DexTacWAM: A Visuo-Tactile World-Action Model for Dexterous Manipulation WorldModel

visuo-tactile world-action model dexterous manipulation video diffusion tactile world modeling

简要说明：DexTacWAM 提出了一种视觉-触觉世界动作模型，将指尖触觉感知融入视频扩散世界模型，用于灵巧双手机器人操作，在六个高接触任务中显著优于仅视觉基线。

TLDR: DexTacWAM introduces a visuo-tactile World-Action Model that integrates fingertip tactile sensing into a video diffusion world model for dexterous bimanual manipulation, significantly outperforming vision-only baselines across six contact-rich tasks.

Abstract: Dexterous manipulation depends on contact dynamics that are often only partially observable from vision. Recent World-Action Models (WAMs) couple predictive video world modeling with action generation, but remain largely vision-centric and therefore cannot directly model these contact dynamics. We present DexTacWAM, a visuo-tactile WAM that encodes each fingertip independently, aggregates the resulting features through a finger- and pose-aware tactile compressor, and injects the tactile latent into a video diffusion world model for joint visuo-tactile world modeling. Across six contact-rich dexterous manipulation tasks on a 22-DoF bimanual platform, DexTacWAM achieves the highest score on every task, averaging 70.6 versus 38.0 for the strongest baseline. Ablations attribute the gain to modeling contact evolution as part of the predicted world state rather than tactile conditioning alone: removing tactile world modeling reduces the four-task mean from 74.7 to 26.6 while keeping the same tactile features and action expert. After four hours of tactile-encoder adaptation with a frozen pretrained vision VAE, our continual vision-to-touch learning extends the pretrained video model to touch using roughly 100 demonstrations per task without tactile midtraining, while retaining visual prediction quality within 0.5 dB of vision-only counterparts. The compressor retains 89.4% of pre-fusion contact recall while enabling 2.26x faster training and 1.29x faster inference. Together, these results show that pretrained video priors can be extended to distributed multi-finger contact dynamics in a data- and compute-efficient manner.

摘要（中文）：灵巧操作依赖于接触动力学，而这类动力学往往仅能从视觉中获得部分可观测性。近期提出的世界-动作模型（WAMs）将预测性视频世界建模与动作生成相结合，但其本质上仍以视觉为中心，因此无法直接建模上述接触动力学。我们提出了DexTacWAM，一种视触觉世界-动作模型，该模型对每个指尖独立编码，通过具备手指与姿态感知的触觉压缩器聚合所得到的特征，并将触觉潜变量注入视频扩散世界模型，以进行视触觉联合世界建模。在22自由度双臂平台上的六项高接触灵巧操作任务中，DexTacWAM在每项任务上均取得了最高得分，平均得分70.6，而最强基线的平均得分为38.0。消融实验表明，性能提升来源于将接触演化作为预测世界状态的一部分进行建模，而非仅依赖触觉条件约束：在保持相同触觉特征和动作专家的情况下，移除触觉世界建模使四项任务的平均得分从74.7降至26.6。在冻结预训练视觉VAE的条件下，经过四小时触觉编码器自适应训练，我们的持续视触觉学习方法以每项任务约100条示范数据将预训练视频模型扩展至触觉模态，无需触觉中期训练，同时将视觉预测质量保持在仅视觉模型的0.5 dB范围内。该压缩器保留了融合前触觉召回率的89.4%，同时实现了2.26倍的训练加速和1.29倍的推理加速。综合上述结果，本文表明预训练视频先验能够以数据高效和计算高效的方式扩展至分布式多指接触动力学建模。

Authors: Haoran Yuan, Zekai Wang, Boning Shao, Haoran Lu, Trevor Darrell, Ismini Lourentzou, Wei Zhan

Think Like a World Model, Act Like a VLA: Distilling World-Model Representations into Compact Robot Policies VLA

world-model distillation representation alignment vision-language-action compact policy real-robot manipulation

简要说明：本文提出了一种将世界模型表示蒸馏到紧凑VLA策略中的方法，在不增加测试时计算或模型容量的情况下，提高了操作任务的鲁棒性和性能。

TLDR: This paper introduces a method to distill world-model representations into compact VLA policies, improving robustness and performance on manipulation tasks without added test-time compute or model capacity.

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models map observations to actions with no objective that accounts for how the world responds, so their robustness is bounded primarily by data coverage. World models carry precisely that missing objective and are better grounded for it, yet rolling the future forward costs seconds per decision and rules them out of the control loop. We show the two can be separated. What a world model knows about physical scenes lives in its internal features; generating the future is merely the objective that produced them, so the grounding can be inherited while the generative machinery is left behind. We add one feature-alignment term to ordinary VLA training: a frozen world model is run over the training frames once and cached, and the student learns to agree with that cache. No teacher is loaded during training, the projector is discarded after it, and the deployed policy is identical to the undistilled baseline, running in 32ms and 1.86GB on a consumer RTX5090, so every gain is attributable to the representation rather than to added capacity or test-time compute. A 0.8B student reaches 97.9% on LIBERO, improves from 48.2% to 50.5% on RoboCasa-GR1 humanoid manipulation, and the same objective carries over to real hardware, on both a single-arm and a bimanual platform. The gain survives changes of student scale, backbone, alignment layer, and teacher, indicating a broad representational prior rather than a fragile alignment between two particular networks. Project page: https://thaw-vla.trung-dt.com/.

摘要（中文）：视觉-语言-行动（VLA）模型将观测映射为动作，但缺乏对世界如何响应的建模目标，因此其鲁棒性主要受限于数据覆盖范围。世界模型恰好承载了这一缺失的目标，并因此具有更坚实的理论基础，然而将未来向前推演需要每步决策耗费数秒，使其无法进入控制回路。我们证明这两者可以分离。世界模型对物理场景的认知存在于其内部特征中；生成未来仅仅是产生这些特征的目标，因此可以在放弃生成机制的同时继承其基础性表征。我们在常规VLA训练中添加一项特征对齐项：将冻结的世界模型在训练帧上运行一次并缓存结果，学生模型学习与该缓存对齐。训练期间无需加载教师模型，训练后投影层被丢弃，部署的策略与未蒸馏的基线完全相同，在消费级RTX5090上以32ms和1.86GB运行，因此所有增益均归因于表征本身，而非额外的模型容量或测试时计算。一个0.8B的学生模型在LIBERO上达到97.9%，在RoboCasa-GR1人形操作任务上从48.2%提升至50.5%，且相同的目标可迁移至真实硬件，包括单臂和双臂平台。该增益在改变学生模型规模、骨干网络、对齐层和教师模型后依然保持，表明这是一种广泛存在的表征先验，而非两个特定网络之间的脆弱对齐。项目页面：https://thaw-vla.trung-dt.com/。

Authors: Trung Dao, Sankalp Yamsani, Jaden Park, Joohyung Kim, Yong Jae Lee

ARSTAG: An Agentic Real2Sim2Real System for Task-Specific Robot Data Generation Manipulation

agentic system Real2Sim2Real data generation visuomotor policy sim-to-real

简要说明：ARSTAG是一个智能体驱动的Real2Sim2Real系统，能从单张RGB图像和自然语言指令自动构建仿真场景并生成任务特定的机器人演示数据，实现视觉运动策略到真实双臂机器人的仿真到现实迁移。

TLDR: ARSTAG is an agentic Real2Sim2Real system that automatically builds simulation scenes and generates task-specific robot demonstrations from a single RGB image and natural-language instruction, enabling sim-to-real transfer of visuomotor policies to a real dual-arm robot.

Abstract: Adapting visuomotor policies to new manipulation tasks often requires substantial manual engineering or teleoperated data collection. Simulation can provide task-specific data at scale, but constructing the scene, designing expert behavior, and configuring data generation still require significant per-task effort. We present ARSTAG, an agentic Real2Sim2Real system that turns a single RGB image and a natural-language instruction directly into robot policy-learning data. A hierarchy of language agents constructs a task-scoped simulation scene, generates robot-feasible demonstrations, and expands the training distribution through task-consistent randomization, while a coordinator agent manages cross-stage feedback and recovery. Across seven manipulation tasks spanning grasping, placement, and stacking, the ARSTAG-generated demonstrations enable sim-to-real transfer of three visuomotor policy architectures to a dual-arm robot, with pi0.5 achieving an average real-world success rate of 74.6%. Ablations show that task-consistent randomization substantially improves robustness, and policy performance increases with generated dataset size. Project webpage: https://boweili666.github.io/ARSTAG/.

摘要（中文）：将视觉运动策略适应于新的操作任务通常需要大量的手动工程或远程操作数据收集。仿真能够规模化提供任务特定的数据，但构建场景、设计专家行为以及配置数据生成仍然需要大量针对每项任务的投入。我们提出了ARSTAG，一种智能体化的实景到仿真再到实景（Real2Sim2Real）系统，能够直接将单张RGB图像和自然语言指令转化为机器人策略学习数据。一个由语言智能体组成的层级结构构建任务范围内的仿真场景，生成机器人可执行的示范，并通过任务一致的随机化扩展训练分布，同时由一个协调智能体管理跨阶段反馈与恢复。在涵盖抓取、放置和堆叠的七项操作任务中，ARSTAG生成的示范使三种视觉运动策略架构能够实现从仿真到真实世界的迁移，其中pi0.5达到了平均74.6%的真实世界成功率。消融实验表明，任务一致的随机化显著提升了鲁棒性，且策略性能随生成数据集规模的增大而提升。项目网页：https://boweili666.github.io/ARSTAG/。

Authors: Bowei Li, Yuner Zhang, Changliu Liu

Zeva-Ego: Egocentric Mid-Training with In-Context Causal Learning for Robot Manipulation VLA

egocentric video VLA mid-training action-effect feedback In-Context Causal Learning robot manipulation

简要说明：Zeva-Ego 提出了一种机器人操作框架，通过动作中心编码器将人类第一视角视频转化为用于VLA中间训练的动作中心监督，并利用上下文因果学习实现基于机器人交互反馈的无参数适应，从而从人类经验中可扩展学习并持续改进。

TLDR: Zeva-Ego introduces a framework for robot manipulation that uses an Action-Centric Encoder to convert egocentric human videos into action-centered supervision for VLA mid-training, and In-Context Causal Learning for parameter-free adaptation from robot interaction feedback, achieving scalable learning from human experience and continual improvement.

Abstract: Egocentric video offers a scalable source of physical interaction experience, yet translating it into robot-executable knowledge and enabling continual adaptation remain challenging. We introduce Zeva-Ego, a unified framework that learns physical priors from human experience and evolves through robot interaction. An Action-Centric Encoder (ACE) converts egocentric visual transitions into action-centered supervision for VLA mid-training, while In-Context Causal Learning (ICCL) enables parameter-free adaptation from action-effect feedback at deployment. Scaling Ego data to 10K hours improves RoboTwin success from 63.8% to 75.3%, matching 2K hours of robot demonstrations (74.7%), corresponding to an empirical data ratio of roughly 4-5:1. With accumulated interaction experience, ICCL further improves success from 58% to 89% within four attempts without parameter updates. These results demonstrate a scalable path toward embodied intelligence that learns from human experience and continuously improves through its own interaction.

摘要（中文）：以自我为中心的视频提供了物理交互体验的可扩展来源，但将其转化为机器人可执行的知识并实现持续适应仍具挑战性。我们引入了Zeva-Ego，一个统一框架，它从人类经验中学习物理先验，并通过机器人交互不断进化。动作中心编码器（ACE）将以自我为中心的视觉转换转化为适用于VLA中间训练的动作中心监督，而上下文因果学习（ICCL）则能够在部署时通过动作-效果反馈实现无参数适应。将自我中心数据扩展至10,000小时，可将RoboTwin的成功率从63.8%提升至75.3%，与2,000小时机器人演示（74.7%）相当，对应的经验数据比率约为4-5:1。随着交互经验的积累，ICCL在不更新参数的情况下，能在四次尝试内将成功率从58%提升至89%。这些结果表明，一条通往具身智能的可扩展路径正逐步形成，该路径从人类经验中学习，并通过自身交互不断改进。

Authors: Bingjia Huang, Xin Ding, Fu Chen, Kun Li, Wei Sun, Hao Wu, Yunxin Liu, Ting Cao

ME-Brain-1.0: Memory, Cognition and Action for Evolving Embodied Intelligence VLA

self-evolving evolvable memory cognitive core action model embodied intelligence

简要说明：ME-Brain提出了一种自进化的具身智能系统，包含可进化记忆、认知核心和动作模型，在具身基准和真实机器人任务上无需重训练即取得优异性能。

TLDR: ME-Brain introduces a self-evolving embodied intelligence system with evolvable memory, cognitive core, and action model, achieving strong performance on embodied benchmarks and real-robot tasks without retraining.

Abstract: Current embodied systems largely rely on pretrained capabilities that remain fixed after deployment, limiting their ability to learn from physical interaction. We introduce MachEmbodied-Brain (ME-Brain), a self-evolving embodied system organized around a closed loop of action execution, experience acquisition, experience evolution, and improved execution. Evolvable Memory consolidates multimodal trajectories into hierarchical, reusable experience; Cognitive Core transforms physical experience into transferable skills; and the Action Model combines event-driven keyframes, EventCell local-world prediction, and action-conditioned memory modulation to focus computation on decision-critical moments, regions, and historical evidence. Together, these modules shift embodied intelligence from train-and-freeze to deploy-and-evolve without model retraining. Cognitive Core outperforms the strongest comparison models by 8.2 and 9.6 points on embodied and agent benchmarks. The Action Model achieves 47.88% mean success on RoboMME, a 3.26-point improvement over the strongest baseline. On RoboDojo, it reaches a 21.51 mean Score and 16.03% success rate, exceeding $π_{0.5}$ by 10.10 and 9.12 points. On the six-task ME-RealBench, ME-Brain achieves a 69.5 mean Score and 66.7% success rate, outperforming DM0.5 by 12.8 and 11.7 points, respectively.

摘要（中文）：当前的具身系统主要依赖预训练能力，这些能力在部署后保持不变，限制了系统从物理交互中学习的能力。我们提出了MachEmbodied-Brain（ME-Brain），一种自进化具身系统，围绕动作执行、经验获取、经验演化与改进执行形成闭环。可演化记忆将多模态轨迹整合为分层、可复用的经验；认知核心将物理经验转化为可迁移的技能；动作模型结合事件驱动关键帧、EventCell局部世界预测以及动作条件记忆调制，将计算聚焦于决策关键时刻、关键区域和历史证据。这些模块协同作用，使具身智能从“训练后冻结”转变为“部署即演化”，且无需模型重训练。认知核心在具身和智能体基准测试中分别超越最强对比模型8.2和9.6分。动作模型在RoboMME上达到47.88%的平均成功率，较最强基线提升3.26个百分点；在RoboDojo上取得21.51的平均得分和16.03%的成功率，分别超过π₀.₅达10.10和9.12分。在六任务ME-RealBench中，ME-Brain取得69.5的平均得分和66.7%的成功率，分别超越DM₀.₅达12.8和11.7分。

Authors: Wei He, Hengtao Li, Zhongrui Yu, Xuhan Zhu, Maokui He, Zide Liu, Xiyue Zhang, Xianwei Mao, Chunpeng Zhou, Jia Shi, Yanze Xin, Jingwen Li, Jingxie Zheng, Sijie Zeng, Chenfeng Wang, Fan Lu, Zeyu Zhang, Shuai Guo, Hengxuan Zhang, Pengfei Yu, Jia Shi, Yu Liu, Kun Zhan, Yan Xie

GraspTune: Tactile-Driven Execution Refinement for Robust Grasping Manipulation

tactile-driven grasp execution refinement residual policy contact semantics real-robot transfer

简要说明：GraspTune 是一种由触觉驱动的执行精炼框架，通过残差运动和接触语义学习提升视觉抓取方案的成功率，并在大量仿真和真实机器人实验中验证。

TLDR: GraspTune is a tactile-driven execution refinement framework that improves the success of visual grasp proposals by applying residual motions and learning contact semantics, validated in extensive simulation and real-robot trials.

Abstract: Visual grasp proposal generation has advanced rapidly, yet converting a selected proposal into a stable physical grasp remains a central execution-stage challenge. This paper introduces GraspTune, a tactile-driven execution-stage refinement framework that starts from a nominal proposal and applies bounded residual TCP motions during approach, contact formation, and final grasp execution. GraspTune learns control-facing contact semantics from local depth, tactile signals, state, and history using state-conditioned expert contact queries and multi-task supervision for contact change, contact risk, and post-close readiness. The representation conditions a diffusion-pretrained residual policy and is aligned with PPO for closed-loop execution. Across more than 60,000 simulated executions over 20 object categories, GraspTune establishes an execution-layer benefit across four proposal generators, raising stable grasp success by +19.22, +9.55, +12.45, and +20.70 percentage points for GraspNet, Contact-GraspNet, AnyGrasp, and VGN. A four-fold held-out category study raises unseen-object execution from 54.58% to 70.33%, showing category-disjoint generalization of contact correction. Across more than 1,000 real-robot trials on a UR5e setup with Xense fingertip sensors, GraspTune raises GraspNet execution from 71.0% to 84.3%, validating direct transfer without realworld policy fine-tuning. Together, these results turn visually plausible proposals into stable physical grasps for downstream contact-rich manipulation. A supplementary video is available at https://youtu.be/kcq7fSLNtzU.

摘要（中文）：摘要： 视觉抓取提议生成技术发展迅速，但如何将选定的提议转化为稳定的物理抓取仍是执行阶段的核心挑战。本文提出GraspTune，一种基于触觉驱动的执行阶段精修框架，从名义提议出发，在接近、接触形成及最终抓取执行过程中施加有界残差TCP运动。GraspTune利用局部深度、触觉信号、状态及历史信息，通过状态条件化专家接触查询及多任务监督（涵盖接触变化、接触风险及闭合后就绪状态），学习面向控制的接触语义。该表示对扩散预训练残差策略进行条件化，并与PPO算法对齐实现闭环执行。在超过20个物体类别、60,000余次模拟执行中，GraspTune在四种提议生成器上均展现出执行层增益，使GraspNet、Contact-GraspNet、AnyGrasp及VGN的稳定抓取成功率分别提升+19.22、+9.55、+12.45及+20.70个百分点。四倍留出类别研究将未见物体执行成功率从54.58%提升至70.33%，证明接触修正具备跨类别泛化能力。在配备Xense指尖传感器的UR5e平台上进行的1,000余次真实机器人试验中，GraspTune将GraspNet执行成功率从71.0%提升至84.3%，验证了无需真实环境策略微调即可直接迁移的有效性。以上结果表明，该方法能够将视觉上合理的提议转化为稳定的物理抓取，服务于下游接触丰富操作任务。补充视频见https://youtu.be/kcq7fSLNtzU。

Authors: Juntao Li, Xingke Xia, Sichao Liu, Daqiang Guo

Dexterous Robot Manipulation from Human Demonstrations via Contact-Anchored Retargeting and Residual Policy Learning Manipulation

dexterous manipulation human demonstration contact retargeting residual RL bimanual tasks

简要说明：一种三阶段流程通过接触锚定重定向和残差强化学习，将人体动捕演示转化为灵巧机器人策略，无需真实机器人数据即可实现多手型迁移和双臂操作。

TLDR: A three-stage pipeline converts human motion-capture demonstrations into dexterous robot policies via physics-based contact recovery, contact-anchored retargeting, and shared residual RL, enabling zero-real-robot-data transfer to multiple hands and real bimanual tasks.

Abstract: Learning dexterous manipulation from demonstrations is bottlenecked by data: the contact forces that determine whether a grasp succeeds are absent from every scalable source of human demonstrations. This paper builds on two observations. First, what survives the change from a human hand to a robot hand is the contact structure of a demonstration - which finger regions touch which object locations, and in what order - rather than its joint motion. Second, physical consistency need not be engineered per task: a single residual reinforcement learning (RL) policy, trained once across diverse demonstrations, can repair kinematic recordings into physically consistent, contact-annotated trajectories, and the same residual formulation restores dynamic feasibility after retargeting. These observations yield a three-stage pipeline that converts human motion-capture recordings into dexterous robot policies with no real-robot training data: physics refinement with a simulated MANO hand recovers contacts and forces, contact-anchored retargeting transfers the demonstrated contact structure through an objective independent of hand morphology, and residual policy learning adapts the result to robot actuation. The pipeline reconstructs 25,454 single-hand trajectories (success 7.3% -> 59.3%) and 25 dual-hand tasks (16.0% -> 62.4%) with one shared policy per setting, transfers one human dataset to four morphologically distinct robot hands (+62.4 pp), and executes four contact-rich bimanual tasks on physical hardware with zero real-robot training data.

摘要（中文）：从人类演示中学习灵巧操作受制于数据瓶颈：决定抓取成败的接触力在各类可扩展的人类演示数据源中均缺失。本文基于两个观察展开。第一，从人手到机器人手的转换中得以保留的是演示的接触结构——哪些手指区域接触哪些物体位置，以及接触顺序——而非关节运动。第二，物理一致性无需针对每个任务单独设计：一个在多样化演示上统一训练的残差强化学习（RL）策略，可以将运动学记录修复为物理一致且带有接触标注的轨迹，且同一残差公式在重定向后也能恢复动态可行性。基于这些观察，本文提出一个三阶段流水线，将人类动作捕捉记录转化为灵巧机器人策略，且无需任何真实机器人训练数据：使用仿真MANO手进行物理细化以恢复接触与力，接触锚定的重定向通过与手部形态无关的目标函数迁移演示的接触结构，残差策略学习则将结果适配至机器人驱动。该流水线重建了25，454条单手轨迹（成功率从7.3%提升至59.3%）和25个双手任务（从16.0%提升至62.4%），每种设置仅使用一个共享策略；将一个人体数据集迁移至四个形态各异的机器人手（提升62.4个百分点）；并在真实硬件上执行四个富含接触的双手任务，且零真实机器人训练数据。

Authors: Zihao Yang, Chengyuan Liu, Yu Zhou, Runze Lv, Tianyu Cui, Sheng Yi, Haohua Zhu, Irvine Lu, JieQ Sun

Imagine-RL: Residual-Confidence-Guided Cross-Attention for World-Model-Augmented VLA Reinforcement Learning VLA

VLA RL world model cross-attention residual confidence contact-rich manipulation

简要说明：Imagine-RL 通过动作条件下的视觉-扭矩想象和残差置信引导的交叉注意力，增强噪声空间 VLA 后训练中的动作评估，从而在接触丰富的操作任务中以更少的 RL 轨迹获得更高的成功率。

TLDR: Imagine-RL augments noise-space VLA post-training with action-conditioned visual-torque imagination and residual-confidence-guided cross-attention to improve action evaluation in contact-rich manipulation, achieving higher success rates with fewer RL trajectories on real robots.

Abstract: Reliable action evaluation in contact-rich manipulation requires looking beyond the current observation to future visual and contact consequences. Existing noise-space reinforcement learning efficiently steers a frozen Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policy, but its critics largely ignore these consequences. We present Imagine-RL, which augments noise-space VLA post-training with action-conditioned visual-torque imagination. For each candidate action chunk, a frozen visual-torque latent world model (VTLWM) autoregressively predicts compact future representations without pixel reconstruction. A current image-state-action query attends to observed histories and predicted futures, while previous-window prediction residuals provide token-wise confidence priors that suppress unreliable future tokens. By combining current evidence with predicted consequences, the action critic better evaluates candidate actions and supervises the actor, while the VLA and VTLWM remain frozen. Across four real-robot tasks with 50 evaluation trials per task, Imagine-RL uses only 100 RL trajectories and improves the average success rate by (23.6%) over DSRL and by (60%) over VLA baselines.

摘要（中文）：在接触丰富的操作任务中，可靠的动作评估需要超越当前观察，展望未来的视觉与接触后果。现有的噪声空间强化学习方法能够高效地微调冻结的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略，但其批评者大多忽略了这些后果。我们提出了Imagine-RL，该方法在噪声空间VLA后训练中引入动作条件下的视觉-触觉想象机制。对于每个候选动作块，一个冻结的视觉-触觉潜在世界模型（VTLWM）以自回归方式预测紧凑的未来表示，而无需像素重建。当前图像-状态-动作查询同时关注已观测的历史序列与预测的未来序列，而前窗口预测残差则提供标记级置信度先验，用于抑制不可靠的未来标记。通过将当前证据与预测后果相结合，动作评论者能够更准确地评估候选动作并监督行动者，而VLA和VTLWM保持冻结状态。在四个真实机器人任务、每项任务50次评估试验中，Imagine-RL仅使用100条强化学习轨迹，相较于DSRL平均成功率提升23.6%，相较于VLA基线提升60%。

Authors: Kejia Hu, Wentong Zhai, Bo Zhao, Shuai Liang

Opt2VLA: Force-Aware Vision-Language-Action for Contact-Rich Humanoid Whole-Body Manipulation VLA

force-aware VLA humanoid whole-body manipulation contact-rich tasks trajectory optimization reinforcement learning

简要说明：Opt2VLA 提出了用于人形机器人全身操作的力量感知 VLA 框架，联合预测几何运动目标和连续接触力参考，并由基于强化学习的控制器跟踪，通过轨迹优化提供物理合理的监督，提升接触丰富任务中的力调节精度。

TLDR: Opt2VLA introduces force-aware VLA for humanoid whole-body manipulation, predicting both geometric motion goals and continuous contact-force references tracked by RL-based controllers, with trajectory optimization providing physically grounded supervision for improved force regulation in contact-rich tasks.

Abstract: Humanoid robots are expected to perform diverse human-level tasks in daily environments, many of which require precise regulation of interaction forces. While recent vision-language-action (VLA) models have shown promise for semantic planning and visuomotor control, existing humanoid systems primarily represent actions through geometric motion goals and rely on whole-body controllers focused on motion tracking, with limited explicit reasoning or control of interaction forces. This limitation is particularly relevant in contact-rich tasks, where geometrically similar motions may require different force regimes depending on the task context and where visual observations may become unreliable after contact. In this work, we present Opt2VLA, a force-aware VLA framework that introduces explicit force commands at the VLA-to-control interface for humanoid whole-body manipulation. A single multi-task VLA policy jointly predicts both geometric motion goals and continuous contact-force references, which are tracked by task-specific reinforcement learning (RL)-based whole-body controllers. To provide scalable and physically grounded supervision, we generate dynamically feasible and contact-consistent training data via whole-body trajectory optimization (TO) with explicit force references. We evaluate Opt2VLA on three contact-rich humanoid tasks and show that explicit force conditioning enables more accurate and consistent force regulation than motion-only control, while physically grounded torque supervision from TO further improves force tracking accuracy and stability. Closed-loop evaluations further demonstrate language-conditioned force modulation with Opt2VLA in simulation and on humanoid hardware.

摘要（中文）：类人机器人被期望在日常生活环境中执行各种人类级别的任务，其中许多任务要求对交互力进行精确调节。尽管近期视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在语义规划和视觉运动控制方面展现出潜力，但现有类人机器人系统主要通过几何运动目标来表示动作，并依赖侧重于运动跟踪的全身控制器，对交互力的显式推理或控制能力有限。这一局限性在与接触密切相关的任务中尤为突出，因为在这些任务中，几何上相似的运动可能需要根据任务情境施加不同的力模式，且接触后视觉观测可能变得不可靠。在本工作中，我们提出了Opt2VLA，一种力感知的VLA框架，在VLA到控制的接口上引入显式力指令，用于类人机器人全身操作。一个多任务VLA策略联合预测几何运动目标和连续接触力参考值，这些参考值由基于强化学习（RL）的任务特定全身控制器进行跟踪。为提供可扩展且物理可验证的监督，我们通过带有显式力参考的全身轨迹优化（TO）生成动态可行且接触一致的训练数据。我们在三个接触密集的类人机器人任务上评估了Opt2VLA，结果表明，与仅运动控制相比，显式力条件化能够实现更准确且更一致的力调节，而来自轨迹优化的物理可验证力矩监督进一步提高了力跟踪精度和稳定性。闭环评估进一步验证了Opt2VLA在仿真和类人机器人硬件上的语言条件化力调制能力。

Authors: Fukang Liu, Yipu Chen, Jaehwi Jang, Danfei Xu, Zsolt Kira, Ye Zhao

Topology-Informed Visual Prompting For Vision Language Action Policies VLA

topological signatures visual prompting Gauss Linking Integral simulation-based planning bimanual manipulation

简要说明：本文提出了一种面向VLA策略的拓扑引导视觉提示框架，通过仿真规划和拓扑签名增强训练数据并在部署时提供视觉提示，提升了复杂障碍几何环境下的双臂操作性能。

TLDR: This paper introduces a topology-guided visual-prompting framework for VLA policies, using simulation-based planning and topological signatures to augment training data and provide visual prompts, improving performance on bimanual manipulation tasks with complex obstacle geometries.

Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies can struggle with manipulation tasks with complex obstacle geometries due to partial observability. These complex geometries can lead to similar visual observations or robot configurations requiring qualitatively different actions, a distinction that can be quantified using topological signatures. While motion planners with full knowledge of environment geometries and object states can reason about these signatures in planning, this information is often not known at deployment. To address this issue, we present a topology-guided visual-prompting framework that uses simulation-based planning to augment a nominal demonstration dataset and provides vision-based guidance at deployment. Our method uses a Gauss-Linking-Integral topological signature representation to capture important topological properties of the environment. Using privileged geometry information from a simulation approximation of our environment, we augment a VLA fine-tuning dataset with trajectories that move the system to a demonstrated signature and, from the new configuration, resume task execution. A vision-language model (VLM) is fine-tuned on the same dataset to both predict signatures from live camera observations and predict end-effector waypoints, which are rendered as visual prompts on the observations to guide the VLA. Across three simulated bimanual tasks and a real-world box pickup task, our method outperforms a VLA fine-tuned only on nominal demonstrations and a VLM-prompting baseline that can remove topology-relevant information from observations. On hardware, it exceeds the strongest baseline by 40% in task success. Project website: https://topology-vla.github.io.

摘要（中文）：视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略在面临具有复杂障碍几何形状的操作任务时，可能因部分可观测性而表现不佳。这些复杂的几何形状可能导致相似的视觉观测或机器人构型需要本质不同的动作，而这种差异可以通过拓扑特征加以量化。尽管在规划过程中，具备环境几何形状和物体状态完整信息的运动规划器能够考虑这些特征，但在实际部署时，这些信息往往不可得。为解决这一问题，我们提出了一种拓扑引导的视觉提示框架，该框架利用基于仿真的规划来扩充标准示范数据集，并在部署阶段提供基于视觉的引导。我们的方法采用高斯链接积分拓扑特征表示来捕捉环境的重要拓扑属性。利用环境仿真近似中的特权几何信息，我们将能够使系统移动到已示范拓扑特征状态的轨迹扩充至VLA微调数据集中，并从新配置出发继续执行任务。我们在同一数据集上微调了一个视觉-语言模型（VLM），使其既能从实时摄像头观测中预测拓扑特征，也能预测末端执行器航点，这些航点以视觉提示的形式渲染在观测图像上，用以引导VLA。在三个仿真双臂任务和一个真实世界的箱子拾取任务中，我们的方法优于仅在标准示范数据上微调的VLA，以及一个可能从观测中移除与拓扑相关信息的VLM提示基线。在硬件实验中，我们的方法在任务成功率上比最强基线高出40%。项目网站：https://topology-vla.github.io。

Authors: Haoyang Wu, Abhinav Kumar, Dmitry Berenson

Grounded Action Model: 3D Grounding as a Foundation for Robotics Manipulation

3D grounding manipulation policy object-centric representation multi-stream transformer action chunks

简要说明：本文提出了接地动作模型（GAMs），一种利用3D接地和以对象为中心的表示来提升操作策略鲁棒性和性能的机器人基础模型范式，在仿真和真实机器人任务上均表现出色。

TLDR: This paper introduces Grounded Action Models (GAMs), a robot foundation model paradigm that uses 3D grounding with object-centric representations to improve manipulation policy robustness and performance across simulated and real-robot tasks.

Abstract: Manipulation policies must know which objects matter and where they are, yet the pretrained backbones that current robot foundation models build on, from language in vision-language-action models (VLAs) to video generation in world-action models (WAMs), do not directly require this metric grounding, leaving it to be learned implicitly from robot demonstrations. We propose Grounded Action Models (GAMs), a new paradigm of robot foundation models built with 3D grounding. GAM can be conditioned using language, points, or box prompts, which are first transformed into a shared object-centric representation of the selected objects. This representation captures target-focused visual features and metric object geometry, which is mixed with robot state history through a multi-stream transformer to predict action chunks. Although GAMs can be run autonomously, they can also serve as a low-level controller that a high-level planner controls using its various input modalities, allowing for long-horizon and memory-dependent manipulation. On RoboTwin 2.0, GAM achieves an average success rate of 55.3% across 50 tasks (vs. 52.0% for Spatial Forcing), including 47.6% under scene randomization (vs. 30.4% for Abot-M0), with its action policy trained only on clean-scene demonstrations. On LIBERO-PRO, it achieves a state-of-the-art average success rate of 61% (vs. 53% for $π_{0.5}$) across 16 perturbation settings, with the largest gains when targets are relocated or newly designated. On two real robots, GAM retains 17/20 successes under visual shift on a bimanual YAM versus 4/20 for $π_{0.5}$, while its composition with a Molmo2 planner on a Franka achieves 64.7% ID and 49.8% OOD step completion on long-horizon and memory-dependent tasks.

摘要（中文）：操作策略必须知道哪些物体是重要的以及它们的位置，然而当前机器人基础模型所依赖的预训练主干网络——从视觉-语言-动作模型（VLAs）中的语言到世界-动作模型（WAMs）中的视频生成——并不直接要求这种度量级接地，而是将其隐含地从机器人示范中学习。我们提出了接地动作模型（GAMs），这是一种基于3D接地构建的机器人基础模型的新范式。GAM可以通过语言、点或框提示进行条件化，这些提示首先被转换为所选物体的共享以物体为中心的表示。该表示捕获了目标聚焦的视觉特征和度量级物体几何信息，并通过多流Transformer与机器人状态历史混合，以预测动作块。尽管GAM可以自主运行，但它们也可以作为低级控制器，由高级规划器使用其各种输入模态进行控制，从而实现长时程和依赖记忆的操作。在RoboTwin 2.0上，GAM在50个任务中实现了55.3%的平均成功率（而Spatial Forcing为52.0%），在场景随机化下达到47.6%（而Abot-M0为30.4%），其动作策略仅使用干净场景示范进行训练。在LIBERO-PRO上，GAM在16种扰动设置下实现了最先进的61%平均成功率（而π₀.₅为53%），在目标被重新定位或重新指定的情况下增益最大。在两台真实机器人上，GAM在双机械臂YAM上的视觉偏移下保持了17/20的成功率，而π₀.₅为4/20，同时其与Franka上的Molmo2规划器组合在长时程和依赖记忆任务中实现了64.7%的ID和49.8%的OOD步骤完成率。

Authors: Gehao Zhang, Weikai Huang, Shailesh Shailesh, Yiyan Peng, Jiafei Duan, Ranjay Krishna

Structured World-State Reasoning for Agentic Robotic Search VLN

robotic search world-state reasoning language-guided navigation geospatial priors multimodal evidence

简要说明：WORLDS 是一个用于长时程机器人搜索的框架，它将自然语言推理锚定在持久化的图世界状态中，通过并行推理器和检查/判断循环在 CityNav 上取得了最先进的导航成功率，并在真实四旋翼上进行了演示。

TLDR: WORLDS is a framework for long-horizon robotic search that grounds natural language reasoning in a persistent graph world-state, using parallel reasoners and an examiner/judge loop to achieve state-of-the-art navigation success on CityNav and demonstrate real quadrotor flights.

Abstract: Long-horizon robotic search must resolve natural language against heterogeneous, incomplete, and often ambiguous evidence: textual information, prior maps, and observations arriving over time. The core challenge is to contextualize these streams and decide where to gather evidence before selecting a target. We present WORLDS: World-state Observation and Reasoning for Language-guided Discovery and Search, a framework that grounds reasoning in a persistent graph initialized from geospatial priors and updated by perception. Parallel Reasoners maintain competing candidate interpretations and request evidence to distinguish between them. We collect and process the requested observations with a multimodal Examiner, after which a Judge selects a grounded target or requests another pass. WORLDS achieves 51.8% navigation success across all 5,311 CityNav test episodes, the highest reported success rate, exceeding the previous published best by 15.7 percentage points under an OSM-only, high-resolution orthographic protocol. On 1,000 shared episodes, it achieves 50.0% versus 27.9% for the strongest adapted baseline using the same model, prior, sensing stack, and movement budget. Observation-based verification by the Examiner contributes 5.9 points of this success, and at a reduced reasoning-effort setting WORLDS still exceeds the adapted GeoNav baseline by 18.8 points while generating fewer tokens. We also demonstrate WORLDS on a quadrotor, which flies the generated sensing waypoints and grounds three language targets, including a vehicle absent from the map, from its onboard imagery.

摘要（中文）：长时域机器人搜索必须在异构、不完整且常常模糊的证据中解析自然语言：文本信息、先验地图以及随时间到达的观测数据。核心挑战在于将这些信息流置于上下文中理解，并在选择目标之前决定应在何处收集证据。我们提出WORLDS：面向语言引导发现与搜索的世界状态观测与推理框架，该框架将推理锚定于一个由地理空间先验初始化并经感知更新的持久化图谱中。并行推理器维护相互竞争的候选解释，并请求证据以区分它们。我们通过多模态检查器收集和处理所请求的观测结果，随后由裁判选择有依据的目标或请求进行下一轮推理。WORLDS在全部5，311个CityNav测试场景中实现了51.8%的导航成功率，这是已报道的最高成功率，在仅使用OSM、高分辨率正射影像协议下，比此前已发表的最佳结果高出15.7个百分点。在1，000个共享场景中，WORLDS达到50.0%的成功率，而使用相同模型、先验、感知栈和运动预算的最强适配基线仅为27.9%。其中，检查器基于观测的验证贡献了5.9个百分点的成功率提升；在降低推理开销的设置下，WORLDS仍以更少的令牌生成量超越适配的GeoNav基线18.8个百分点。我们还在一架四旋翼无人机上演示了WORLDS，该无人机执行生成的感觉航点，并基于其机载图像对三个语言目标进行定位，其中包括一个地图上不存在的车辆。

Authors: Finley R. Holt, Luis A. Pabon, John Irvin Alora, Jonas Frey, Marco Pavone

ME-VLM: A Unified VLM for Embodied Cognition and Agent Coordination VLA

embodied cognition vision-language model reinforcement learning multimodal agent edge deployment

简要说明：ME-VLM 提出了一个统一的视觉语言模型（4B 和 35B-A3B），通过能力注入、分离强化学习和多教师蒸馏将具身认知（物理感知、时空推理、规划、交互）与多模态智能体能力结合。在具身、智能体、自动驾驶和导航基准上表现优异，并支持边缘设备部署。

TLDR: ME-VLM introduces a unified vision-language model with two variants (4B and 35B-A3B) that integrates embodied cognition (physical perception, spatiotemporal reasoning, planning, interaction) and multimodal agent capabilities via a training pipeline of capability injection, separate RL, and multi-teacher distillation. It demonstrates competitive performance on embodied, agent, autonomous-driving, and navigation benchmarks, and enables on-device inference via token compression, quantization, and co-optimization.

Abstract: Physical AI requires models to ground visual and linguistic understanding in real-world environments while accounting for environmental constraints and execution feedback. We introduce MachEmbodied-VLM (ME-VLM), a unified vision-language model with two variants, 4B and 35B-A3B, that brings together embodied cognition and multimodal agent capabilities. Our work emphasizes physical perception and spatiotemporal reasoning, together with planning, interaction, and outcome assessment in both digital and physical environments. We construct training data spanning embodied and multimodal agent tasks, including execution observations and feedback to support outcome assessment and decision refinement. The training pipeline comprises embodied capability injection, separate reinforcement learning of embodied and multimodal-agent experts, and multi-teacher on-policy distillation that consolidates their complementary capabilities into a single model. Experiments show competitive performance on both embodied and agent benchmarks, as well as on autonomous-driving and embodied-navigation tasks. For edge deployment, visual token compression, W4A8 quantization, and hardware-software co-optimization enable on-device inference of the 4B variant on the M100, reducing prefill latency from 400 ms to 188 ms. Project Page: https://machembodied.com/ME-Brain/ME-VLM.html Code Repository: https://github.com/MachEmbodied/ME-VLM

摘要（中文）：物理人工智能要求模型在真实世界环境中锚定视觉与语言理解，同时考虑环境约束与执行反馈。我们提出MachEmbodied-VLM（ME-VLM），一个统一的视觉语言模型，包含4B与35B-A3B两个变体，将具身认知与多模态智能体能力融为一体。我们的工作强调物理感知与时空推理，同时涵盖数字与物理环境中的规划、交互及结果评估。我们构建了覆盖具身与多模态智能体任务的训练数据，包括执行观测与反馈，以支持结果评估与决策优化。训练流程包括具身能力注入、具身与多模态智能体专家分别进行强化学习，以及多教师在线策略蒸馏，将二者互补能力整合至单一模型。实验表明，该模型在具身与智能体基准测试、自动驾驶以及具身导航任务上均表现出具有竞争力的性能。针对边缘部署，通过视觉令牌压缩、W4A8量化及软硬件协同优化，实现了4B变体在M100上的端侧推理，将预填充延迟从400毫秒降低至188毫秒。 项目主页：https://machembodied.com/ME-Brain/ME-VLM.html 代码仓库：https://github.com/MachEmbodied/ME-VLM

Authors: Foundation Model, Li Auto Inc

MIGU: Multimodal Instruction Grounding under Uncertainty for Manipulation Planning Manipulation

multimodal instruction grounding manipulation planning vision-language model uncertainty modeling task-and-motion planning

简要说明：MIGU 是一个模块化框架，通过将 VLM 的语义先验与基于眼-手指几何的 3D 几何似然在不确定性下融合，用于多模态指令接地，支持移动操作和桌面任务与运动规划，并能请求澄清。

TLDR: MIGU is a modular framework that fuses semantic priors from a VLM with 3D geometric likelihoods derived from eye-finger geometry under uncertainty for multimodal instruction grounding, enabling mobile manipulation and tabletop task-and-motion planning with clarification requests.

Abstract: Understanding natural human instructions is crucial for deploying robots in human-centric environments. We study multimodal instruction grounding, where language and gesture provide complementary but uncertain cues. We present MIGU, a modular framework that combines semantic and geometric evidence into a unified grounding belief and connects it to manipulation planning. MIGU constructs a 3D geometric likelihood by propagating viewing-direction and depth uncertainty through eye-finger geometry while accounting for hand-direction estimation error. A vision-language model (VLM) provides semantic priors over candidate objects and regions, which are combined with the geometric likelihood through Bayes-inspired fusion. The resulting belief supports behavior planning to either proceed directly to downstream planning or request clarification. Grounded targets then define goals for mobile manipulation and tabletop task-and-motion planning. On a real-world benchmark, MIGU outperforms all evaluated baselines, while ablations support the benefit of explicit multimodal uncertainty modeling. Project website: multimodal-instruction.github.io

摘要（中文）：理解自然的人类指令对于在人类中心环境中部署机器人至关重要。我们研究了多模态指令接地问题，在该问题中，语言和手势提供了互补但存在不确定性的线索。我们提出了MIGU，一个模块化框架，将语义和几何证据统一为接地信念，并将其与操作规划相连接。MIGU通过眼-手几何传播视线方向和深度不确定性，同时考虑手部方向估计误差，从而构建三维几何似然。视觉语言模型（VLM）提供候选对象和区域的语义先验，并通过受贝叶斯启发的融合与几何似然相结合。由此产生的信念支持行为规划，既可以直接进入下游规划，也可以请求澄清。接地的目标随后为移动操作和桌面任务与运动规划定义目标。在真实世界基准测试中，MIGU优于所有评估的基线方法，而消融实验支持显式多模态不确定性建模的益处。项目网站：multimodal-instruction.github.io

Authors: Mingke Lu, Anxing Xiao, David Hsu

Learning to Drive on Mars: Visual Multimodal Traversability Estimation for Off-World Navigation RLRobot

traversability estimation off-world navigation Mars rover multimodal learning path planning

简要说明：本文介绍了火星2020毅力号火星车数据集（覆盖500个太阳日、45公里行驶），并提出了一种基于多模态驾驶经验的不确定性感知可穿越性估计框架，在AUROC和F1上优于基线方法，并在物理火星车上验证了与路径规划器的集成。

TLDR: This paper introduces the Mars 2020 Perseverance rover dataset spanning 500 sols and 45km of driving, and presents an uncertainty-aware traversability estimation framework that learns multimodal terrain representations for off-world navigation, outperforming baselines in AUROC and F1 and demonstrating integration into path planners on a physical rover.

Abstract: Autonomous navigation on Mars requires vehicles to distinguish between traversable terrains across diverse and visually challenging environments. However, progress in learning-based navigation for off-world environments has been limited by the lack of large-scale datasets. Since landing in Jezero Crater, the Mars 2020 Perseverance rover has traversed terrain ranging from sandy dunes, rocky patches, and flat bedrocks. As a result, this paper presents a dataset spanning 500 sols and 45km of trajectories driven by both human operators and the onboard planner, ENav. Our dataset contains grayscale stereo image pairs, poses, accelerometer readings, rocker-bogie angles, and estimates of tilt and wheel slip. Building on this dataset, we introduce an uncertainty-aware traversability-estimation framework that learns terrain representations from multimodal driving experience. We compare our proposed method against existing approaches on the Mars 2020 dataset and show that our method achieves an AUROC of 0.874 and an F1 score of 0.758, outperforming the strongest baseline by 0.058 and 0.156, respectively, while also achieving the highest average precision and recall. Finally, we show that the visual representations can be integrated into path planners, such as ENav, on a physical rover test bed. Videos, code, and the M2020 dataset will be available at https://darren-chiu.github.io/learning-to-drive-on-mars.

摘要（中文）：火星自主导航要求车辆能够在多样且视觉上具有挑战性的环境中区分可通行地形。然而，基于学习的异星环境导航研究进展一直受限于大规模数据集的缺乏。自着陆于杰泽罗陨石坑以来，火星2020“毅力号”巡视器已穿越包括沙丘、岩石区域和平坦基岩在内的多种地形。为此，本文提出了一个涵盖500个太阳日、由人类操作员和机载规划器ENav共同驱动的45公里轨迹数据集。该数据集包含灰度立体图像对、位姿、加速度计读数、摇臂转向架角度以及倾斜和车轮滑移的估计值。在此数据集基础上，我们引入了一种不确定性感知的可通行性估计框架，该框架从多模态驾驶经验中学习地形表征。我们将所提出的方法与现有方法在火星2020数据集上进行了比较，结果表明，我们的方法取得了0.874的AUROC和0.758的F1分数，分别比最强基线高出0.058和0.156，同时实现了最高的平均精度和召回率。最后，我们展示了视觉表征可集成到路径规划器（如ENav）中，并在实体巡视器测试平台上进行了验证。视频、代码和M2020数据集将在https://darren-chiu.github.io/learning-to-drive-on-mars上提供。

Authors: Darren Chiu, Cole Wilson, Andrei Tumbar, Gaurav S. Sukhatme, Steven Myint

Visuomotor Robotic Pruning in Planar Orchards Using Hybrid Reinforcement Learning Manipulation

robotic pruning visuomotor control hybrid reinforcement learning sim-to-real transfer planar orchards

简要说明：该论文提出了一种端到端流水线，用于学习平面果园树木修剪的闭环视觉运动控制器，利用合成数据和混合强化学习算法，并在物理硬件上验证了零样本仿真到现实的迁移。

TLDR: This paper presents an end-to-end pipeline for learning a closed-loop visuomotor controller for robotic pruning of planar orchard trees, using synthetic data and a hybrid reinforcement learning algorithm, and validates zero-shot sim-to-real transfer on physical hardware.

Abstract: Dormant tree pruning is labor-intensive yet essential for maintaining modern high-productivity fruit orchards. In this work, we focus on pruning of modern planar tree training systems - V-Trellis apples and UFO cherries - where trunks and primary branches are trained into approximately planar walls. We introduce an end-to-end pipeline to learn a closed-loop visuomotor controller for robotic pruning. This controller is trained entirely using simulation and synthetically generated data and deployed in real orchards in a zero-shot manner. The pipeline comprises synthetic generation of planar orchard tree meshes, construction of a physics-based orchard simulator, automated collection of successful pruning trajectories via motion planning, and policy learning with a novel hybrid reinforcement-learning algorithm that combines offline demonstrations with online simulated rollouts. The controller uses optical-flow inputs from a wrist-mounted camera - avoiding the need for full 3D-reconstruction - and continuously guides the cutter through cluttered branch environments to a specified cutpoint with correct tool orientation. In exhaustive simulated task-space evaluations over 3,000 pruning points, the policy attains 49.9% success on V-Trellis apples and 46.0% on UFO cherries. We validate the learned controller across 38 physical trials - comprising 28 outdoor field trials in commercial and experimental orchards and 10 indoor laboratory tests - demonstrating zero-shot sim-to-real transfer. The learned policy also outperforms a classical RRT-Connect baseline on physical hardware in laboratory trials.

摘要（中文）：休眠期果树修剪劳动强度大，但对于维持现代高产出果园至关重要。本研究聚焦于现代平面化树形栽培系统的修剪——包括V型棚架苹果和UFO樱桃——其中主干和主枝被培育成近似平面的树墙结构。我们提出了一种端到端流程，用于学习机器人修剪的闭环视觉运动控制器。该控制器完全在仿真环境和合成数据中训练，并以零样本方式部署于真实果园。该流程包括：平面果树网格的合成生成、基于物理的果园模拟器构建、通过运动规划自动采集成功修剪轨迹，以及采用一种将离线演示与在线模拟 rollout 相结合的新型混合强化学习算法进行策略学习。控制器利用腕部相机捕获的光流输入——无需完整的三维重建——即可在杂乱的分支环境中持续引导刀具到达指定切割点，并保持正确的工具姿态。在超过3000个修剪点的详尽模拟任务空间评估中，该策略在V型棚架苹果上达到49.9%的成功率，在UFO樱桃上达到46.0%。我们通过38次实际物理试验验证了所学控制器——包括在商业和试验果园中进行的28次户外田间试验以及10次室内实验室测试——证明了零样本从仿真到现实的迁移能力。在实验室试验中，所学策略在物理硬件上的表现也优于经典的RRT-Connect基线方法。

Authors: Abhinav Jain, Cindy Grimm, Stefan Lee

DualWAM: Dual-System World Action Models for Asynchronous Global Planning and Local Refinement VLA

World Action Model dual-system asynchronous planning manipulation denoising

简要说明：本文提出 DualWAM，一种双系统世界动作模型，将全局规划与局部细化解耦，实现异步高频机器人控制，降低计算成本并提高操作成功率。

TLDR: This paper proposes DualWAM, a dual-system World Action Model that decouples global planning from local refinement to enable asynchronous, high-frequency robot control with lower computational cost and improved manipulation success.

Abstract: World Action Models (WAMs) jointly generate robot actions and predict future world states, transferring priors from video pretraining to robot control. However, future visual prediction is computationally expensive, so existing WAMs often rely on long action chunks to amortize inference cost across control steps, at the cost of closed-loop responsiveness. We present \method, a dual-system WAM that preserves broader-horizon world-action generation while enabling high-frequency closed-loop action updates by decoupling global planning and local refinement. \systwo periodically performs high-noise bidirectional denoising over a broader world-action chunk to establish a global plan, while wrist-only \sysone extracts a temporally aligned short window from the intermediate denoising state and completes low-noise refinement using the latest wrist observations, which provide action-aligned cues about local geometry, motion, and contact during interaction. The two systems operate asynchronously along a shared denoising trajectory: each global plan is reused across multiple local updates, while \sysone repeatedly incorporates fresh interaction feedback. Across zero-shot manipulation tasks on Franka and Galbot, \method improves success over the strongest evaluated baseline by 4.5 percentage points on average, while achieving a 16.6$\times$ critical-path speedup. Further studies show that role-matched egocentric and UMI data improve success by 14 percentage points, and that the decoupled design naturally supports edge--cloud deployment with substantially lower communication overhead than the baseline.

摘要（中文）：世界动作模型（WAMs）联合生成机器人动作并预测未来世界状态，将视频预训练中的先验知识迁移至机器人控制。然而，未来视觉预测的计算成本较高，因此现有WAMs往往依赖长动作块来分摊跨控制步骤的推理成本，但代价是闭环响应能力的下降。我们提出\method，一种双系统WAM，通过解耦全局规划与局部精化，在保持更广视野的世界动作生成能力的同时，支持高频闭环动作更新。\systwo周期性地在更广的世界动作块上执行高噪声双向去噪以建立全局规划，而仅依赖腕部观测的\sysone从中间去噪状态中提取时间对齐的短窗口，并利用最新腕部观测完成低噪声精化——腕部观测提供了交互过程中与动作对齐的局部几何、运动及接触线索。两个系统沿共享去噪轨迹异步运行：每个全局规划在多次局部更新中被复用，同时\sysone反复引入新鲜的交互反馈。在Franka和Galbot上的零样本操作任务中，\method相较于最强基线平均成功率提升4.5个百分点，同时实现16.6$\times$的关键路径加速。进一步研究表明，角色匹配的自我中心视角与UMI数据可将成功率提升14个百分点，且该解耦设计天然支持边缘-云部署，其通信开销相比基线显著降低。

Authors: Yixin Zheng, Jiangran Lyu, Yuntian Deng, Kai Liu, Yizhou Zhou, Yizhou Wang, Xiaoguang Zhao, He Wang, Zhizheng Zhang

SE(3) Neural Potential Fields for 6-DoF Trajectory Planning Directly from Images Without Explicit 3D Reconstruction Manipulation

SE(3) neural potential field trajectory planning 6-DoF grasping image-based collision-free

简要说明：本文提出一种直接从带位姿的RGB图像学习的SE(3)神经势场，并通过导航函数（到抓取点的测地距离）进行监督，实现无需显式3D重建的6自由度无碰撞轨迹规划，并在真实UR10机器人上展示了稳健的抓取性能。

TLDR: This paper introduces an SE(3) neural potential field learned directly from posed RGB images, supervised by a navigation function (geodesic distance to the grasp) to achieve 6-DoF collision-free trajectory planning for grasping without explicit 3D reconstruction, demonstrating robust grasping on a real UR10 robot.

Abstract: Reaching a 6-DoF grasp pose in clutter requires a collision-free trajectory, conventionally obtained by reconstructing the scene in 3D and planning inside that reconstruction, at the cost of its accuracy and compute. Potential fields learned directly from images remove that dependency but inherit the classical weakness of artificial potential fields: where attractive and repulsive gradients cancel, the descent grazes the obstacle instead of going around it, and can stall short of the goal. We present an SE(3) neural potential field learned from posed RGB images and supervised with a navigation function, the geodesic distance to the grasp through free space recovered from those same images during training, which removes both failures. On two tabletop scenes, from obstacle-blocked starts executed on a UR10, the field converges within 3 cm of the grasp from every start and every path it executes is collision-free against the ground-truth geometry, against 25% and 0% under image supervision alone; mean clearance rises from under a centimeter to 8.6-8.8 cm and arm-link contacts fall from 20.6-50.4% to 2.7-5.5% of executed configurations. Executed grasp success is 90.0% and 40.0% on the two scenes, the residual failures being refusals of the Cartesian executor rather than of the field. Planning takes about 2 s against 67-133 s for RRT* on a reconstruction of the same images, though under a common offline harness the two are comparable: the deployed margin is the cost of collision-checking a dense reconstruction, not planner complexity.

摘要（中文）：在杂乱环境中达成6自由度抓取姿态需要一条无碰撞轨迹，传统方法通常通过对场景进行三维重建并在该重建模型中规划来获得，但这是以重建精度和计算开销为代价的。直接从图像学习势场可以消除这一依赖，却继承了人工势场的经典缺陷：当吸引梯度和排斥梯度相互抵消时，梯度下降轨迹会擦过障碍物而非绕行，并可能在到达目标前停滞。我们提出一种SE(3)神经势场，从带姿态的RGB图像中学习，并以导航函数——即训练期间从同一图像中恢复的自由空间中到抓取点的测地距离——作为监督信号，从而同时消除上述两类失败。在两个桌面场景中，从障碍物阻挡的起始点出发，在UR10机器人上执行，该势场从每个起始点都能收敛到距抓取点3厘米以内，且每条执行路径均相对真实几何无碰撞，而仅使用图像监督时的无碰撞比例分别为25%和0%；平均间隙从不足1厘米提升至8.6-8.8厘米，机械臂连杆接触占比从执行构型的20.6-50.4%降至2.7-5.5%。两个场景中执行的抓取成功率为90.0%和40.0%，残余失败源于笛卡尔执行器的拒绝而非势场本身。规划时间约为2秒，而基于同一图像的稠密重建使用RRT*算法需要67-133秒；不过，在共同的离线测试框架下两者相当：实际部署中的额外开销来自稠密重建的碰撞检测成本，而非规划器复杂度。

Authors: Jeffrey Eiyike, Masoud Ataei, Elvis Gyaase, Vikas Dhiman

PredActor: Predictive Action Diffusion for Steerable Onboard Humanoid Control HumanoidEmbodied

diffusion policy humanoid control classifier-free guidance classifier guidance onboard deployment

简要说明：PredActor 是一种预测性动作扩散策略，联合生成可执行动作和内部未来状态轨迹，用于人形机器人控制，支持文本条件行为、测试时引导以及 Unitree G1 的机载部署。

TLDR: PredActor is a predictive action diffusion policy that jointly generates executable actions and an internal future-state trajectory for humanoid control, enabling text-conditioned behavior, test-time steering, and onboard deployment on a Unitree G1.

Abstract: Diffusion models offer flexible motion generation, but translating this flexibility into feedback-responsive humanoid control remains challenging. Hierarchical systems steer motion through references that may exceed a separate tracker's capabilities, leaving recovery and physical execution largely to the tracker. Action-only diffusion generates actions directly but lacks an explicit future-state trajectory for test-time motion objectives. Joint state-action diffusion provides this representation, yet representative controllers often depend on privileged full-body states, and support for learned behavior selection and test-time motion steering remains fragmented. We present PredActor, a predictive action diffusion policy that brings these complementary steering capabilities into one directly executed policy using proprioceptive observations. Conditioned on proprioceptive history and optional task context, PredActor jointly generates executable actions and an internal future-state trajectory. Classifier-free guidance strengthens text-conditioned behavior, while classifier guidance steers predicted states toward test-time objectives. Only actions are executed, without a separate motion-reference tracker or externally estimated full-body states as policy inputs. In simulation, PredActor reaches all 15 destination targets and achieves a text retrieval score of 0.580, compared with 0.373 for conditional action diffusion, with similar observed disturbance survival. To make this guided policy practical onboard, rolling denoising and computation-preserving runtime optimizations reduce the complete callback to 16.790 ms median and 19.383 ms p95 on a Jetson Orin NX, both below the 20 ms control period. We deploy PredActor on a Unitree G1; evaluations across simulation and physical hardware demonstrate text-conditioned motion, disturbance response, joystick control, and semantic interpolation.

摘要（中文）：扩散模型提供了灵活的运动生成能力，但将这种灵活性转化为具有反馈响应的人形机器人控制仍具挑战性。分层系统通过可能超出独立跟踪器能力的参考信号来引导运动，将恢复与物理执行在很大程度上交由跟踪器完成。仅动作扩散直接生成动作，但缺乏用于测试时运动目标的显式未来状态轨迹。状态-动作联合扩散提供了这一表示，然而代表性控制器往往依赖特权全身状态，且对学习行为选择与测试时运动引导的支持仍较为零散。我们提出PredActor，一种预测性动作扩散策略，利用本体感觉观测将上述互补的引导能力整合到单一直接执行策略中。以本体感觉历史及可选任务上下文为条件，PredActor联合生成可执行动作和内部未来状态轨迹。无分类器引导增强了文本条件行为，而分类器引导则将预测状态导向测试时目标。仅执行动作，无需单独的运动参考跟踪器或外部估计的全身状态作为策略输入。在仿真中，PredActor到达全部15个目标位置，文本检索得分为0.580，而条件动作扩散为0.373，且观测扰动下的生存率相当。为使该引导策略能够在机载运行，滚动去噪与保留计算量的运行时优化将完整回调缩短至中位数16.790 ms、95百分位19.383 ms（基于Jetson Orin NX），均低于20 ms控制周期。我们在宇树G1上部署了PredActor；仿真与物理硬件上的评估表明其支持文本条件运动、扰动响应、摇杆控制及语义插值。

Authors: Lei Ye, Haibo Gao, Yitang Li, Peng Xu, Zetong Jing, Junhan Sun, Fanrong Dong, Ziqi Han, Xue Wang, Jianhua Sun, Cewu Lu, Hao Zhao, Liang Ding

Uranus: Building the Next-Generation Simulation Infrastructure for Embodied AI WorldModel

data-driven simulator diffusion model joint-trajectory-conditioned autoregressive rollout multi-view generation

简要说明：Uranus 提出了一种面向具身智能的数据驱动仿真基础设施，利用关节轨迹条件自回归扩散模型实时生成多视角视频，用于机器人策略训练与评估。

TLDR: Uranus presents a data-driven simulation infrastructure for embodied AI, using a joint-trajectory-conditioned autoregressive diffusion model to generate real-time, multi-view video rollouts for robot policy training and evaluation.

Abstract: Scalable simulation is essential for robot data generation, policy training, evaluation, and safe iteration, yet real-world interaction is costly and conventional simulators require labor-intensive construction. We present Uranus, a data-driven robot simulator built around a joint-trajectory-conditioned autoregressive diffusion model. Uranus offers three key capabilities: (1) streaming, open-ended rollout, which receives future joint-position trajectories online and autoregressively generates one latent frame per step, corresponding to four RGB frames, without a fixed horizon; (2) low-latency generation, achieving 24 FPS after inference optimization; and (3) scalable, extensible robot control, providing a unified interface for synchronized multi-view generation across diverse robot embodiments and camera configurations. We conduct comprehensive quantitative and qualitative evaluations on both in-distribution and out-of-distribution data, providing an objective assessment of Uranus and clearly identifying its current limitations. We release the code and model weights to empower the community with practical tools and insights.

摘要（中文）：可扩展的仿真对于机器人数据生成、策略训练、评估及安全迭代至关重要，然而现实世界的交互成本高昂，且传统模拟器需要大量人工构建。我们提出了Uranus，一种基于关节轨迹条件自回归扩散模型的数据驱动机器人模拟器。Uranus提供三项关键能力：（1）流式、开放式展开，在线接收未来关节位置轨迹，并自回归地逐步生成一个潜在帧，对应四个RGB帧，且不受固定视野限制；（2）低延迟生成，经推理优化后实现24 FPS；（3）可扩展、可扩展的机器人控制，为不同机器人形态和相机配置提供统一的多视角同步生成接口。我们在分布内和分布外数据上进行了全面的定量和定性评估，对Uranus进行了客观评价，并清晰指出了其当前局限。我们开源了代码和模型权重，旨在为社区提供实用工具和见解。

Authors: Wenkang Qin, Yukun Zhou, Noah Shen, Jisong Cai, Dongxiao Mao, Baicheng Li, Yue Zhang, Wei Sui

H2RBench: A Real-to-Sim Benchmark for Evaluating Human-to-Robot Transfer Manipulation

human-to-robot transfer Real2Sim benchmark manipulation policies sim-to-real correlation embodiment gap

简要说明：H2RBench是一个用于标准化人机迁移方法评估的Real2Sim基准，提供包含真实人类视频和模拟机器人演示的协议，涵盖四个操作任务，并显示模拟性能与真实世界成功率强相关。

TLDR: H2RBench is a Real2Sim benchmark for standardizing evaluation of human-to-robot transfer methods, providing a protocol with real human videos and simulated robot demonstrations across four manipulation tasks, and showing that simulation performance correlates strongly with real-world success.

Abstract: Learning robot manipulation policies from human video demonstrations constitutes a promising avenue for scalable robot learning. However, comparing different human-to-robot (H2R) transfer methods remains challenging, as existing approaches are evaluated under different settings, including differing task suites, scene layouts, object instances, and amounts of robot supervision. To address this challenge, we present H2RBench, a Real2Sim benchmark for evaluating H2R transfer methods. H2RBench provides a standardized protocol built on real human video demonstrations and simulated robot demonstrations, and includes four manipulation tasks spanning diverse interaction requirements. We evaluate multiple representative H2R transfer methods, each adopting a different strategy for bridging the embodiment gap. Using H2RBench, we systematically characterize how each method scales with the amount of human demonstrations, revealing that methods differ substantially in their ability to leverage additional human data. We further show that simulation performance is broadly predictive of real-world robot performance, with an overall Pearson correlation of r = 0.89, Spearman correlation of \r{ho} = 0.85 and Mean Maximum Rank Violation (MMRV) of 0.06 across method-task configurations. These results establish H2RBench as a practical and scalable benchmark for comparative H2R evaluation prior to real-world deployment.

摘要（中文）：从人类视频演示中学习机器人操作策略，为可扩展的机器人学习提供了一条极具前景的途径。然而，不同的人到机器人（H2R）迁移方法之间的比较仍然面临挑战，因为现有方法在不同的设置下进行评估，包括不同的任务套件、场景布局、物体实例以及机器人监督的数量。为了应对这一挑战，我们提出了H2RBench，一个用于评估H2R迁移方法的Real2Sim基准。H2RBench提供了一个基于真实人类视频演示和模拟机器人演示的标准化协议，并包含四个涵盖多样化交互需求的操作任务。我们评估了多种具有代表性的H2R迁移方法，每种方法都采用了不同的策略来弥合具身差异。利用H2RBench，我们系统地刻画了每种方法随人类演示数量增加而扩展的表现，揭示了不同方法在利用额外人类数据方面的能力存在显著差异。我们进一步表明，模拟性能在很大程度上能够预测真实世界机器人的表现，跨方法-任务配置的整体皮尔逊相关系数为r = 0.89，斯皮尔曼相关系数为ρ = 0.85，平均最大秩违反（MMRV）为0.06。这些结果确立了H2RBench作为在实际部署前进行对比性H2R评估的实用且可扩展的基准。

Authors: Chuyang Xiao, Haotian Zhan, Sriram Krishna, Peilin Meng, Muhammad Zubair Irshad, Sergey Zakharov, David Held

D-JEPA: A Decision-Aligned Latent World Model WorldModel

latent world model decision alignment action selection manipulation autonomous driving

简要说明：D-JEPA提出了一种决策对齐的潜在世界模型，通过序数结果比较细化预测潜在几何，在潜在控制、操作和自动驾驶中提升了动作选择。

TLDR: D-JEPA introduces a decision-aligned latent world model that refines predictive latent geometry using ordinal outcome comparisons, improving action selection across latent control, manipulation, and autonomous driving.

Abstract: Latent world models predict the consequences of actions, but accurate prediction does not guarantee that latent distance reflects which candidate will execute successfully. We identify a decision-local prediction gap: among the few futures competing for execution, a candidate predicted closer to the goal can produce a worse realized outcome than an available alternative. We introduce D-JEPA, a decision-aligned latent world model that learns decision-relevant relations among candidate futures from executed outcomes. A bounded, permutation-equivariant operator jointly reasons over goal-relative predictive features and ordinal evidence, refining pretrained predictive geometry where action choices are most consequential. Restricted predictor adaptation and a shared ordinal interface extend this alignment across complementary predictive geometries. D-JEPA further realizes the learned decision structure in JEPA-compatible future representations, enabling deployment through native latent-distance planning. Evaluations across latent control, manipulation, pretrained action-producing models, physical robots and autonomous driving demonstrate improved action selection, including 87.89% success on PushT, a 15.04-point average gain on RoboTwin, and a 17-point gain on physical robot tasks. These results establish decision-relevant relational structure as a direct bridge between predictive world modeling and effective control.

摘要（中文）：潜在世界模型预测行动的结果，但准确的预测并不保证潜在距离能反映哪个候选行动将成功执行。我们识别出一个决策局部的预测差距：在少数竞争执行的未来情景中，预测距离目标更近的候选者可能比可用的替代方案产生更差的实际结果。我们提出D-JEPA，一种决策对齐的潜在世界模型，从执行结果中学习候选未来之间的决策相关关系。一个有界的、排列等变的算子联合推理目标相对预测特征和序数证据，在行动选择最具后果性的地方细化预训练的预测几何。受限预测器适应和共享序数接口将这种对齐扩展到互补的预测几何。D-JEPA进一步在JEPA兼容的未来表示中实现学习到的决策结构，使通过原生潜在距离规划进行部署成为可能。在潜在控制、操作、预训练行动生成模型、物理机器人和自动驾驶中的评估展示了改进的行动选择，包括在PushT上87.89%的成功率，在RoboTwin上平均提升15.04个百分点，以及在物理机器人任务上提升17个百分点。这些结果确立了决策相关的关系结构作为预测世界建模与有效控制之间的直接桥梁。

Authors: Shuaijun Liu, Chengyu Wu, Qifu Wen, Feiyang You, Chenglong Zhang, Shuyang Hao, Xi Lin, Ningxin Su

Beyond Visual Quality: A Study of Test-Time Planning with World Action Models WorldModel

test-time planning world action models action selection imagined futures counterfactual branching

简要说明：本文实证研究了世界动作模型（WAM）的测试时规划，发现尽管采样动作提供了选择机会，但基于视觉质量等线索的选择器只能恢复较少的潜在改进，强调应以决策效用而非视觉质量来评估WAM。

TLDR: This paper empirically studies test-time planning with world action models (WAMs), showing that while sampled actions offer selection opportunities, current selectors based on visual quality or other cues recover little of the potential improvement, highlighting the need to evaluate WAMs by decision-making utility.

Abstract: World action models generate actions together with visual predictions of their consequences. These paired outputs create the potential for planning by sampling multiple actions from one state, comparing their imagined outcomes, and choosing the action with the most promising predicted outcome. However, how to use imagined futures to guide action selection remains unclear. We examine this planning potential empirically. First, we estimate an oracle upper bound on selection by choosing the sampled candidate whose realised outcome is best. In a controlled same-state analysis, this choice raises success from 68.9% under uniform random selection to 79.2%. We then test selectors based on visual quality, physical consistency, and task progression as controlled interventions. Some tested selectors yield higher observed success, but the gains are uneven and the matched selectors leave much of the measured opportunity unrecovered. To investigate this gap, we examine whether sampled actions lead to different outcomes, whether these differences are visible in the predictions, and whether a score recognises them. Counterfactual branching from the same states shows that selection opportunity is concentrated in relatively few decisions in the initial candidate sets. Action spread and outcome coverage need not increase together. In a further evaluation across trajectory phases with complete action execution, the tested scores again recover little of the available improvement despite a small gain from learned value. These findings distinguish producing consequential action choices from recognising them in generated futures, motivating the evaluation of WAM predictions through their usefulness for decisions rather than visual quality alone.

摘要（中文）：世界动作模型在生成动作的同时，也会对其后果进行视觉预测。这种成对输出为规划提供了潜在可能，即从同一状态中采样多个动作，比较其想象的结果，并选择预测结果最有前景的动作。然而，如何利用想象出的未来情景来指导动作选择仍不明确。我们对此规划潜力进行了实证研究。首先，我们通过选择采样候选中实际结果最优者，估计了选择的上限（即“神谕”上界）。在受控的同状态分析中，这一选择将成功率从均匀随机选择下的68.9%提升至79.2%。随后，我们测试了基于视觉质量、物理一致性和任务进展的选择器，作为受控干预。部分测试的选择器确实带来了更高的实际成功率，但提升幅度不均，且匹配的选择器未能完全收回已测得的潜在收益。为探究这一差距，我们考察了采样动作是否会导致不同结果、这些差异是否在预测中可见，以及评分是否能够识别这些差异。来自相同状态的反事实分支表明，选择机会主要集中在初始候选集中的少数决策上。动作的分散程度与结果的覆盖率并不必然同步增长。在另一项涵盖完整动作执行的轨迹阶段评估中，尽管学习到的价值带来了小幅提升，但测试评分仍仅恢复了少量可用改进。这些发现区分了“生成具有后果的动作选择”与“在生成的未来情景中识别这些选择”之间的差异，从而促使我们以WAM预测对决策的有用性（而非仅凭视觉质量）来评估其价值。

Authors: Jianhao Yuan, Yu Yuan, Benjamin Ramtoula, Lukas Vierling, Paul Newman, Lars Kunze, Philip Torr, Daniele De Martini

Touch2Robot: Robot Touch in the Human Demonstration Loop Manipulation

tactile sensing human demonstration robot contact retargeting dexterous manipulation Diffusion Policy

简要说明：Touch2Robot提出了一种框架，在人类遥操作过程中整合触觉数据与机器人特定接触可视化，从而提高收集真实机器人灵巧操作示范的效率与成功率。

TLDR: Touch2Robot introduces a framework that integrates human tactile data with robot-specific contact visualization during teleoperation, improving the efficiency and success rate of collecting dexterous manipulation demonstrations for real robots.

Abstract: Human demonstrations offer a scalable way to collect manipulation data, but their contacts may be unstable or infeasible when transferred to a robot hand. Collecting demonstrations directly on the target robot avoids this mismatch but substantially increases the cost of data collection. To address this trade-off, we present Touch2Robot, a framework that lets humans collect demonstrations while seeing how the target robot hand would contact the object. We capture human hand motion, tactile-glove measurements, and object motion during human manipulation. These recordings guide object-specific RL policies to reproduce the demonstrated object motion while favoring contacts consistent with the recorded human touch. We distill the learned behaviors into a unified real-time retargeter that maps incoming human observations and object geometry to robot hand configurations. During collection, the predicted robot configuration is synchronized with the tracked object pose in simulation to reconstruct robot-object contacts, which are visualized to help the demonstrator adapt subsequent interactions to the target hand. Across four real-world tasks, Touch2Robot improves average real-robot replay completion from 37.9% to 72.1% over visual-only feedback, while reducing the collection time per replay-successful demonstration from 58.6s to 18.2s. Reconstructed target-hand contacts achieve 44.2% F1 against real-robot tactile measurements, and policies trained on Touch2Robot demonstrations improve downstream Diffusion Policy performance by 29.1 percentage points over visual-only feedback. These results show that bringing robot touch into the human demonstration loop improves both the quality and efficiency of scalable dexterous data collection. Project webpage: https://Touch2Robot.github.io/.

摘要（中文）：人类示范为采集操作数据提供了一种可扩展的途径，但其接触在迁移至机器手时可能不稳定或不可行。直接在目标机器人上采集示范可以避免这种不匹配，却会显著增加数据采集的成本。为平衡这一矛盾，我们提出了Touch2Robot框架，使人类能够在采集示范的同时，直观看到目标机器手将如何接触物体。我们采集人类操作过程中的人类手部运动、触觉手套测量数据以及物体运动信息。这些记录用于引导面向特定物体的强化学习策略，在复现所展示物体运动的同时，偏向于与记录的人类触觉一致的接触方式。我们将学习到的行为提炼为一个统一的实时重定向器，将输入的人类观测信息与物体几何映射为机器手配置。在采集过程中，预测的机器配置与仿真中跟踪的物体位姿同步，以重建机器-物体接触，并将该接触可视化，帮助示范者根据目标手调整后续交互。在四个真实世界任务中，Touch2Robot将平均真实机器人重放完成率从仅视觉反馈的37.9%提升至72.1%，同时将每次成功重放示范的采集时间从58.6秒缩短至18.2秒。重建的目标手接触与真实机器人触觉测量相比，F1分数达到44.2%，而基于Touch2Robot示范训练的策略在下游扩散策略任务上，相较于仅视觉反馈提升了29.1个百分点。这些结果表明，将机器人触觉引入人类示范循环，能够同时提升可扩展灵巧数据采集的质量与效率。项目网页：https://Touch2Robot.github.io/。

Authors: Shengcheng Luo, Xiaoyang Cheng, Hong Ying, Xiaoying Zhou, Jiaming Jiang, Haoran Guo, Wanlin Li, Ziyuan Jiao, Chenxi Xiao

From Semantic Decisions to Feasible Trajectories: Self-Evolving LLM-Guided Optimal Control for Narrow-Space Parking AutonomousDriving

Large Language Models Optimal Control Autonomous Parking Maneuver Planning Self-Evolution

简要说明：SE-LLM-OCP将LLM的高层机动规划与低层最优控制相结合，用于狭窄空间自主泊车，通过在线重规划和离线知识库自进化提升鲁棒性并跨平台迁移。

TLDR: SE-LLM-OCP combines LLM-based high-level maneuver planning with low-level optimal control for autonomous parking in narrow spaces, using online replanning and offline self-evolution of a knowledge base to improve robustness and transfer across platforms.

Abstract: Autonomous parking in nonconvex and narrow environments remains challenging. Although optimal-control methods can explicitly enforce vehicle dynamics and collision constraints, nonconvexity compromises solver robustness and can cause failures. Large language models (LLMs) exhibit strong semantic reasoning capabilities, but directly generating dense trajectories makes it difficult to guarantee physical feasibility. We introduce SE-LLM-OCP, a unified framework in which LLMs make high-level discrete maneuver decisions, while an optimal-control module enforces low-level vehicle dynamics and collision constraints. Online, the LLM proposes sparse maneuver plans, decomposing the parking task into a sequence of short-horizon trajectory-optimization problems. A low-level solver then sequentially solves optimal-control problems. If the solver fails, the LLM aggregates failure evidence from the solver and validation stages to guide replanning. Offline, SE-LLM-OCP automatically evolves a structured decision-making knowledge base from scratch, driven by accumulated online failures. We validate our proposed framework in simulation on a car-like vehicle model and on a differential-drive robot. Our experimental results show that SE-LLM-OCP enables safer autonomous parking in narrow scenarios and demonstrates transfer of the same maneuver representation to a different kinematic platform.

摘要（中文）：在非凸且狭窄的环境中进行自主泊车仍具挑战性。尽管最优控制方法能够显式满足车辆动力学与碰撞约束，但非凸性会削弱求解器的鲁棒性，并可能导致求解失败。大语言模型（LLM）展现出强大的语义推理能力，但直接生成稠密轨迹难以保证物理可行性。我们提出SE-LLM-OCP，一个统一框架，其中LLM负责高层离散机动决策，而最优控制模块则确保低层车辆动力学与碰撞约束的满足。在线运行时，LLM提出稀疏机动方案，将泊车任务分解为一系列短时域轨迹优化子问题；随后，低层求解器依次求解这些最优控制问题。若求解失败，LLM会汇总来自求解器及验证阶段的失败证据以指导重新规划。离线阶段，SE-LLM-OCP基于累积的在线失败经验，从零自动演化出一套结构化的决策知识库。我们在类车车辆模型及差速驱动机器人上进行了仿真验证。实验结果表明，SE-LLM-OCP能在狭窄场景中实现更安全的自主泊车，并展示出同一机动表示可迁移至不同运动学平台的能力。

Authors: Zhengbao Yao, Yuanfu Luo, Kehan Xue

Relationally Grounded Latent World Models for Autonomous Driving AutonomousDriving

latent world models scene graphs autonomous driving trajectory prediction nuScenes

简要说明：本文提出利用交通场景图作为特权语义监督来增强自动驾驶的潜在世界模型，在nuScenes上提高了轨迹预测精度并大幅降低碰撞率，推理时无需场景图。

TLDR: This paper proposes grounding latent world models for autonomous driving with traffic scene graphs as privileged semantic supervision, improving trajectory prediction and collision rates on nuScenes without requiring scene graphs at inference.

Abstract: Latent world models learn predictive representations for autonomous driving, but the relational semantics these states preserve often remain implicit. We investigate whether traffic scene graphs can serve as privileged semantic supervision for latent world representations. Building on LAW, we construct actor-centric scene graphs from nuScenes 3D annotations, encode their serialized relational structure using a frozen text embedding model, and align the visual latent representations with this semantic target during training. We remove the supervision branch at inference, so it requires neither scene graphs nor 3D annotations and adds no test-time computation. On nuScenes, our method reduces average trajectory L2 error from 0.661 to 0.622 (5.9%) and collision rate from 0.456 to 0.217 (52.4%) relative to our retrained LAW baseline. It also outperforms an unstructured caption-style semantic target, supporting the benefit of explicit relational structure for latent world-model representation learning.

摘要（中文）：潜在世界模型学习自动驾驶的预测性表征，但这些状态所保留的关系语义往往仍隐式存在。我们探究交通场景图能否作为潜在世界表征的优质语义监督。基于LAW，我们从nuScenes 3D标注构建以智能体为中心的场景图，利用冻结的文本嵌入模型编码其序列化的关系结构，并在训练期间将视觉潜在表征与该语义目标对齐。推理时不使用监督分支，因此该方法无需场景图或3D标注，且不增加测试时计算量。在nuScenes上，与重训练的LAW基线相比，我们的方法将平均轨迹L2误差从0.661降至0.622（降低5.9%），碰撞率从0.456降至0.217（降低52.4%）。该方法还优于非结构化的描述式语义目标，进一步印证了显式关系结构对潜在世界模型表征学习的益处。

简要说明：本文提出了DeCap，一种约束强化学习算法，将人形机器人全身平滑性解耦为上下半身约束组，在多样地形上降低上半身动作频率和加速度并提升稳定性。

TLDR: This paper introduces DeCap, a constrained reinforcement learning algorithm that decouples whole-body smoothness into upper- and lower-body constraint groups for humanoid locomotion, reducing upper-body action rate and acceleration while improving stability across diverse terrains.

Abstract: Embodied AI systems, particularly humanoid robots deployed in real world scenarios require whole-body control policies that are both task-responsive and physically smooth. However, smoothness is not uniform across the body: lower body must remain sufficiently reactive, while the upper body must be tightly regulated to preserve stability. Existing reinforcement learning approaches typically impose smoothness through auxiliary terms in the reward function, which compete with task objectives, treating the body as uniform and provide no direct control over the physical quantities responsible for smooth behavior. We introduce DeCap (Decoupled Constraint-aware policy), a constrained reinforcement learning algorithm that decouples whole-body smoothness into separate upper- and lower-body constraint groups, each formulates smoothness as explicit constraints on physical motion limits. To improve constraint satisfaction near feasibility boundaries, DeCap incorporates a bounded barrier penalty that activates proactively as limits are approached and remains bounded at the constraint limit. On real-world humanoid whole-body control task, DeCap reduces upper-body action rate by 2.50x and acceleration by 2.18x relative to reward-based smoothness policies, while also improving lower-body smoothness and reducing transient motion. We demonstrate that a fixed set of smoothness constraints transfers across diverse terrains, alleviating the need of extensive reward tuning.

摘要（中文）：具身人工智能系统，特别是部署在现实场景中的人形机器人，需要既对任务高度响应又具备物理平滑性的全身控制策略。然而，平滑性在身体各部分并非均匀一致：下半身必须保持足够的响应性，而上半身则需要严格调控以维持稳定性。现有的强化学习方法通常通过在奖励函数中添加辅助项来施加平滑性，这些辅助项与任务目标相互竞争，将身体视为均匀整体，且无法直接控制决定平滑行为的物理量。我们引入了DeCap（解耦约束感知策略），一种约束强化学习算法，将全身平滑性解耦为独立的上半身和下半身约束组，每组将平滑性表述为对物理运动极限的显式约束。为了提高可行边界附近的约束满足度，DeCap引入了有界障碍罚项，该罚项在接近极限时主动激活，并在约束极限处保持有界。在真实世界的人形机器人全身控制任务中，相较于基于奖励的平滑策略，DeCap将上半身动作率降低了2.50倍，加速度降低了2.18倍，同时改善了下半身平滑性并减少了瞬态运动。我们证明，一组固定的平滑性约束能够跨多种地形迁移，从而减轻了广泛调整奖励参数的需求。

Authors: Utsav Panchal, Denis Kleyko, Unal Artan, Amy Loutfi

MIRA: Real-Time Full-Duplex Human-Robot Interaction for Embodied Companions HumanoidEmbodied

full-duplex interaction co-speech motion generation streaming dialogue humanoid robot barge-in preemption

简要说明：MIRA是一个用于具身陪伴机器人的统一实时全双工交互框架，集成了流式对话、情感感知响应生成和可中断的协同语音动作合成，并已在人形机器人上部署。

TLDR: MIRA is a unified real-time full-duplex interaction framework for embodied companion robots, integrating streaming dialogue, affect-aware response generation, and interruptible co-speech motion synthesis via a prefix-conditioned diffusion model, deployed on a humanoid robot.

Abstract: % !TEX root = ../main.tex Real-time embodied companion interaction requires a robot to infer user intent from streaming speech, generate timely responses, and execute expressive, interruptible motions. Existing systems typically decouple dialogue orchestration from gesture synthesis, relying on offline motion generation from complete audio. This separation leaves open how a deployed robot can dynamically synchronize response content, prosodic timing, and physical safety under incremental inputs and uncertain turn boundaries. We present MIRA, a unified framework for real-time full-duplex embodied companion interaction. Given streaming user speech, dialogue history, and vocal affect, MIRA predicts both the response text and an explicit embodiment cue that routes the response to the appropriate physical behavior. Discrete social behaviors (\eg listening and greeting) are mapped to validated robot trajectories, while speaking responses are accompanied by streaming, generative co-speech motion. For co-speech motion generation, we propose ROSCO, a prefix-conditioned diffusion model for streaming audio-to-joint motion generation. We further design RHPC, an inference scheme that maintains a sufficiently long temporal context for motion prediction while bounding physical commitment to a short, interruptible prefix. At the interaction level, we design CORTEX, a dual-timescale interaction policy that combines low-latency barge-in preemption and streaming response generation with deliberative turn decisions, backed by a robot-side execution layer that enforces physical safety constraints during execution. MIRA is deployed on an Astribot S1 humanoid robot. Quantitative evaluations demonstrate competitive audio-motion alignment relative to state-of-the-art motion-generation baselines, while real-robot deployment measurements characterize streaming responsiveness and interruption handling.

摘要（中文）：% !TEX root = ../main.tex 实时具身伴侣交互要求机器人从流式语音中推断用户意图，生成及时响应，并执行富有表现力且可中断的动作。现有系统通常将对话编排与手势合成分离，依赖从完整音频进行的离线动作生成。这种分离导致部署后的机器人如何在增量输入和不确定的轮次边界下动态同步响应内容、韵律时序和物理安全性这一问题悬而未决。我们提出MIRA，一个用于实时全双工具身伴侣交互的统一框架。给定流式用户语音、对话历史和声音情感，MIRA同时预测响应文本和显式的具身线索，将该响应路由至适当的物理行为。离散的社交行为（例如倾听和问候）被映射到经过验证的机器人轨迹，而说话响应则伴随流式生成的共语动作。对于共语动作生成，我们提出ROSCO，一种用于流式音频到关节动作生成的前缀条件扩散模型。我们进一步设计RHPC，一种推理方案，在维持足够长的时序上下文用于动作预测的同时，将物理承诺限制在较短且可中断的前缀内。在交互层面，我们设计CORTEX，一种双时间尺度交互策略，结合低延迟抢占式打断和流式响应生成与深思熟虑的轮次决策，并由机器人侧执行层支持，在执行过程中强制物理安全约束。MIRA部署在Astribot S1人形机器人上。定量评估表明，相较于最先进的动作生成基线，其音频-动作对齐具有竞争力，而真实机器人部署测量则表征了流式响应能力和中断处理能力。

Authors: Lijian Lin, Ye Zhu, Fan Zhang, Yunfei Liu, Baofeng Li, Xianwen Zeng, Jianan Wang, Yu Li

Bridge3D: Enabling Vision-Language-Action Models to See and Act in 3D VLA

Vision-Language-Action models 3D geometry guidance implicit fusion explicit conditioning robotic manipulation

简要说明：Bridge3D通过隐式和显式的3D几何指导增强预训练的2D VLA模型，提升其在仿真和真实世界中的空间操作能力。

TLDR: Bridge3D enhances pre-trained 2D VLA models with implicit and explicit 3D geometry guidance, improving spatial manipulation in both simulation and real-world benchmarks.

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have demonstrated remarkable generalization in robotic manipulation via large-scale multimodal pretraining. However, VLA models are mainly trained on 2D-centric observations, which inherently constrains their capacity for precise spatial manipulation. Previous methods enhance 3D awareness by introducing implicit spatial priors, but still lack explicit geometry guidance. In this paper, we propose Bridge3D that integrates both implicit and explicit 3D geometry guidance into pre-trained 2D VLA models, enabling them to ''see'' and ''act'' in 3D. Bridge3D introduces two strategies: 1) Implicit Fusion, which enriches visual tokens with features from 3D foundation models to improve ''seeing'' in 3D; 2) Explicit Conditioning, which integrates action denoising with an explicit 3D semantic field to achieve ''acting'' in 3D. Furthermore, we utilize the proposed layer-wise linear probing to improve learning efficiency. Experiments show that Bridge3D achieves superior performance against state-of-the-art methods. On the RoboTwin 2.0 benchmark, Bridge3D exceeds $π_0$ by 14.0 percentage points, while in real-world experiments, it outperforms Spatial Forcing by 11.7 percentage points. These results demonstrate Bridge3D's strong capabilities in high-precision and spatial-sensitive manipulation tasks.

摘要（中文）：视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型通过大规模多模态预训练，在机器人操作任务中展现了卓越的泛化能力。然而，VLA模型主要基于二维中心化观测进行训练，这从根本上限制了其在精确空间操作中的能力。以往方法通过引入隐式空间先验来增强三维感知，但仍缺乏显式的几何引导。本文提出Bridge3D，将隐式和显式的三维几何引导同时融入预训练的二维VLA模型中，使其能够以三维方式“观察”和“行动”。Bridge3D引入了两种策略：1）隐式融合，利用三维基础模型提取的特征丰富视觉令牌，以增强三维“观察”能力；2）显式条件化，将动作去噪与显式三维语义场相结合，以实现三维“行动”能力。此外，我们利用所提出的分层线性探测方法来提高学习效率。实验表明，Bridge3D在性能上超越了现有最先进方法。在RoboTwin 2.0基准测试中，Bridge3D比π₀高出14.0个百分点；在真实世界实验中，其性能优于Spatial Forcing达11.7个百分点。这些结果充分展示了Bridge3D在高精度和空间敏感型操作任务中的强大能力。

Authors: Haoxuan Li, Sixu Yan, Lianghui Zhu, Xuanlai Tang, Shikang Wang, Xinggang Wang

InsertAnything: Generalizable Contact-Rich Precision Insertion from Simulation to Reality Manipulation

reinforcement learning sim-to-real peg-in-hole precision insertion force feedback

简要说明：本文提出了一种强化学习框架，用于接触丰富的精密插入任务，完全在仿真中训练并直接部署到真实机器人，无需微调，在ManipulationNet的插销孔基准上取得了满分成绩。

TLDR: This paper presents a reinforcement learning framework for contact-rich precision insertion that trains entirely in simulation and deploys directly to real robots without fine-tuning, achieving high success rates and a perfect score on ManipulationNet's peg-in-hole benchmark.

Abstract: Contact-rich precision insertion is a key manipulation skill in robotic assembly. Tight clearances make insertion more sensitive to alignment errors and prone to collisions and jamming, while variations in geometry and clearance across parts further complicate policy reuse. We present a reinforcement learning framework that trains insertion policies entirely in simulation for direct deployment without real-world demonstrations or policy fine-tuning. By combining target poses with compact three-dimensional fingertip force feedback, the policy learns to search for alignment and correct its motion despite errors in the estimated hole position. A decoupled gated reward coordinates alignment and insertion. Force-signal smoothing and state-independent standard deviations stabilize the learning process. The resulting policies perform real-world insertion across multiple hole geometries with a minimum nominal clearance of 0.02 mm and improve success while reducing peak contact forces under hole-position errors. Cross-clearance and cross-geometry evaluations further confirm policy generalization. The system achieved the first perfect score of 20/20 on ManipulationNet's peg-in-hole benchmark under its Human-in-the-Loop protocol, with fully autonomous insertion motions. A single policy trained only on a simulated hexagonal insertion task achieved an overall success rate of 95.0% across eight unseen real-world insertion tasks. These results show that learning entirely in simulation can yield precision insertion skills that can be deployed directly and reused across real-world tasks. The project website (https://mzhsoul.github.io/InsertAnything/) provides open-source simulation and real-robot experiment scripts, assets, and trained checkpoints.

摘要（中文）：接触丰富的精密插入是机器人装配中的一项关键操作技能。紧凑的间隙使得插入过程对对齐误差更为敏感，容易发生碰撞和卡滞，而不同零件在几何形状和间隙上的差异进一步增加了策略复用的难度。我们提出了一种强化学习框架，该框架完全在仿真中训练插入策略，无需真实世界演示或策略微调即可直接部署。通过将目标位姿与紧凑的三维指尖力反馈相结合，策略能够在估计的孔位存在误差的情况下，学习搜索对齐并纠正自身运动。一种解耦的门控奖励机制协调了对齐与插入两个阶段。力信号平滑处理及与状态无关的标准差设置稳定了学习过程。由此得到的策略能够在最小标称间隙为0.02毫米的多种孔几何形状下完成真实世界插入任务，并在孔位误差条件下提高成功率、降低峰值接触力。跨间隙与跨几何形状的评估进一步验证了策略的泛化能力。该系统在ManipulationNet的插轴入孔基准测试中，依据其“人在回路”协议，首次取得了20/20的满分成绩，且插入动作完全自主完成。仅基于仿真六边形插入任务训练出的单一策略，在八个未见过的真实世界插入任务中实现了95.0%的总体成功率。这些结果表明，完全在仿真中学习能够获得可直接部署并跨真实世界任务复用的精密插入技能。项目网站（https://mzhsoul.github.io/InsertAnything/）提供了开源的仿真及真实机器人实验脚本、资产和训练好的检查点。
