Authors: Zhenghua Ma, Xinpan Meng, Zeyu Liu, Muyuan Ma, Hengdi Zhang, Houcheng Li, Long Cheng

TACIT: Tactile Contact Supervision for Spatial Attention in Dexterous Manipulation Manipulation

Tactile sensing Spatial attention Diffusion policy Dexterous manipulation Few-shot learning

简要说明：TACIT 利用遥操作演示中的触觉接触信息监督空间注意力，提升少样本灵巧操作的鲁棒性，无需额外的人工标注。

TLDR: TACIT uses tactile contact measurements from teleoperated demonstrations to supervise spatial attention in visuomotor diffusion policies, improving few-shot dexterous manipulation robustness without manual point annotation.

Abstract: Visuomotor policies trained from a few demonstrations may reproduce demonstrated trajectories without reliably following changes in object position. Existing approaches with explicit attention typically obtain spatial priors from human annotation or visual models. We introduce TACIT (tactile contact informs attention), which uses measured tactile contacts from teleoperated demonstrations to supervise spatial attention without additional point annotation. Gaussian targets over preceding camera point clouds supervise an attention head whose pooled output conditions a visuotactile diffusion policy. Targets are used only during training; tactile observations remain inputs at inference. In the primary real-robot benchmark, with ten demonstrations per task and five demonstrated placement regions, TACIT achieves 66.7% success on ball placement and 73.3% on peg insertion, compared with 10.0% and 20.0% for input-matched 3D visuotactile fusion and 20.0% and 43.3% for vision-only DP3. TACIT enters the 150 mm palm-to-object approach region within 12 seconds in all 30 trials per task; all remaining failures occur after arrival. Across three training seeds on real ball and simulated peg, TACIT outperforms input-matched fusion and an architecture-matched control without explicit attention supervision, supporting the contribution of supervision beyond branch capacity. Pre-contact and contact-time supervision show no consistent ordering. These results demonstrate that measured tactile contact provides effective spatial supervision for approach behavior from few demonstrations within the evaluated workspace.

摘要（中文）：基于少量演示训练的视觉运动策略可以复现演示轨迹，但难以可靠地跟踪物体位置的变化。现有方法中，显式注意力机制通常依赖人工标注或视觉模型来获取空间先验。我们提出TACIT（触觉接触引导注意力），该方法利用遥操作演示中实测的触觉接触信号来监督空间注意力，无需额外的点标注。先前相机点云上的高斯目标用于监督注意力头，其池化输出作为视觉-触觉扩散策略的条件输入。目标仅在训练阶段使用；触觉观测在推理阶段仍作为输入。在主要的真实机器人基准测试中，每个任务使用十个演示和五个演示放置区域，TACIT在球放置任务上达到66.7%的成功率，在插销任务上达到73.3%，而输入匹配的三维视觉-触觉融合方法分别为10.0%和20.0%，仅视觉的DP3方法分别为20.0%和43.3%。TACIT在每个任务的30次试验中均在12秒内进入150毫米掌心到物体的接近区域；所有剩余失败均发生在到达之后。在真实球体和仿真插销的三种训练随机种子下，TACIT优于输入匹配的融合方法和无显式注意力监督的架构匹配对照组，表明该监督的贡献超越了分支容量本身。接触前监督与接触时刻监督之间未出现一致性的性能排序。这些结果表明，在评估的工作空间内，实测触觉接触可为少样本演示的接近行为提供有效的空间监督。

Authors: Yanhou Lai, Fucai Zhu, Ruiqiang Wang, Koichi Hashimoto

FoldQuantVLA: Native Low-Bit Quantization of Vision-Language-Action Models via Consistent Folding VLA

post-training quantization vision-language-action model low-bit inference TensorRT robot policy

简要说明：FoldQuantVLA 通过通道缩放、块哈达玛变换和动态每标记量化，在无需策略重训练的情况下实现视觉-语言-动作模型的 W4A4/W8A8 低比特推理，在 Ada GPU 和 Jetson AGX Orin 上加速并使机器人动作保真度保持。

TLDR: FoldQuantVLA post-training quantization framework accelerates Vision-Language-Action models by using consistent activation representation via channel scaling, block Hadamard transforms, and dynamic per-token quantization with W4A4/W8A8 mixed precision, achieving speedups on Ada GPUs and Jetson AGX Orin while preserving robot action fidelity.

Abstract: Low-bit vision-language-action inference must reduce observation-to-action latency while preserving robot behavior. We present FoldQuantVLA, a post-training quantization framework that carries a consistent activation representation through calibration, weight rounding, and native integer execution. It combines channel scaling and block Hadamard transforms with dynamic per-token quantization, without policy retraining. Custom TensorRT plugins execute projections in both the language backbone and iterative action expert with four-bit weights and activations (W4A4) on Ada GPUs and Jetson AGX Orin. Evaluation spans LIBERO, SimplerEnv, and two robot platforms. Across three GR00T checkpoints and $π_{0.5}$, W4A4 achieves $1.20$ to $1.33\times$ speedups over floating-point TensorRT on Orin and $1.25$ to $1.52\times$ on desktop. Retaining language attention-output and feed-forward down projections at eight bits (W8A8) improves held-out action fidelity on all four checkpoints. Across four real-robot tasks, this configuration raises observed GR00T N1.7 success from $80.0\%$ with uniform W4A4 to $92.5\%$ over 80 trials per configuration, with a measured additional Orin latency of 1 ms.

摘要（中文）：低比特视觉-语言-动作推理必须在降低观测到动作延迟的同时保持机器人行为质量。我们提出FoldQuantVLA，一种训练后量化框架，在标定、权重取整及原生整数执行过程中保持一致的激活表示。该框架结合通道缩放与块哈达玛变换，并采用动态逐令牌量化，无需策略重训练。自定义TensorRT插件在语言骨干网络和迭代动作专家模块中执行投影，在Ada GPU和Jetson AGX Orin上实现四比特权重与激活（W4A4）。评估覆盖LIBERO、SimplerEnv及两个机器人平台。在三个GR00T检查点和$π_{0.5}$上，W4A4在Orin上相较于浮点TensorRT实现了$1.20$至$1.33\times$的加速，在桌面端实现$1.25$至$1.52\times$的加速。将语言注意力输出和前馈下投影保持为八比特（W8A8）可在全部四个检查点上提升保留动作保真度。在四项真实机器人任务中，该配置将观测到的GR00T N1.7成功率从统一W4A4下的$80.0\%$提升至$92.5\%$（每种配置80次试验），且实测Orin端额外延迟仅为1毫秒。

Authors: Hung T. Ho, Khanh D. Nguyen, Quang D. Nguyen, Thanh Q. Duong, Ngan Le, Meng Guo, Vien A. Ngo, An T. Le

LIBERO-VPro: Benchmarking Closed-Loop Visual Robustness of Robotic Foundation Models VLA

robotic foundation models visual robustness closed-loop evaluation vision-language-action models world-action models

简要说明：本文提出了LIBERO-VPro基准，用于系统评估机器人基础模型在视觉扰动下的闭环鲁棒性，发现名义性能可能掩盖视觉基础与适应能力的不足。

TLDR: This paper introduces LIBERO-VPro, a benchmark for evaluating the closed-loop visual robustness of robotic foundation models under perturbations, revealing that strong nominal performance can mask weaknesses in visual grounding and adaptation.

Abstract: Robotic foundation models achieve impressive performance on standard manipulation benchmarks, yet these evaluations typically assume clean, timely, and consistent visual observations throughout execution. We introduce LIBERO-VPro, a benchmark for systematically evaluating the closed-loop visual robustness of robotic foundation models by perturbing the visual evidence available during execution. LIBERO-VPro covers four complementary dimensions, including Visual Evidence Degradation, Camera Staleness, Visual Source Consistency, and Task-Relevant Scene Variation, spanning 12 challenge categories, 96 experimental settings, and 3,296 task-condition cases. We evaluate three vision-language-action models and three world-action models over approximately 196,000 simulated episodes, complemented by 200 real-world rollouts on a Franka Research 3. Our results reveal that strong nominal performance can mask substantial weaknesses in visual grounding and adaptation. Models often remain successful despite severe object-level occlusion, yet degrade sharply when local interaction cues are disrupted or familiar spatial priors are violated. They are also highly sensitive to stale or missing observations and struggle when changed task preconditions require behavioral adaptation. Finally, VLAs and WAMs exhibit distinct robustness profiles, showing that visual robustness is multi-dimensional and architecture-dependent. LIBERO-VPro provides a systematic diagnostic framework for developing robotic foundation models that can more reliably ground and adapt their actions under challenging visual conditions.

摘要（中文）：机器人基础模型在标准操控基准测试中表现出色，然而这些评估通常假设执行过程中视觉观测是干净、及时且一致的。我们提出LIBERO-VPro，一个通过干扰执行过程中可获得的视觉证据来系统评估机器人基础模型闭环视觉鲁棒性的基准。LIBERO-VPro涵盖四个互补维度，包括视觉证据退化、相机陈旧性、视觉来源一致性和任务相关场景变化，横跨12个挑战类别、96种实验设置和3,296个任务条件案例。我们在约196,000个模拟回合中评估了三种视觉-语言-动作模型和三种世界-动作模型，并辅以在Franka Research 3上进行的200次真实世界部署实验。我们的结果表明，优异的标称性能可能掩盖视觉基础与适应能力方面的重大缺陷。模型在面对严重的物体级遮挡时往往仍能成功执行，但当局部交互线索被破坏或熟悉的空间先验被违背时，其性能会急剧下降。它们还对陈旧或缺失的观测高度敏感，并且在任务前提条件发生变化而需要行为适应时表现挣扎。最后，VLA和WAM展现出不同的鲁棒性特征，表明视觉鲁棒性是多维度的且依赖于架构设计。LIBERO-VPro为开发能够在挑战性视觉条件下更可靠地建立动作依据并调整行为的机器人基础模型提供了一个系统的诊断框架。

Authors: Huiqiong Li, Zhiting Mei, Anirudha Majumdar, Jingjing Chen, Yu-Gang Jiang, Bin Zhu

vla.simd: Efficient CPU Inference for Language-Conditioned Manipulation Manipulation

CPU inference SIMD language-conditioned manipulation ACT-based policy edge deployment

简要说明：vla.simd 是一个通过 SIMD 微内核加速语言条件操作策略的 CPU 推理引擎，并引入了基于 ACT 的 IMPACT 策略，支持在 Raspberry Pi 5 等边缘设备上实时 CPU 部署。

TLDR: vla.simd is a CPU inference engine that accelerates language-conditioned manipulation policies via SIMD micro-kernels and introduces IMPACT, an ACT-based policy with cached text representations, enabling real-time CPU deployment on edge devices like the Raspberry Pi 5.

Abstract: Deploying language-conditioned manipulation without a dedicated GPU requires efficient inference and action chunks that cover the delay between policy queries. We present vla.simd, a CPU inference engine that combines shared SIMD micro-kernels, reusable computation, and target-specific optimization. We relate query latency and execution horizon to action availability under lagged and time-aligned execution, distinguishing action supply from feedback frequency. Across six policies and four CPUs, vla.simd achieves approximately $1.4\times$ median speedup over compiled PyTorch references while preserving fp32 numerical fidelity. We also introduce IMPACT, an ACT-based policy with cached text representations and language-modulated visual features. IMPACT is the only language-conditioned policy in our evaluated set that supplies at least 30 actions/s on the Raspberry Pi 5: after a 90 s thermal soak, it supplies 33.5 actions/s in fp32 and 81.2 with int8. Separate GPU evaluations yield $76.4\%$ mean success across four LIBERO suites without robot pretraining; instruction-shuffling tests demonstrate selection among familiar goals. Trials with IMPACT on an SO-101 arm and SmolVLA on a UR10e with a Robotiq gripper demonstrate CPU deployment on two robot embodiments.

摘要（中文）：在无专用GPU的条件下部署语言条件操控任务，需要高效的推理能力和覆盖策略查询间隔的动作块。我们提出vla.simd，一个CPU推理引擎，结合了共享SIMD微内核、可复用计算以及针对特定目标的优化。我们将查询延迟和执行时间跨度与滞后及时间对齐执行下的动作可用性相关联，区分动作供给与反馈频率。在六种策略和四种CPU上，vla.simd相比编译后的PyTorch参考实现实现了约1.4倍的中位加速，同时保持了fp32数值精度。我们还引入了IMPACT，一种基于ACT的策略，具有缓存文本表示和语言调制视觉特征。在我们评估的策略集中，IMPACT是唯一能在树莓派5上提供至少每秒30个动作的语言条件策略：经过90秒热稳定后，在fp32下提供每秒33.5个动作，在int8下提供每秒81.2个动作。独立GPU评估显示，在未进行机器人预训练的情况下，四个LIBERO任务套件的平均成功率为76.4%；指令打乱测试表明其能在熟悉目标中进行选择。在SO-101机械臂上使用IMPACT以及在使用Robotiq夹爪的UR10e上使用SmolVLA的实验，展示了在两个机器人实体上的CPU部署。

Authors: Khanh D. Nguyen, Hoang M. Truong, An T. Le

A Topological Representation with Object-Path Graphs for Open-Vocabulary Instance Navigation VLN

object-path graph open-vocabulary topological navigation vision-language navigation semantic visual servoing

简要说明：本文提出了一种对象-路径图表示，将开放词汇语义推理与拓扑导航统一起来，无需稠密度量地图即可实现视觉语言导航。在HM3D和Replica基准上取得了竞争性性能，并通过真实机器人实验验证了其实用性。

TLDR: This paper proposes an object-path graph representation that unifies open-vocabulary semantic reasoning with topological navigation, enabling vision-language navigation without dense metric maps. The method achieves competitive performance on HM3D and Replica benchmarks and is validated in real-world robot experiments.

Abstract: Vision-language navigation requires embodied agents to navigate environments using natural language instructions and visual observations. Existing approaches typically decompose navigation into sequential language-guided decisions or rely on online exploration without prior environmental knowledge. Scene graph representations offer compact semantic memory but remain decoupled from downstream navigation, which still depends on dense metric maps. To close this gap, we propose an object--path graph that unifies open-vocabulary semantic reasoning with topological navigation. The proposed representation jointly supports semantic grounding, graph-based localization, and navigation within a single lightweight topological framework. Building on this graph, we introduce a navigation strategy that combines global path planning with local inter-node execution through lightweight node localization and semantic visual servoing, enabling navigation directly over the graph without dense metric reconstruction. Experiments on HM3D and Replica demonstrate competitive performance in open-vocabulary object grounding through the proposed hierarchical graph structure, while achieving effective navigation performance. Real-world robot experiments further validate the practicality of the proposed framework.

摘要（中文）：视觉-语言导航要求具身智能体利用自然语言指令和视觉观察在环境中进行导航。现有方法通常将导航任务分解为序列化的语言引导决策过程，或依赖缺乏环境先验知识的在线探索策略。场景图表示能够提供紧凑的语义记忆，但始终与下游导航任务相分离，后者仍依赖于稠密的度量地图。为弥合这一差距，我们提出了一种物体-路径图，将开放词汇语义推理与拓扑导航相统一。该表示在单一轻量级拓扑框架内同时支持语义定位、基于图的定位和导航功能。在此基础上，我们提出了一种导航策略，通过轻量级节点定位和语义视觉伺服，将全局路径规划与局部节点间执行相结合，从而无需稠密度量重建即可直接在图上完成导航。在HM3D和Replica数据集上的实验表明，所提出的层次化图结构在开放词汇物体定位任务中展现出具有竞争力的性能，同时实现了有效的导航效果。真实机器人实验进一步验证了所提框架的实用性。

Authors: Linwei Zheng, Daojie Peng, Bingtao Wang, Haoang Li, Jun Ma

StenoVLA-3D: 3D-Aware Reasoning VLA for Navigation Through Gastrointestinal Stenoses VLA

3D-aware VLA endoscopic navigation point-map fusion temporal state branch lesion reporting

简要说明：StenoVLA-3D 提出了一种用于内窥镜狭窄区域自主导航的 3D 感知 VLA 框架，将点图和时间状态分支集成到 Cosmos-Reason 2 骨干网络中，并在记录片段和物理模型上展示了强劲性能。

TLDR: StenoVLA-3D introduces a 3D-aware VLA framework for autonomous endoscopic navigation through stenoses, integrating point-maps and a temporal state branch into the Cosmos-Reason 2 backbone, and demonstrating strong performance on both recorded episodes and physical phantoms.

Abstract: Autonomous endoscopic navigation requires the policy model to predict actions from texture-poor monocular observations, make safe control decisions, and retain evidence of lesions after they leave the field of view. Existing vision-language-action (VLA) models primarily rely on visual appearance and short-term context, limiting geometric grounding and episode-level reporting. We introduce StenoVLA-3D, a 3D-aware VLA framework for navigating through stenotic regions. We integrate point-maps into the Cosmos-Reason 2 backbone through learned geometry-gated fusion, and also propose a temporal state branch to model traversal progress. Our reasoning-and-action backbone predicts grounded reasoning with actions, while dedicated heads estimate stenosis shape and generate the final lesion report. We further introduce EndoCausal, an episode-level dataset with lesion annotations, actions, and temporally grounded reasoning. On 40 held-out recorded test episodes, StenoVLA-3D reaches 95.2\% semantic accuracy and 83.4\% action accuracy. On the physical 3-DoF endoscope, it attains 88.9\% and 77.8\% task success in esophageal and colonic phantoms (36 trials each), substantially outperforming the evaluated baselines.

摘要（中文）：自主内窥镜导航要求策略模型能够从缺乏纹理的单目观测中预测动作，做出安全控制决策，并在病灶离开视野后保留其证据。现有的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型主要依赖视觉外观和短期上下文，限制了几何 grounding 和回合级报告能力。我们提出 StenoVLA-3D，一种面向狭窄区域导航的 3D 感知 VLA 框架。我们通过学习的几何门控融合将点图（point-maps）集成到 Cosmos-Reason 2 骨干网络中，并提出时间状态分支来建模穿越进度。我们的推理与动作骨干网络在预测动作的同时生成 grounded 推理，专用头部分别估计狭窄形态并生成最终病灶报告。我们进一步引入 EndoCausal，一个包含病灶标注、动作和时间 grounded 推理的回合级数据集。在 40 个留出的记录测试回合中，StenoVLA-3D 达到 95.2% 的语义准确率和 83.4% 的动作准确率。在物理 3 自由度内窥镜上，其在食管和结肠体模（各 36 次试验）中分别达到 88.9% 和 77.8% 的任务成功率，显著优于所评估的基线方法。

Authors: Tamima Tabassum, Yiming Huang, Tianchun Wu, Changjing Liu, Zhiqing Tang, Chikit Ng, Beilei Cui, Liangjing Shao, Jiewen Lai, Hongliang Ren

Object-Centric Conditioning for Visuomotor Flow Matching VLA

object-centric flow matching visuomotor policy robust manipulation spatial grounding

简要说明：SlotFlow 提出了一种面向视觉运动流匹配的以对象为中心的条件机制，通过分离语义和空间特征来增强在空间分布外偏移和视觉干扰下的鲁棒性，同时保持高效的推理。

TLDR: SlotFlow introduces an object-centric conditioning mechanism for visuomotor flow matching policies, decoupling semantic and spatial features to improve robustness under spatial OOD shifts and visual distractors while preserving efficient inference.

Abstract: Robot visuomotor policies are commonly formulated as autoregressive, diffusion-based, or more recently, flow matching models. Among them, Action-to-Action (A2A) flow matching improves inference efficiency by initializing generation from historical action priors rather than stochastic noise. However, stale historical motion patterns and entangled global visual representations can jointly reduce robustness under spatial out-of-distribution (OOD) shifts and visual distractors. In this work, we propose SlotFlow, an object-centric flow matching policy for robust visuomotor manipulation. SlotFlow decouples scene observations into semantic ("what") features and lightweight image-plane spatial ("where") cues to provide object-aware policy conditioning and current-state grounding. The semantic representation suppresses irrelevant background correlations, while the spatial cue improves adaptation to shifted object configurations. Extensive simulation and real-world experiments demonstrate improved robustness under visual distractors and severe spatial perturbations while preserving the low-step inference efficiency of A2A. Controlled initialization and perception ablations further identify object-centric grounding as a major source of the gains and show that it complements, rather than replaces, useful historical motion priors.

摘要（中文）：机器人视觉运动策略通常被构建为自回归模型、基于扩散的模型，或近年来出现的流匹配模型。其中，动作到动作（A2A）流匹配通过从历史动作先验而非随机噪声出发进行生成初始化，提升了推理效率。然而，过时的历史运动模式与纠缠的全局视觉表征相结合，会在空间分布外（OOD）偏移和视觉干扰物存在时共同削弱策略的鲁棒性。在本工作中，我们提出了SlotFlow，一种以对象为中心的流匹配策略，用于鲁棒的视觉操作任务。SlotFlow将场景观测解耦为语义（“是什么”）特征和轻量级图像平面空间（“在哪里”）线索，从而提供对象感知的策略条件约束和当前状态锚定。语义表征抑制了无关背景相关性，而空间线索则增强了对偏移对象配置的适应能力。大量仿真和真实世界实验表明，该方法在视觉干扰物和严重空间扰动下具有更强的鲁棒性，同时保持了A2A的低步数推理效率。受控初始化实验和感知消融实验进一步表明，以对象为中心的锚定是性能提升的主要来源，并且它补充而非替代了有用的历史运动先验。

Authors: Jijie Li, Xu Yang, Junhong Zou, Chunhai Zhao, Chaoyang Zhao, Zhen Lei, Xiangyu Zhu

MimicAgent: Quadruped Skills via Prompt-to-Trajectory Generation Locomotion

prompt-to-trajectory generation quadruped locomotion example-guided RL LLM agent reference motion

简要说明：MimicAgent 是一个智能体框架，利用 LLM 编码智能体从自然语言提示生成四足机器人参考轨迹，并训练示例引导的强化学习策略，可在仿真和真实世界中部署。

TLDR: MimicAgent is an agentic framework that generates quadruped reference trajectories from natural language prompts using LLM coding agents, then trains example-guided RL policies for simulation and real-world deployment.

Abstract: We present MimicAgent, a prompt-to-trajectory generation framework for learning dynamic quadruped skills. Although reward shaping is extensively used when training quadruped policies, navigating the resulting reward landscape is notoriously difficult, requiring hours of "graduate student descent". Eureka attempts to automate reward design with LLMs, but we find that it struggles to generalize across diverse skills and morphologies. Our key observation is that it is far easier for a human - and by association, an LLM - to generate reference motions than to shape reward functions. Our hypothesis is motivated by the success of example-guided RL for humanoids, which exploits large-scale motion capture datasets as references for training locomotion policies. Unlike humanoids, quadrupeds lack such reference motion data. Towards this end, we propose MimicAgent, an agentic harness that, given a skill prompt, generates quadruped reference trajectories with coding agents. These coarse reference trajectories are then used to train example-guided RL policies that are deployable in simulation and in the real-world. Notably, we find that when prompting Claude Fable 5.1 within our agentic harness, 87% of prompts yield semantically aligned reference trajectories.

摘要（中文）：我们提出了MimicAgent，一种用于学习动态四足技能的提示到轨迹生成框架。尽管在训练四足策略时奖励塑形被广泛使用，但驾驭由此产生的奖励景观是出了名的困难，往往需要耗费数小时的“研究生式下降”来调参。Eureka尝试利用大语言模型实现奖励设计的自动化，但我们发现它在跨多种技能和形态的泛化方面存在困难。我们的关键观察是，对人类——以及同样对大语言模型——而言，生成参考动作远比塑形奖励函数容易。我们的假设受到人形机器人示例引导强化学习成功经验的启发，该方法利用大规模运动捕捉数据集作为训练运动策略的参考。与人形机器人不同，四足机器人缺乏此类参考运动数据。为此，我们提出MimicAgent，一个智能代理框架，根据给定的技能提示，通过编码代理生成四足参考轨迹。这些粗略的参考轨迹随后用于训练示例引导的强化学习策略，这些策略既可在仿真环境中部署，也可在现实世界中应用。值得注意的是，我们发现当在我们的智能框架中提示Claude Fable 5.1时，87%的提示能够生成语义对齐的参考轨迹。

Authors: Lucky Kant Nayak, Narayanan Palghat Parameswaran, Neehar Peri, Deva Ramanan

ActiveArena: Benchmarking and Understanding Active Perception in Robotic Manipulation VLA

active perception robotic manipulation benchmark vision-language-action OOD generalization

简要说明：提出了ActiveArena，一个包含35个主动感知操作任务的基准测试和模拟器，以及一套模块化VLA配置，用于分析记忆、本体感觉和规划对泛化的影响。

TLDR: Introduces ActiveArena, a benchmark and simulator with 35 tasks for active perception in robotic manipulation, plus a modular VLA suite analyzing memory, proprioception, and planning for OOD generalization.

Abstract: Active perception and manipulation are crucial for robots to interact with complex scenes. Existing benchmarks struggle to evaluate how robots effectively acquire and maintain information in memory in an active manner. To this end, we introduce ActiveArena-Sim, an active-perception simulator with controllable viewpoints and large-scale workspaces as the foundation. Built on this, we propose ActiveArena-Bench, which comprises 35 tasks across 5 fine-grained categories, covering visual exploration and interactive information acquisition. Each task is difficult to solve from passive observations alone, requiring multi-round evidence acquisition and memory-based reasoning. The benchmark provides rich memory annotations, standardized training data, and ID/OOD protocols featuring disjoint scenes, unseen distractor configurations, and novel backgrounds. Moreover, we present ActiveArena-VLA, a modular suite of 13 vision-language-action configurations for controlled studies of memory writing, memory capacity, proprioceptive state, subtask supervision, and high-level planning in active perception. Benchmark results reveal a substantial ID-OOD gap: uniform memory sampling, increased memory capacity under reliable write policies, proprioceptive inputs, and subtask supervision improve OOD generalization, while planner-guided memory management and decision-making achieve performance close to the best-performing configuration using only sparse memory. ActiveArena thus provides a unified testbed to develop and diagnose models for active perception and manipulation.

摘要（中文）：主动感知与操作对于机器人与复杂场景的交互至关重要。现有基准测试难以评估机器人如何以主动方式有效获取并维持记忆中的信息。为此，我们提出了ActiveArena-Sim，一个具备可控视角和大规模工作空间的主动感知模拟器，作为基础平台。在此基础上，我们构建了ActiveArena-Bench，包含跨5个细分类别的35项任务，涵盖视觉探索与交互式信息获取。每项任务仅凭被动观察难以解决，需要多轮证据采集与基于记忆的推理。该基准测试提供了丰富的记忆标注、标准化的训练数据，以及具有不重叠场景、未见干扰物配置和新颖背景的ID/OOD协议。此外，我们提出了ActiveArena-VLA，一个包含13种视觉-语言-行动配置的模块化套件，用于在主动感知中受控研究记忆写入、记忆容量、本体感觉状态、子任务监督和高层规划。基准测试结果揭示了显著的ID-OOD差距：统一记忆采样、在可靠写入策略下增加记忆容量、本体感觉输入以及子任务监督均能提升OOD泛化能力，而基于规划器的记忆管理与决策在仅使用稀疏记忆的情况下达到了接近最优配置的性能。因此，ActiveArena为主动感知与操作模型的开发和诊断提供了一个统一的测试平台。

Authors: Yibo Li, Enshen Zhou, Rui Chen, Yanjun Ding, Mengzhen Liu, Yi Han, Jiabo Zhan, Lipeng Wang, Shanghang Zhang, Lu Sheng

CARE: Experience-Guided Atomic Corrective Execution for Vision-Language-Action Policies Manipulation

failure recovery vision-language-action corrective execution robotic manipulation experience-guided

简要说明：CARE 提出了一种从失败的机器人执行中学习，生成纠错演示并在推理时触发原子恢复动作的框架，从而在仿真和真实双臂任务中提升 VLA 策略的鲁棒性。

TLDR: CARE proposes a framework that learns from failed robot executions to synthesize corrective demonstrations and trigger atomic recovery actions at inference, improving VLA policy robustness against deviations in simulation and real-world dual-arm tasks.

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies achieve strong performance in robotic manipulation but remain brittle once execution deviates from nominal trajectories. We propose CARE (Corrective Atomic Robotic Execution), a framework that improves recovery by learning from failures encountered during execution. Instead of generating corrective data from manually designed or random perturbations, CARE collects failed rollouts, models stage-conditioned post-failure deviations, and uses the resulting empirical distributions to synthesize representative failure states and corrective demonstrations. At inference time, CARE combines stage-wise planning with physically grounded 3D monitoring to trigger atomic adjustments or re-operations while preserving task progress. We further introduce the Failure State Recovery Benchmark (FSR-Bench), which evaluates recovery from intermediate failure states under local deviations and structural anomalies. Experiments across multiple VLA backbones, simulation benchmarks, and real-world dual-arm tasks show consistent improvements, with average task-success gains of 14.5 points in simulation and 15.9 points in the real world. Code, models, and data are available at https://github.com/xiaojunlan/care

摘要（中文）：视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略在机器人操作中表现出强大的性能，但一旦执行偏离标称轨迹，其鲁棒性便会显著下降。我们提出CARE（校正性原子化机器人执行）框架，通过从执行过程中遇到的失败中学习来提升恢复能力。CARE并非依赖人工设计或随机扰动生成校正数据，而是收集失败轨迹，建模阶段条件下的失败后偏差，并利用由此得到的经验分布合成具有代表性的失败状态与校正演示。在推理阶段，CARE将阶段级规划与基于物理的3D监测相结合，在保持任务进度的同时触发原子化调整或重新操作。我们进一步引入了失败状态恢复基准（FSR-Bench），用于评估在局部偏差和结构异常条件下从中间失败状态恢复的能力。在多种VLA骨干网络、仿真基准以及真实世界双臂任务上的实验均显示出持续改进，仿真环境中的平均任务成功率提升了14.5个百分点，真实世界中提升了15.9个百分点。代码、模型和数据可在 https://github.com/xiaojunlan/care 获取。

Authors: Junlan Xiao, Junwei Jiang, Zaibin Zhang, Yifan Wang, Zhongbo Zhang, Huchuan Lu, Lijun Wang

When Does Touch Matter? Charting the Vision-Interaction Gap in Cluttered Dexterous Grasping Manipulation

dexterous grasping tactile sensing wrench estimation cluttered scene interaction feedback

简要说明：本文通过在真实世界的灵巧手上进行控制实验，研究了在杂乱环境抓取中，触觉和力传感相比纯视觉何时能提升性能，结果显示交互感知带来了显著的性能提升。

TLDR: This paper presents a controlled real-world study on a dexterous robotic hand examining when tactile and wrench feedback improve over vision-only for cluttered grasping, showing significant performance gains with interaction sensing.

Abstract: Dexterous grasping in clutter poses a basic sensing question: when do tactile measurements and external wrench estimates improve on visual geometry? Occlusion and contact can obscure grasp quality, motivating a controlled evaluation of these interaction signals. We present a controlled real-world study over five tabletop scene conditions on a dexterous system that combines vision, per-finger and wrist wrench estimates, and distributed fingertip taxels. With demonstrations, visual observations, action space, and compliant control fixed, we compare vision-only, wrench, taxel, and combined policies plus representation and fusion baselines. The combined policy succeeds in 24/25 trials versus 14/25 for vision only, and 15/15 versus 6/15 across the three confined conditions. Ablations show that wrench and taxel feedback are complementary. Behavioral comparisons show that interaction feedback enables earlier rejection of inadequate contacts, regrasping before lift, and more stable grasps. To our knowledge, this is the first real-world study to combine and separately evaluate these interaction modalities for target-oriented dexterous grasping in clutter. These results chart a widening vision-interaction gap and position cluttered dexterous grasping as a benchmark for determining when the learned policy needs interaction sensing. Project website: https://interaction-dex-grasp.github.io/

摘要（中文）：在杂乱环境中的灵巧抓取引发了一个基本的感知问题：触觉测量和外部力矩估计在何时能够优于视觉几何信息？遮挡和接触可能会掩盖抓取质量，这促使我们对这些交互信号进行受控评估。我们在一款结合了视觉、每指及腕部力矩估计以及分布式指尖触觉传感器的灵巧系统上，针对五种桌面场景条件开展了一项受控的真实世界研究。在演示、视觉观测、动作空间和柔顺控制均保持固定的条件下，我们比较了仅视觉、力矩、触觉像素及组合策略，以及表示方法和融合基线。组合策略在24/25次试验中成功，而仅视觉策略为14/25次；在三种受限条件下，组合策略达到15/15次成功，仅视觉策略为6/15次。消融实验表明，力矩反馈和触觉像素反馈具有互补性。行为对比显示，交互反馈能够更早地拒绝不充分的接触，在抬升前进行重新抓取，并实现更稳定的抓取。据我们所知，这是首个在真实世界中针对杂乱环境下的目标导向灵巧抓取，对这些交互模态进行组合与分别评估的研究。这些结果揭示了视觉与交互能力之间不断扩大的差距，并将杂乱环境下的灵巧抓取定位为判断学习策略何时需要交互感知的基准任务。项目网站：https://interaction-dex-grasp.github.io/

Authors: Hao Jiang, Luis Dominguez, Daniel Seita

Automatic Labelling for Bimanual Mobile Manipulation Manipulation

automatic labelling bimanual mobile manipulation vision-language reasoning temporal segmentation semantic annotations

简要说明：本文提出了一种自动标注流水线，结合确定性轨迹分割与视觉-语言推理，为双手移动操作任务生成具有语义意义的子任务标注，并在真实机器人数据上进行了验证。

TLDR: This paper introduces an automatic labelling pipeline that combines deterministic trajectory segmentation with vision-language reasoning to generate semantically meaningful subtask annotations for bimanual mobile manipulation tasks, validated on real robot data.

Abstract: Semantically meaningful subtask labels can provide useful contexts for long-horizon policies, but automatically identifying both reliable temporal boundaries and broad semantic descriptions for annotations remains difficult. We present an automatic labelling pipeline that assigns temporal localisation to deterministic trajectory analysis and semantic interpretation to vision-language (VL) reasoning. The pipeline segments synchronised kinematic signals into phases, performs phase-localised VL reasoning to describe the contents, and aggregates the outputs for the base, left arm, and right arm actions. We evaluate this pipeline primarily on 29 real Galaxea bimanual mobile-manipulation tasks. Repeating the VL reasoning three times first produces the same output value for 87.4% on selected tasks. A review by nine participants across all 29 tasks then judgements on the labelled phases and shows positive acceptance of temporal divisions (90.5%), body labels (90.7%), and arm labels (78.7%). The results indicate that the segmentation-VL design can produce structured annotations while preserving asynchronous bimanual behaviour, providing a basis for richer semantic subtask identification and state-based verification.

摘要（中文）：语义上有意义的子任务标签可以为长期任务策略提供有用的上下文，但自动识别可靠的时间边界以及为注释提供广泛的语义描述仍然具有挑战性。我们提出了一种自动化标注流水线，该流水线将时间定位分配给确定性轨迹分析，并将语义解释分配给视觉-语言（VL）推理。该流水线将同步的运动信号分割为多个阶段，执行阶段定位的VL推理以描述内容，并汇总基础动作、左臂动作和右臂动作的输出。我们主要在29个真实的Galaxea双臂移动操作任务上评估该流水线。重复三次VL推理后，在选定任务中，87.4%的情况下首次产生相同输出值。随后，由九名参与者对全部29个任务进行评审，对标注阶段进行判断，结果显示对时间划分（90.5%）、身体标签（90.7%）和手臂标签（78.7%）的接受度较高。结果表明，分割-VL设计能够生成结构化注释，同时保留异步双臂行为，为更丰富的语义子任务识别和基于状态的验证提供了基础。

Authors: Yupu Lu, Jia Pan

What Matters in Designing World Action Models: An Empirical Study WorldModel

World Action Models causal structure latent representation training objective empirical study

简要说明：本文对世界动作模型（WAM）进行了受控实证研究，系统比较了因果结构、潜在空间和训练目标等设计选择，在多个基准和真实机器人数据上验证，为未来 WAM 系统提供设计原则。

TLDR: This paper presents a controlled empirical study of World Action Models (WAMs), systematically comparing design choices in causal structure, latent space, and training objectives across several benchmarks and real-robot data, to provide principles for building future WAM systems.

Abstract: World Action Models (WAMs) have emerged as a promising paradigm for generalizable robot control. Despite the growing number of WAM systems, existing works often introduce unified systems that bundle together multiple design choices, such as architecture and training strategy, making it difficult to isolate individual contributions and systematically compare alternative designs. In this work, we present a controlled study that disentangles these design choices and analyzes not only their empirical effects, but also how and why they shape WAMs. More specifically, we focus on three fundamental questions in building WAMs: (1) what causal structure should govern the interaction between world modeling and action generation? (2) in which latent space should world modeling be performed? and (3) how do different world-action modeling objectives affect model behavior and performance? Through structurally controlled experiments on three representative benchmarks, RoboCasa-GR1, LIBERO, and LIBERO-Plus, we systematically compare six causal structures, eight latent representations, and four training objectives, covering popular design choices in existing WAMs. We further validate our key findings on real-robot data from the DROID dataset. We hope to provide a systematic understanding of how core design choices affect world-action modeling and what principles can guide the development of future WAM systems.

摘要（中文）：世界动作模型（WAMs）已成为一种具有前景的通用机器人控制范式。尽管WAM系统数量不断增长，现有工作往往引入统一系统，将多种设计选择（如架构和训练策略）捆绑在一起，使得难以隔离单个贡献并系统比较不同设计方案。在本研究中，我们提出了一项受控研究，解耦这些设计选择，不仅分析其经验效果，还探讨它们如何以及为何塑造WAMs。具体而言，我们聚焦于构建WAMs时的三个基本问题：（1）何种因果结构应控制世界建模与动作生成之间的交互？（2）世界建模应在何种潜在空间中进行？（3）不同的世界-动作建模目标如何影响模型行为与性能？通过在三个代表性基准——RoboCasa-GR1、LIBERO和LIBERO-Plus——上进行结构受控实验，我们系统比较了六种因果结构、八种潜在表示和四种训练目标，覆盖了现有WAMs中的主流设计选择。我们进一步在DROID数据集的真实机器人数据上验证了主要发现。我们希望提供对核心设计选择如何影响世界-动作建模以及哪些原则可指导未来WAM系统开发的系统性理解。

Authors: Chao Tang, Haoqing Wang, Zilang Cen, Weishi Mi, Wei Xia, Fangcheng Liu, Anda Cheng, Yeqing Shen, Xiaohui Cui, Xiaoyuan Zhang, Yehui Tang, Tingguang Li

RoboTalk: Learning Multi-Robot Communication and Coordination from Multimodal Demonstrations Manipulation

multi-robot communication small vision-language models multimodal demonstrations mobile-manipulation kitchen tasks leader-follower protocol

简要说明：RoboTalk 提出了一个包含 7,950 条多模态轨迹的合成数据集，用于移动操作厨房任务，并微调小型视觉语言模型以实现多机器人通信与协调，在新任务上成功率从约 2% 提升至 77%。

TLDR: RoboTalk introduces a synthetic dataset of 7,950 multimodal trajectories for mobile-manipulation kitchen tasks, and fine-tunes small vision-language models to enable multi-robot communication and coordination, achieving 77% success on novel tasks compared to ~2% for untuned models.

Abstract: Multi-robot collaboration could enable more efficient and scalable solutions to complex robotic tasks, but collaboration under partial observability remains challenging. Natural-language communication offers a promising approach to coordinating robots under partial observability. However, in decentralized manipulation, jointly learning explicit inter-robot communication and skill-level action selection from multimodal demonstrations remains underexplored for small vision-language models (VLMs) intended for on-device deployment. To address this gap, we introduce RoboTalk, a synthetic data-generation pipeline and dataset of 7,950 multimodal trajectories spanning 53 mobile-manipulation kitchen tasks for training small VLMs to communicate and coordinate. The dataset includes a leader-follower planning protocol, tool calls (perception, manipulation, navigation, and communication), rationale traces, and diversified natural-language communication. Fine-tuning open-source models on our dataset can reach 77% success on novel held-out tasks, a significant improvement over the untuned open source models, which had a success rate of around ~2%.

摘要（中文）：多机器人协作有望为复杂机器人任务提供更高效、更具可扩展性的解决方案，但在部分可观测条件下的协作仍具挑战性。自然语言通信为在部分可观测条件下协调机器人提供了一种有前景的方法。然而，在分散式操作中，针对面向设备端部署的小型视觉语言模型（VLM），从多模态演示中联合学习机器人间的显式通信与技能级动作选择，仍是一个尚未充分探索的领域。为弥补这一空白，我们提出了RoboTalk，一个合成数据生成流水线及包含7,950条多模态轨迹的数据集，涵盖53项移动操作厨房任务，用于训练小型视觉语言模型进行通信与协作。该数据集包含领导者-跟随者规划协议、工具调用（感知、操作、导航和通信）、推理轨迹以及多样化的自然语言通信。基于我们的数据集对开源模型进行微调，在新颖的留出任务上成功率可达77%，显著优于未微调的开源模型（其成功率约为~2%）。

Authors: Dorian Benhamou Goldfajn, Mason Nakamura, Saaduddin Mahmud, Justin Svegliato, Kyle H. Wray, Shlomo Zilberstein

Anticipatory Robot Goalkeeping via Monotone Optimal Stopping Locomotion

optimal stopping quadruped robot reinforcement learning anticipatory control dynamic interception

简要说明：本文提出了一种用于机器人守门员预判动作的单调最优停止方法，通过决定何时启动学习到的扑救策略来平衡信息获取与物理可达性，在仿真和真实机器人实验中提高了扑救成功率。

TLDR: This paper proposes a monotone optimal stopping method for anticipatory robotic goalkeeping, where a quadruped robot decides when to activate a learned save policy to balance information gathering and physical reachability, improving save rates in simulation and real-robot experiments.

Abstract: Robots engaged in fast physical interactions often need to act before the intent of another agent is fully known. Anticipatory goalkeeping illustrates this challenge. Waiting provides more reliable information about the target but reduces the physical opportunity for interception, whereas acting early preserves reachability but requires initiating motion under uncertainty. Given a fixed closed-loop save controller, we formulate the decision of when to initiate motion as a policy-conditional finite-horizon optimal stopping problem. Building on this formulation, we propose monotone optimal stopping (MOS), a structured release-timing method for dynamic robotic interception. The quadruped save policy is trained with reinforcement learning, while MOS determines when the policy should be activated from the evolving robot state and target belief. Rather than predicting a release time or relying on confidence alone, MOS learns the return advantage of acting now over waiting for one more observation. We derive a direct Bellman recursion for this act-versus-wait margin and impose monotonicity only with respect to physical urgency, reflecting the irreversible loss of interception opportunity as time elapses. This structure enables early activation for dynamically demanding saves while preserving closed-loop adaptation when later observations change the predicted target. Under a single-crossing condition, MOS admits a threshold release boundary with a bounded approximation error. Extensive simulation studies show that MOS improves the mean save rate from 67.7% to 74.4% over a parameter-matched learned gate and increases reversal saves from 52.1% to 66.5%. Real-robot experiments further demonstrate rapid interception and post-release direction correction under human shot-direction feints.

摘要（中文）：机器人在进行快速物理交互时，往往需要在另一智能体的意图尚未完全明确之前采取行动。预期性守门任务恰好体现了这一挑战。等待能够提供关于目标更为可靠的信息，但会缩小物理拦截的可能性窗口；而提前行动虽能保留可达性，却要求在不确定性下启动运动。在给定固定闭环扑救控制器的情况下，我们将启动运动的时机决策形式化为一个策略条件化的有限时域最优停止问题。基于该形式化，我们提出单调最优停止（MOS）方法，一种用于动态机器人拦截的结构化释放时机决策方法。四足机器人扑救策略通过强化学习训练，而MOS则根据不断演化的机器人状态与目标信念，决定策略应何时被激活。MOS并非预测释放时间或仅依赖置信度，而是学习“立即行动”相较于“再等待一次观测”的收益优势。我们为该“行动—等待”边际收益推导出直接的贝尔曼递归关系，并仅针对物理紧迫性施加单调性约束，以反映随时间推移拦截机会不可逆地丧失这一特性。该结构使得对动态要求较高的扑救任务能够早期激活，同时在后续观测改变预测目标时保留闭环自适应能力。在单交叉条件下，MOS允许存在阈值型释放边界，且近似误差有界。大量仿真研究表明，与参数匹配的学习式门控方法相比，MOS将平均扑救成功率从67.7%提升至74.4%，并将反向变向扑救成功率从52.1%提升至66.5%。真实机器人实验进一步验证了在人类射门方向假动作下，机器人能够实现快速拦截及释放后的方向修正。

Authors: Hao E. Zhang, Ruize Geng, Yisen Li, Yaru Niu, Yikai Wang, Raihan Haque, Khalil Zbiss, Guanyang Luo, Hui-ping Wang, H. Eric Tseng, Ding Zhao

HapticWAM: Distilling Imagined Touch into a World-Action Model without Inference-Time Tactile Sensing Manipulation

world-action model tactile sensing teacher-student distillation contact-rich manipulation pick-and-place

简要说明：HapticWAM 提出了一种世界动作模型，通过师生蒸馏和触觉想象，使机器人在部署时无需触觉传感即可完成接触丰富的操作任务，并在真实场景中取得了高成功率。

TLDR: HapticWAM introduces a world-action model that uses teacher-student distillation and tactile imagination to enable contact-rich manipulation without requiring tactile sensing at deployment, achieving high success rates on real-world pick-and-place tasks.

Abstract: Contact-rich manipulation requires estimating forces, slip and contact geometry that can remain ambiguous in scene images. Optical tactile sensors provide both visual observations of the contact surface and mechanical measurements, yet learning from these signals raises two challenges: representing contact beyond appearance and transferring its benefits to a policy that does not require fingertip observations at deployment. We introduce HapticWAM, a world-action model that combines heterogeneous tactile encoding, structured contact prediction and teacher-student distillation. Its teacher encodes gel images together with deformation, shear, distributed forces, resultant wrench and derived contact state into a frozen video backbone. Rather than predicting tactile pixels alone, the model jointly generates actions and a contact package describing future events and mechanics. Anticipatory Contact Coupling uses the previously imagined package to condition attention, preserving a contact-related input when direct tactile observations are unavailable. Haptic-Imagination Distillation transfers both contact futures and action predictions to a student that retains the generative contact head but removes its fingertip input branches. On a real-world setup, across three contact-rich pick-and-place tasks, HapticWAM Student achieves a 77% per-task mean success rate (41 of 50 starts, 82% pooled), reaching 95% on one of the tasks, outperforming the evaluated teacher and baseline configurations.

摘要（中文）：接触丰富的操作任务要求对力、滑移及接触几何进行估计，而这些信息在场景图像中往往具有模糊性。光学触觉传感器既能提供接触表面的视觉观测，又能提供力学测量数据，然而利用这些信号进行学习面临两个挑战：一是如何表征超越外观的接触信息，二是在部署阶段如何将这种表征的优势迁移至无需指尖观测的策略中。为此，我们提出HapticWAM，一种世界-动作模型，融合了异质触觉编码、结构化接触预测以及师生蒸馏机制。其教师网络将凝胶图像与形变、剪切、分布力、合力和推导出的接触状态共同编码至一个冻结的视频骨干网络中。该模型不仅预测触觉像素，还联合生成动作及描述未来事件和力学特性的接触数据包。预期接触耦合机制利用先前想象得到的接触数据包来调节注意力，从而在直接触觉观测不可用时保留与接触相关的输入。触觉想象蒸馏将接触未来信息和动作预测同时迁移至学生网络，后者保留了生成式接触头，但移除了指尖输入分支。在真实实验平台上，覆盖三项接触丰富的抓取-放置任务，HapticWAM学生模型实现了每项任务77%的平均成功率（50次启动中成功41次，合并成功率为82%），其中一项任务的成功率达到95%，优于所评估的教师模型及基线配置。

Authors: Mikhail Sannikov, Ilya Mikhalchuk, Konstantin Gubernatorov, Petr Kovalev, Ogunwoye Faith Oluwatobi, Dzmitry Tsetserukou

ContactDP: Contact-Guided Diffusion Policy for Tight Insertion Tasks Manipulation

diffusion policy contact-rich manipulation tactile sensing force-torque connector insertion

简要说明：ContactDP提出了一种多模态扩散策略，结合腕部RGB、指尖触觉和力-力矩数据以及混合位置-力控制器，用于高精度、接触丰富的连接器插接任务，在工业任务上显著优于仅视觉的基线。

TLDR: ContactDP presents a multimodal diffusion policy that integrates wrist RGB, fingertip tactile, and force-torque data with a hybrid position-force controller for high-precision, contact-rich connector insertion, demonstrating superior performance over vision-only baselines on industrial tasks.

Abstract: High-precision connector insertion remains challenging for robotic systems due to tight mechanical tolerances, partial observability during contact, and multimodal uncertainty arising from occlusion and contact ambiguity. Successful insertion requires closed-loop contact guidance that continuously integrates global alignment cues with local contact feedback to produce stable corrective actions under interaction. In this work, we present ContactDP (Contact-Guided Diffusion Policy for Tight Insertion Tasks), a multimodal diffusion-policy framework for contact-rich insertion. ContactDP jointly integrates wrist RGB observations, fingertip tactile sensing, and wrist-mounted force-torque measurements to infer contact state and generate temporally consistent corrective motions during insertion. To ensure stable execution under contact, the learned policy operates together with a hybrid position-force controller that provides compliant low-level interaction. We evaluate our approach on a suite of industrial-grade connector insertion tasks with varying connector geometries, grasp conditions, and initial misalignment. Across all tasks, ContactDP significantly outperforms vision-only diffusion policies for performance, reliability and generalization.

摘要（中文）：高精度连接器插入任务对机器人系统而言仍具挑战性，原因在于严苛的机械公差、接触过程中的部分可观测性，以及由遮挡和接触模糊所引发的多模态不确定性。成功插入需要闭环接触引导，持续融合全局对齐线索与局部接触反馈，以在交互作用下产生稳定的修正动作。在本工作中，我们提出了ContactDP（面向紧密插入任务的接触引导扩散策略），一种面向接触密集插入任务的多模态扩散策略框架。ContactDP联合整合腕部RGB观测、指尖触觉感知和腕部力-力矩测量，以推断接触状态并在插入过程中生成时间上一致的修正运动。为确保接触条件下的稳定执行，所学策略与混合位置-力控制器协同工作，该控制器提供柔顺的低层交互。我们在一系列具有不同连接器几何形状、抓取条件和初始对中偏差的工业级连接器插入任务上评估了该方法。在所有任务中，ContactDP在性能、可靠性和泛化能力上均显著优于仅依赖视觉的扩散策略。

Authors: Chengyi Xing, Shaoxiong Yao, Diego Romeres, Devesh K. Jha

PackLab: A Comprehensive Framework for Developing, Training, and Evaluating MLLMs in Robotic Bin Packing Manipulation

robotic bin packing multimodal large language models closed-loop sequential decision-making physics-based simulation benchmark

简要说明：PackLab 提出了一个用于训练和评估MLLM在闭环机器人装箱中的框架，包括仿真套件、专用VLM和基准测试，展示了优于启发式方法和强化学习方法的性能。

TLDR: PackLab introduces a framework for training and evaluating MLLMs in closed-loop robotic bin packing, including a simulation suite, a packing-specialized VLM, and a benchmark, demonstrating superior performance over heuristics and RL methods.

Abstract: Robotic bin packing requires long-horizon sequential decision-making, as each object placement affects the available space for subsequent packing. Existing methods primarily rely on hand-crafted geometric heuristics that optimize predefined objectives or reinforcement learning policies learned through trial and error over predefined training configurations. Despite recent advances in multimodal large language models (MLLMs) for this task, their potential for closed-loop sequential decisions across heterogeneous packing configurations remains underexplored. To address this gap, we introduce PackLab, a comprehensive framework for developing, training, and evaluating MLLMs for closed-loop robotic bin packing. PackLab-Suite provides a physics-based simulation platform for scalable generation of diverse training packing trajectories and evaluation of their physical outcomes. PackLab-VLM is a packing-specialized MLLM that understands the evolving object and container states to jointly select objects and predict placements in a closed-loop manner. PackLab-Bench provides standardized packing scenarios at multiple difficulty levels for systematic evaluation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that, on average, PackLab-VLM outperforms conventional packing heuristics, traditional reinforcement learning methods, and general-purpose MLLMs across object sets and container configurations, highlighting the potential of MLLMs for long-horizon robotic packing. The code, model, dataset, and benchmark are available at https://github.com/Correr-Zhou/PackLab .

摘要（中文）：机器人装箱任务需要长时程的序贯决策，因为每一次物体放置都会影响后续装箱可用的空间。现有方法主要依赖人工设计的几何启发式规则，以优化预定义目标，或通过强化学习策略在预定义训练配置上反复试错进行学习。尽管近年来多模态大语言模型在该任务上取得了一定进展，但其在异构装箱配置下实现闭环序贯决策的潜力仍未得到充分探索。为弥补这一空白，我们提出了PackLab——一个用于开发、训练和评估面向闭环机器人装箱任务的多模态大语言模型的综合性框架。PackLab-Suite提供了一个基于物理仿真的平台，可规模化生成多样化的训练装箱轨迹，并对其物理结果进行评估。PackLab-VLM是一个面向装箱任务专门优化的多模态大语言模型，能够理解不断变化的物体与容器状态，以闭环方式联合选择物体并预测放置位置。PackLab-Bench提供了多个难度等级的标准化装箱场景，用于系统性评估。大量实验表明，在不同物体集合与容器配置下，PackLab-VLM平均性能优于传统装箱启发式方法、传统强化学习方法以及通用多模态大语言模型，凸显了多模态大语言模型在长时程机器人装箱任务中的潜力。相关代码、模型、数据集和基准测试平台已发布于 https://github.com/Correr-Zhou/PackLab 。

Authors: Donghao Zhou, Jia-Hui Pan, Fan Zhang, Xingyuan Bu, Shilong Li, Xiaojie Gao, Yun-Hui Liu, Chi-Wing Fu, Pheng-Ann Heng

X-Planner: Event-Structured Task Planning for Embodied Intelligence VLA

event-structured planning task planning VLM backbone latent CoT states embodied reasoning

简要说明：X-Planner 为具身智能提出了一种事件结构化的任务规划前端，通过阶梯式解码和潜在语义锚定提升了长时程操作规划与真实机器人执行效果。

TLDR: X-Planner introduces a planning front-end for embodied intelligence with event-structured plan forms and staggered CoT decoding, improving long-horizon manipulation planning and real-robot execution.

Abstract: Task planning bridges high-level instructions and executable behavior in long-horizon manipulation, yet modern Vision-Language-Action (VLA) systems often leave this intermediate structure implicit. Existing chain-of-thought (CoT) planners also tend to rely on coarse task-level annotations or serialize long reasoning traces token by token. We present X-Planner, a planning front-end that addresses both the supervision and representation of embodied reasoning. Our planning data combine Ego, UMI, and teleoperation under a hierarchy granularity with source-dependent annotation depth. Takeover-time annotations and human-designed failures supervise ongoing error recognition. On the model side, a shared VLM backbone exposes two event-structured plan forms: a discrete interface that emits interpretable event states and a latent interface that relays continuous CoT states across staggered Transformer depths through Staircase Decoding. A frozen latent-to-text reconstruction objective provides a semantic anchor for the latent representation. Offline two-step planning evaluation places X-Planner second among four evaluated models on both BERTScore-F1 and a judge-based Overall score. In real-robot experiments, respectively, outperforming the evaluated baselines. These results characterize planning-text quality and downstream execution.

摘要（中文）：任务规划在长程操作中连接高级指令与可执行行为，然而现代视觉-语言-动作（VLA）系统往往使这一中间结构隐式化。现有的思维链（CoT）规划器也倾向于依赖粗粒度的任务级标注，或将冗长的推理轨迹逐词元序列化。我们提出X-Planner，一个规划前端，旨在同时解决具身推理的监督与表示问题。我们的规划数据在层级粒度下结合了Ego、UMI和遥操作，并采用依赖数据来源的注释深度。接管时刻的注释和人为设计的失败场景监督了持续的错误识别。在模型侧，共享的VLM骨干网络展示了两种事件结构的规划形式：一种离散接口，输出可解释的事件状态；以及一种潜在接口，通过阶梯解码在交错的Transformer深度之间传递连续的思维链状态。冻结的潜在到文本重建目标为潜在表示提供了语义锚点。离线两步规划评估中，X-Planner在BERTScore-F1和基于评判者的总体得分上均位列四个评估模型中的第二名。在真实机器人实验中，分别优于所评估的基线模型。这些结果表征了规划文本质量和下游执行性能。

Authors: Howard Lu, Shalfun Li, Porter Pan, Cris, Lumen, Cyril, Eric Hu, Lily Li, Maeve Zhang, Robert Wang, KZ Zheng, Viggo Chen, Tim Ding, Regsis Cheng, YJ Xiao, Kian, Hai Lin, Alan Song, Elise Ma, Gody Li, Victor Yao, Yohann Tang, Ingrid Yu, Jason He, James Wang, Ryan Yu, Ping Yang, Chris Pan, Vincent Chen, Roy Gan, Hao Wang, Qian Wang

An Unexpected Robot Policy: Early Evaluations of GPT-6 Astra on RoboDojo and Beyond VLA

LLM as policy RoboDojo robot manipulation zero-shot GPT-6 Astra

简要说明：本文评估了GPT-6 Astra在RoboDojo上作为零样本通用机器人操作策略的表现，发现其得分最高，但在精度和动态控制方面仍有不足，为LLM作为通用操作模型提供了初步证据。

TLDR: This paper evaluates GPT-6 Astra as a zero-shot generalist robot manipulation policy on RoboDojo, finding it achieves the highest score among public policies but struggles with precision and dynamic control, while other LLMs fail. It provides initial evidence for LLMs as general-purpose manipulation models without task-specific finetuning.

Abstract: Embodied AI systems are often organized into System 1 and System 2. System 1 is typically a pretrained policy that generates actions at high frequency, whereas System 2 is often instantiated as a vision-enabled language model for high-level planning. We ask whether a large language model (LLM) can act as the policy for robot manipulation without task-specific finetuning. We call this setting LLM as policy. We evaluate three LLMs on all 42 RoboDojo tasks and compare their scores with 40 public policies. Astra and GPT-5.5 use the official 50-episode-per-task protocol; DeepSeek-Flash uses 10 episodes per task. GPT-6 Astra achieves 22.48% average success rate and 28.97 Score over 2,100 trials, ranking above every public entry. Yet GPT-5.5 and DeepSeek-Flash reach only 0.88% and 1.92% average success rate with the same post-processing. We find that Astra exhibits a sharply polarized capability profile. It generalizes well to tasks that require semantic understanding but not high-precision control. In contrast, it performs poorly on tasks that require precision, dynamic control, or complex bimanual coordination. In-context experiments show no aggregate benefit from one-shot demonstrations, while selected interaction traces show within-episode corrections under perturbations. Overall, the evaluated LLMs vary substantially in manipulation performance. Astra stands out and provides initial evidence for the potential of a general-purpose manipulation model, although reliable precision and dynamic control remain limitations in the evaluated setting.

摘要（中文）：具身智能系统通常被组织为系统1和系统2两个层面。系统1通常是高频生成动作的预训练策略，而系统2通常以具备视觉能力的大语言模型形式实现，用于高层规划。我们探究的问题是：大语言模型（LLM）能否在不进行任务特定微调的情况下，直接充当机器人操作策略。我们将这一设定称为“LLM即策略”（LLM as policy）。我们在RoboDojo全部42个任务上评估了三款大语言模型，并将其得分与40个公开策略进行比较。Astra和GPT-5.5采用官方每任务50回合的测试协议；DeepSeek-Flash采用每任务10回合的测试协议。GPT-6 Astra在2,100次试验中实现了22.48%的平均成功率和28.97的得分，位居所有公开提交结果之上。然而，在相同的后处理条件下，GPT-5.5和DeepSeek-Flash的平均成功率仅分别达到0.88%和1.92%。我们发现Astra展现出显著两极化的能力分布：在需要语义理解但不需要高精度控制的任务上，其泛化能力良好；相反，在需要精度、动态控制或复杂双臂协调的任务上，其表现不佳。上下文实验显示，一次性示范并未带来总体收益，而选定的交互轨迹则表明在扰动下存在回合内修正能力。总体而言，所评估的大语言模型在操作性能上存在显著差异。Astra表现突出，为通用操作模型的潜力提供了初步证据，但在所评估的设定中，可靠的精度和动态控制仍然是其局限性所在。

Authors: Wenbo Zhang, Kaixuan Wang, Yutao Ouyang, Xiaoyu Huang, Liyang Li, Kailun Su, Weiyang Jin, Wenhao Chai, Haotian Liang, Zhiyang Dou, Yue Chen, Tianxing Chen

Learning Beyond What Humans Can Demonstrate Manipulation

behavior cloning guardrails infeasible demonstrations robot manipulation teleoperation filtering

简要说明：该论文提出了GLIDE框架，从不可行演示中推断任务特定的失败模式并将其转化为数据收集和策略部署的护栏，显著提高了成功率。

TLDR: The paper proposes GLIDE, a framework that infers task-specific failure modes from infeasible demonstrations for robot manipulation and converts them into guardrails for data collection and policy deployment, improving success rates significantly.

Abstract: Behavior cloning for robot manipulation relies on expert demonstrations. However, for tasks that require dynamic stability, precise contact timing, or dexterous coordination, human operators may find it hard or even impossible to collect data. We study this infeasible-demonstration regime and propose GLIDE: Guardrails for Learning from Infeasible Demonstrations Efficiently, a framework that infers task-specific failure modes and converts them into executable guardrails for data collection and policy deployment. Given a task description and the conditioning teleoperation code, GLIDE writes guardrails that use system states to filter teleoperation and policy commands, constrain failure-prone actions, and iteratively improve from trajectory feedback. Across three tasks, GLIDE discovers emergent guardrails that go beyond domain-expert hardcoded ones, improving data collection over naive VR teleoperation and domain-expert hardcoded guardrails. After refinement, GLIDE raises data-collection success from 0-10 percent to 70-90 percent across the three tasks. During policy execution, mixed-data guarded policies reach 70 percent, 60 percent, and 60 percent success on Tomato plate transfer, Marker handover and stand, and Wine serving tasks. These results show that GLIDE can support policy learning when direct demonstrations are infeasible. Project website: http://guardrail-policy.github.io/

摘要（中文）：机器人操作的行为克隆依赖于专家示范。然而，对于需要动态稳定性、精确接触时机或灵巧协调的任务，人类操作员可能难以甚至无法收集数据。我们研究了这种不可行示范情境，并提出了GLIDE：一种从不可行示范中高效学习的护栏框架，该框架能够推断任务特定的故障模式，并将其转化为可执行的数据收集与策略部署护栏。给定任务描述和条件遥操作代码，GLIDE编写护栏，利用系统状态过滤遥操作和策略命令，约束易出错动作，并通过轨迹反馈迭代改进。在三个任务中，GLIDE发现了超越领域专家硬编码护栏的新兴护栏，相较于朴素VR遥操作和领域专家硬编码护栏，显著提升了数据收集效果。经过优化后，GLIDE将三个任务的数据收集成功率从0-10%提升至70-90%。在策略执行阶段，混合数据护栏策略在番茄盘传送、马克笔交接与放置以及倒酒任务中分别达到70%、60%和60%的成功率。这些结果表明，当直接示范不可行时，GLIDE能够有效支持策略学习。项目网站：http://guardrail-policy.github.io/

Authors: Yuchen Song, Aditya Mittal, Unnat Jain

Steerable and Reactive Grasping Through Modular Design with a Three-Point Interface Manipulation

dexterous grasping modular design reinforcement learning reactive control affordance heatmap

简要说明：本文提出了一种模块化抓取框架，通过三点接口结合几何特征采样、模型反应式控制和共享RL策略进行局部抓取优化，并在仿真和硬件上验证。

TLDR: This paper presents a modular grasping framework that combines a three-point interface with geometric affordance sampling, model-based reactive control, and a shared RL policy for local grasp refinement, validated in simulation and on hardware.

Abstract: Dexterous grasping requires deciding where to grasp, reaching the target, and maintaining stable contact. We connect these stages through a compact three-point interface that separates global geometric reasoning from local contact control. Given object geometry and optional language commands, our framework samples contact triples from a precomputed grasp-affordance heatmap. A model-based reactive controller tracks the object, avoids collisions, and guides the hand toward the selected contacts. In the final centimeters, a Reinforcement Learning (RL) policy uses proprioceptive feedback to refine and stabilize the grasp despite reaching and perception errors. It observes only finger joint states and its recent actions, with no target points, visual observations, or object geometry, so a single policy is shared across objects and grasp configurations. In simulation, we compare grasp-and-lift success against squeeze and end-to-end baselines, characterize reaching convergence, and demonstrate grasp steering; hardware demonstrations on two training objects and one unseen object illustrate the full pipeline. Our modular framework uses geometry to guide the reach and local feedback to secure the grasp.

摘要（中文）：灵巧抓取需要决定抓取位置、到达目标并保持稳定接触。我们通过一个紧凑的三点接口将这些阶段连接起来，该接口将全局几何推理与局部接触控制分离。给定物体几何形状和可选的语言指令，我们的框架从预计算的抓取可供性热图中采样接触三元组。一个基于模型的反作用控制器跟踪物体、避免碰撞，并引导手部朝向选定的接触点。在最后几厘米范围内，强化学习策略利用本体感觉反馈来优化并稳定抓取，即使存在到达和感知误差。该策略仅观察手指关节状态及其最近的动作，不依赖目标点、视觉观察或物体几何形状，因此单一策略可跨物体和抓取配置共享。在仿真中，我们与挤压式和端到端基线进行了抓取并举升成功率的对比，表征了到达收敛性，并演示了抓取引导；在两个训练物体和一个未见物体上的硬件演示展示了完整的流程。我们的模块化框架利用几何信息引导到达过程，并利用局部反馈确保抓取稳定。

Authors: Andrew Nguyen, Yonghyeon Lee, Sangbae Kim

CAST: Collision-Aware Assembly with Construction Robots using Simultaneous Trajectory Estimation and Planning Manipulation

multi-robot motion planning factor graph collision avoidance construction assembly trajectory estimation

简要说明：CAST提出了一种基于因子图的同步多机器人运动规划框架，结合碰撞与缆绳约束，并在双机械臂的建造组装任务中验证。

TLDR: CAST presents a factor-graph-based framework for synchronized multi-robot motion planning with collision and cable constraints, demonstrated in a construction assembly task with two real robot arms.

Abstract: Multi-robot systems have shown increasing viability in construction due to their ability to execute high-precision actions while reducing human exposure to hazardous tasks. However, these environments have high-dimensional configuration spaces and possess substantial collision-avoidance constraints, which include other robots, assembly objects, and workspace boundaries. We utilize a single factor graph for trajectory estimation and planning that incorporates measured robot states together with explicit collision and learned cable constraints. This supports changing workspaces and enables synchronized, high-dimensional robot motion planning while accounting for the stiff, vibration-induced uncertainty of heavy robotic systems. We demonstrate the success of our framework on the construction of a post-and-lintel structure using one robot arm as a timber gripper, and a second robot as a nail-fastener.

摘要（中文）：多机器人系统因其在执行高精度操作的同时减少人员暴露于危险任务的能力，在建筑施工领域展现出日益增长的可行性。然而，这类环境具有高维构型空间，并包含大量避碰约束，这些约束涉及其他机器人、装配物体及工作空间边界。我们采用单一因子图进行轨迹估计与规划，该因子图融合了实测机器人状态以及显式碰撞约束和学习得到的缆绳约束。该方法支持工作空间的动态变化，并能够在考虑重型机器人系统因刚性及振动引发的不确定性的同时，实现同步的高维机器人运动规划。我们通过构建一个梁柱结构验证了所提框架的有效性，其中一台机器人手臂用作木材夹持器，另一台机器人用作钉紧固器。

Authors: Karthik Shaji, Chisung Kim, John D'Amato, Edvard Bruun, Frank Dellaert

Feasibility Distance Fields for Heterogeneous Constraints in Robot Configuration Space Manipulation

feasibility distance field configuration space neural approximation collision avoidance robot constraints

简要说明：本文提出可行性距离场（FDF），在构型空间中统一表示多种机器人约束的距离，并在UR5e和双臂机器人上展示了碰撞、关节限位、灵活性、柔顺性、扭矩和可操作性等FDF的神经逼近精度。

TLDR: This paper introduces the feasibility distance field (FDF), a unified distance-based representation of diverse robot constraints in configuration space, and demonstrates accurate neural approximation of FDFs for collision, joint limits, dexterity, compliance, torque, and manipulability on UR5e and dual-arm robots.

Abstract: Robot manipulators are monitored by constraint-specific indicators whose units and gradient scales are not comparable, so they do not provide a common measure of the configuration-space motion remaining before violation. We define the feasibility distance field (FDF) as the distance, under a fixed positive-definite joint-space metric, to the union of infeasible configuration sets. Classical distance-to-set theory gives 1-Lipschitz continuity, almost-everywhere differentiability, and unit dual-gradient norm wherever the nearest projection is unique. The robotics contribution is an admissibility analysis showing when practical constraints define non-empty closed sets. We derive admissible formulations for external and self-collision, joint limits, dexterity, Cartesian and task-projected compliance, joint torque under payload, and dynamic manipulability. Since every field uses the same metric, heterogeneous constraints compose by a pointwise minimum, conditioned constraints retain a fixed distance space, and multi-robot constraints produce block-sparse gradients that identify which robots must react. We generate projection-based labels and train neural approximations with a distance loss and an Eikonal penalty. Simulations on a UR5e and a dual-arm cell evaluate seven fields using value, projection, sign, gradient, composition, and moving-obstacle diagnostics. Across 8,000 configurations, the largest feasible-side secant ratio is 0.920, mean learned gradient norms range from 0.994 to 0.998, and projection residuals range from 0.011 to 0.034 rad. Across 24 random obstacle paths, the external and composed collision fields achieve 90.4% and 91.6% success within 3 cm, with sign-error rates below 2%. The results support a common configuration-space margin and identify approximation errors near medial axes and sparsely sampled boundaries.

摘要（中文）：机器人机械臂通过约束特定指标进行监控，但这些指标的单位和梯度尺度不可比，因此无法提供违反约束前剩余构型空间运动量的统一度量。我们将可行性距离场（FDF）定义为在固定正定关节空间度量下，到不可行构型集合并集的距离。经典距离到集合理论给出了1-Lipschitz连续性、几乎处处可微性，以及在最近投影唯一处单位对偶梯度范数。本研究的机器人学贡献在于可容许性分析，证明了实际约束何时定义非空闭集。我们推导了外部碰撞与自碰撞、关节极限、灵巧度、笛卡尔空间与任务投影柔顺性、负载下关节力矩以及动态可操作度的可容许表达式。由于所有场使用相同度量，异构约束通过逐点最小值进行组合，条件约束保留固定距离空间，多机器人约束产生块稀疏梯度，可识别必须响应的机器人。我们生成基于投影的标签，并使用距离损失和Eikonal惩罚训练神经近似。在UR5e和双臂单元上的仿真实验中，通过数值、投影、符号、梯度、组合和移动障碍物诊断评估了七个场。在8，000个构型中，最大可行侧正割比为0.920，平均学习梯度范数范围为0.994至0.998，投影残差范围为0.011至0.034弧度。在24条随机障碍物路径中，外部碰撞场和组合碰撞场在3厘米内分别达到90.4%和91.6%的成功率，符号错误率低于2%。结果支持统一的构型空间裕度，并识别了中轴附近和稀疏采样边界处的近似误差。

Authors: Xijing Cui, Huayan Pu, Jun Luo, Gang Wang

Learning tactile perception from high-bandwidth single-point sensing Manipulation

tactile sensing spectrogram representation robotic manipulation high-bandwidth sensing cross-sensor generalization

简要说明：SpectRobot 将单点高带宽触觉信号转换为频谱图，供视觉编码器使用，实现遮挡操作任务和跨传感器泛化。

TLDR: SpectRobot converts single-point high-bandwidth tactile signals into spectrograms usable by vision encoders, enabling occluded manipulation tasks and cross-sensor generalization.

Abstract: Tactile sensing is increasingly being incorporated into learning-based robotic manipulation, yet many existing approaches rely on spatially distributed sensors. Here we introduce SpectRobot, a framework that transforms single-point tactile signals into compact time-frequency spectrograms. These spectrograms encode high-bandwidth tactile histories as fixed-size image-like representations. They can be processed by standard vision encoders and integrated into learning pipelines originally developed for vision, while preserving temporal and frequency information unavailable to conventional cameras. Rather than increasing spatial density through arrays of tactile elements, SpectRobot exploits the rich dynamics contained in sparse, high-bandwidth single-point measurements. In our implementation, the sensors are mounted away from the contact surface while remaining mechanically coupled to it, reducing direct exposure to wear and potentially improving robustness in harsh environments and for long-term deployment on dexterous robots. Our experiments demonstrate that: (1) a robot can exploit single-point vibration signals to solve a visually occluded manipulation task; (2) temporal history strongly influences policy performance, while sensing bandwidth controls the spectral information available, with measurements extending to 100~kHz; and (3) the same representation can be used across different tactile sensing technologies mediated by acceleration, force, or strain. We further show that capabilities previously associated with research-grade instrumentation can be accessed using readily available, off-the-shelf hardware. We believe that broader access to high-bandwidth tactile sensing could facilitate the integration of contact dynamics into embodied learning systems and, for some tasks, offer an alternative or complement to increasing the spatial density of tactile sensing.

摘要（中文）：触觉感知正越来越多地被整合到基于学习的机器人操作中，然而许多现有方法依赖于空间分布的传感器。在此，我们提出SpectRobot，一个将单点触觉信号转换为紧凑时频谱图的框架。这些谱图将高带宽触觉历史编码为固定大小的类图像表示，可由标准视觉编码器处理，并集成到原先为视觉设计的学习流程中，同时保留了传统相机无法获取的时间和频率信息。 SpectRobot并非通过触觉元件阵列来增加空间密度，而是利用稀疏、高带宽单点测量中所包含的丰富动态信息。在我们的实现中，传感器安装在远离接触表面的位置，同时与其保持机械耦合，从而减少直接磨损暴露，并可能提高在恶劣环境中的鲁棒性以及灵巧机器人长期部署的可靠性。 我们的实验表明：（1）机器人可以利用单点振动信号解决视觉遮挡的操作任务；（2）时间历史对策略性能有显著影响，而感知带宽控制着可用的频谱信息，测量频率可延伸至100 kHz；（3）同一表示可用于不同的触觉传感技术，涵盖加速度、力或应变等传感机制。我们进一步证明，以往需要研究级仪器才能实现的能力，现在可以通过现成的市售硬件获得。我们相信，高带宽触觉感知的更广泛普及能够促进接触动力学在具身学习系统中的整合，并且对于某些任务而言，可以成为增加触觉感知空间密度的替代方案或补充手段。

Authors: Joseph Rigal, Emmanuel Virot, Caroline Pascal

What do VLM-Based Vision-Language Navigation Models Rely on: Interpreting and Steering Policy Behavior VLN

Vision-Language Navigation Interpretability Steerability Intervention-based metrics Activation vectors

简要说明：本文分析视觉语言导航模型的可解释性和可操控性，表明它们依赖多种模态，并可通过内部激活引导以提升分布外性能。

TLDR: This paper analyzes the interpretability and steerability of Vision-Language Navigation models, showing they rely on multiple modalities and can be steered via internal activations to improve out-of-distribution performance.

Abstract: Modern Vision-Language Navigation (VLN) models rely mostly on pre-trained large Vision-Language Models (VLMs) to predict navigation actions. While this fusion of language instructions and visual observations allows multimodal reasoning, it obscures how information is routed across modalities or what mechanisms drive navigation decisions. Thus, it remains unclear whether VLN models ground their predictions in relevant semantic cues or can track task progress. In this work, we study the interpretability and steerability of VLN models. We use intervention-based metrics that measure how visual observations, instructions, and visual memory causally influence navigation decisions. Our results show that these navigation policies are sensitive to all input modalities and do not depend on a single one. We further show that these agents encode navigation progress and retain semantic structure from their VLM backbones, enabling concept-level steering through internal activations. Finally, we extract activation vectors for abstract behaviors to transfer them zero-shot to out-of-distribution real-world scenarios, improving performance without additional fine-tuning.

摘要（中文）：现代视觉-语言导航（VLN）模型主要依赖于预训练的大规模视觉-语言模型（VLMs）来预测导航动作。虽然这种将语言指令与视觉观察相融合的方式实现了多模态推理，但它却掩盖了信息如何在各模态之间传递，以及哪些机制驱动了导航决策。因此，目前尚不清楚VLN模型是否将其预测建立在相关语义线索之上，或者能否跟踪任务进度。在本研究中，我们探讨了VLN模型的可解释性与可操控性。我们采用基于干预的度量方法，衡量视觉观察、指令和视觉记忆对导航决策的因果影响。研究结果表明，这些导航策略对所有输入模态均具有敏感性，并非依赖于单一模态。我们进一步证明，这些智能体编码了导航进度，并保留了来自其VLM骨干网络的语义结构，从而能够通过内部激活实现对概念层面的操控。最后，我们提取针对抽象行为的激活向量，将其零样本迁移至分布外的真实世界场景，在无需额外微调的情况下提升性能。

Authors: Débora Oliveira Makowski, Samiran Gode, Abhijeet Nayak, Marco Hutter, Cordelia Schmid, Lukas Rosenberger Schmid, Wolfram Burgard

A Monolithic Force-Proprioception Soft Acutuator Enabled by Single-Material 3D printing Manipulation

soft robotics proprioception 3D printing gripper force sensing

简要说明：本文提出了一种通过单一材料3D打印制造的单片式软气动执行器，集成了力-本体感知功能，并演示了其在双指抓手中的应用。

TLDR: This paper presents a monolithic soft pneumatic actuator with integrated force-proprioception sensing, fabricated via single-material 3D printing, and demonstrates its use in a two-finger gripper for grasping and force sensing.

Abstract: Pneumatic proprioceptive actuators integrate actuation and sensing for soft robots that attract interest due to functional potential. Existing approaches often suffer from assembly errors or stress concentrations caused by heterogeneous materials. In this work, we propose the Monolithic Force-Proprioception Soft (MFPS) design and fabrication method that integrates an Asymmetric Origami Bending (AOB) chamber and a Force-Proprioception Soft (FPS) sensor with single material through one-step Fused Deposition Modeling (FDM) fabrication. Based on the resistance response to strain of conductive thermoplastic polyurethane (TPU), we design and analyze the structure of the FPS sensor, and conduct parametric analysis on the sensing characteristics. The FDM fabrication parameters of the MFPS actuator are analyzed, followed by actuator fabrication and characterization of the actuation and proprioception performance. Experimental results show that the MFPS actuator achieves a bending angle of 40°, an output force of 12.5 N, and a resistance change of 26.9% as the applied external force increased from 0 to 45 N. A two-finger force-proprioception gripper is developed based on the MFPS actuator. The grasping and force-proprioception capabilities are experimentally validated, proving that the MFPS design method provides a new approach for the development of self-sensing actuators.

摘要（中文）：气压本体感知执行器将驱动与传感功能集成于软体机器人中，因其功能潜力而备受关注。现有方法常因异质材料导致装配误差或应力集中问题。本文提出了一种单材料一体成型的气动本体感知软体（MFPS）设计与制造方法，通过一步熔融沉积建模（FDM）工艺，将非对称折纸弯曲（AOB）腔体与力-本体感知软体（FPS）传感器集成于一体。基于导电热塑性聚氨酯（TPU）的应变电阻响应特性，本文设计并分析了FPS传感器的结构，并对传感特性进行了参数化分析。对MFPS执行器的FDM制造参数进行了研究，随后完成了执行器的制造及其驱动与本体感知性能的表征。实验结果表明，当外部施加力从0 N增大至45 N时，MFPS执行器实现了40°的弯曲角度、12.5 N的输出力以及26.9%的电阻变化率。基于MFPS执行器，研制了一种双指力-本体感知夹持器，并通过实验验证了其抓取与力-本体感知能力，证明MFPS设计方法为自传感执行器的发展提供了一条新途径。

Authors: Nan Huang, Lele Liu, Junfeng Lu, Yipan Zhu, Jiansheng Dai, Sicong Liu

Do LiDAR Language Models Really Understand Spatio-temporal Relationships? AutonomousDriving

LiDAR language models spatio-temporal reasoning benchmark hallucination autonomous driving

简要说明：本文提出了LiDAR-Hallu，一个基于几何参照的基准，用于评估4D LiDAR语言模型在时空推理方面的能力，揭示这些模型往往依赖数据集偏差而非真正理解，并提出了时间洗牌对比解码但效果有限。

TLDR: This paper introduces LiDAR-Hallu, a geometry-referenced benchmark for evaluating spatio-temporal reasoning in 4D LiDAR language models, revealing that these models often rely on dataset biases rather than actual understanding, and proposes temporal-shuffle contrastive decoding with limited success.

Abstract: Recent 4D LiDAR language models aim to reason about objects and their evolving spatial relationships. Yet, in our evaluation, always selecting the same option nearly matches the multiple-choice accuracy of two B4DL-derived configurations. We introduce LiDAR-Hallu, a geometry-referenced benchmark and diagnostic protocol with 10,000 questions across 150 nuScenes scenes. It covers object existence, ego-relative position, distance ordering, relative motion, and temporal localization, with explicit rules for selecting objects, comparing times, and determining reference answers. Our protocol combines fixed-answer and candidate-content controls, cross-scene pairs with identical prompts but opposite reference answers, and relation-specific recall. Analysis of 100,000 recorded responses reveals failures hidden by aggregate accuracy. Candidate duration alone makes temporal answers predictable without observing LiDAR. On paired questions, the models frequently give the same answer to scenes requiring opposite answers. Relation-specific analysis further shows that both configurations miss every positive lateral-motion case across all tested conditions. Temporal-shuffle contrastive decoding provides little net improvement, as repairs are largely offset by new errors and the main failures persist. These results show that evaluating spatio-temporal reasoning requires testing whether models distinguish the queried physical relationships, rather than relying on individual-answer accuracy alone. The source code, checkpoints, and data are released at https://github.com/Awesome4D/4DMLLM_Hallucination_Bench.

摘要（中文）：近期的4D LiDAR语言模型旨在推理对象及其不断演变的时空关系。然而，在我们的评估中，始终选择同一选项的准确率几乎与两种基于B4DL构建的配置在多项选择题上的表现相当。我们引入了LiDAR-Hallu，一个基于几何参照的基准测试与诊断协议，涵盖150个nuScenes场景中的10，000个问题。该协议覆盖对象存在性、自车相对位置、距离排序、相对运动和时间定位，并明确了对象选择、时间比较以及参考答案确定的规则。我们的协议结合了固定答案与候选内容控制、具有相同提示但参考答案相反的跨场景配对，以及针对特定关系的召回率分析。对100，000条记录响应的分析揭示了在总体准确率下隐藏的失败模式。仅凭候选时长即可预测时间答案，而无需观察LiDAR数据。在配对问题上，模型经常对需要相反答案的场景给出相同回答。关系特定分析进一步表明，两种配置在所有测试条件下均遗漏了所有正向横向运动案例。时间洗牌对比解码带来的净改进甚微，因为修复效果在很大程度上被新引入的错误所抵消，且主要失败仍然存在。这些结果表明，评估时空推理能力需要检验模型是否区分所查询的物理关系，而非仅依赖单答案准确率。源代码、检查点及数据已发布于 https://github.com/Awesome4D/4DMLLM_Hallucination_Bench。

Authors: Runyi Yang, Murat Akkoyun, Di Wen, Ruiping Liu, Yufan Chen, Junwei Zheng, Xiaoye Wang, Kailun Yang, Danda Pani Paudel, Luc Van Gool, Kunyu Peng

Robotic Valve Turning: Axial Misalignment Correction Using Reaction Torque Feedback Manipulation

haptic control reaction torque valve turning robotic manipulation force/torque feedback

简要说明：本文提出一种利用反作用力矩反馈的触觉控制律，用于校正机器人阀门操作中的轴向偏差，并进行了稳定性证明、仿真以及Kinova Gen3真机实验。

TLDR: This paper proposes a haptic control law using reaction torque feedback to correct axial misalignment during robotic valve turning, with stability proof, simulations, and real-robot experiments on a Kinova Gen3.

Abstract: In this work, we propose a haptic update control law that uses reaction torques to correct axial misalignment during robotic valve manipulation. Unlike vision-based estimates, which can be affected by calibration errors, occlusion, and uncertainty in the contact geometry, reaction torques arise directly from the physical interaction between the gripper and valve. A geometric relationship exists between the error (misalignment) vector and these torques. The primary aim of this work is to propose a stable controller exploiting this geometric property. Our control law is proven to be uniformly asymptotically stable. Simulations are performed for verification. Furthermore, we experimentally test the robustness of our method using a Kinova Gen3 robotic arm for initial misalignments ranging from $-15^\circ$ to $15^\circ$ at 3 different valve positions and report the resulting data distribution. The absolute value of the median misalignment across all 18 test cases is found to be within $2.46^\circ$ and that of reaction torques within $0.23\mathrm{Nm}$.

摘要（中文）：在本项工作中，我们提出了一种利用反作用力矩来修正机器人阀门操作过程中轴向不对准问题的触觉更新控制律。与基于视觉的估计方法（可能受到标定误差、遮挡以及接触几何形状不确定性的影响）不同，反作用力矩直接来源于夹持器与阀门之间的物理相互作用。误差（不对准）向量与这些力矩之间存在几何关系。本项工作的主要目标是提出一种利用该几何特性的稳定控制器。我们证明了所提出的控制律具有一致渐近稳定性，并通过仿真进行了验证。此外，我们使用Kinova Gen3机械臂对初始不对准角度在$-15^\circ$至$15^\circ$范围内、3个不同阀门位置的情况进行了实验测试，以验证该方法的鲁棒性，并报告了所得数据分布。在所有18个测试案例中，不对准角度的中位数绝对值均落在$2.46^\circ$以内，反作用力矩的中位数绝对值落在$0.23\mathrm{Nm}$以内。

Authors: Amit Kumar, Sri Harsha Turlapati, Gautami Golani, Yang Lin, Ravi N. Banavar, Domenico Campolo

Tactile-JEPA: Topology-Aware Self-Supervised Representation Learning for Distributed Tactile Sensors Manipulation

tactile sensing self-supervised learning representation learning electronic skins robot manipulation

简要说明：Tactile-JEPA 提出了一种针对分布式触觉传感器的自监督表征学习方法，利用传感器连接图进行拓扑感知的掩码预测，从而提升力估计、手内朝向估计以及机器人策略学习等下游任务的表现。

TLDR: Tactile-JEPA introduces a self-supervised representation learning method for distributed tactile sensors that uses their spatial connectivity graph for topology-aware masking, improving downstream force estimation, in-hand orientation, and robot policy learning.

Abstract: Tactile sensing is an essential modality for robots performing contact-rich, dexterous manipulation, particularly under visual occlusion. While pre-trained image encoders are standard in robot learning pipelines, tactile encoders are still commonly trained from scratch from raw, noisy signals, which might limit their expressivity. Existing self-supervised learning (SSL) approaches focus predominantly on vision-based tactile sensors, leaving distributed electronic skins largely unaddressed. These sensors, however, have a distinctive property: their sensing elements are sparse and irregularly arranged over the surface they cover, which makes direct reuse of visual SSL methods suboptimal. We present Tactile-JEPA, an efficient self-supervised pre-training method that uses the spatial arrangement of tactile sensors to learn topology-aware representations. Specifically, it is trained to predict the embeddings of masked sensing elements from the unmasked remainder, using the sensor connectivity graph to guide spatial masking. Our analysis shows that effective tactile representations require capturing both local contact details and the global state of the tactile surface, which we achieve through dual-scale masking. Across three diverse datasets spanning magnetic and piezoresistive sensors, different robot embodiments, and single- and paired-sensor configurations, Tactile-JEPA reduces force estimation error by 6.3% and in-hand orientation error by 20.8% over the prior state-of-the-art, with consistent gains in other downstream applications, including policy learning. Overall, our results demonstrate that the benefit of tactile sensing depends critically on the quality of encoder pre-training, a problem which Tactile-JEPA addresses directly. Code is available at https://github.com/E-Kovtun/tactile.

摘要（中文）：触觉感知是机器人在执行高接触、灵巧操作任务时的关键感知模态，尤其是在视觉被遮挡的情况下。尽管预训练的图像编码器已成为机器人学习流程中的标准组件，触觉编码器却仍通常需要从原始、含噪信号出发从头训练，这在一定程度上限制了其表达能力。现有的自监督学习方法主要聚焦于基于视觉的触觉传感器，而分布式电子皮肤在很大程度上未被涉及。然而，这类传感器具有一个显著特性：其感知单元在被覆盖表面上呈稀疏且不规则分布，这使得直接套用视觉自监督方法并非最优。我们提出Tactile-JEPA，一种高效的自监督预训练方法，利用触觉传感器的空间布局来学习拓扑感知的表征。具体而言，该方法被训练用于从未被掩蔽的感知单元中预测被掩蔽感知单元的嵌入表示，并通过传感器连接图来引导空间掩蔽策略。我们的分析表明，有效的触觉表征需要同时捕捉局部接触细节与触觉表面的全局状态，为此我们通过双尺度掩蔽机制加以实现。在涵盖磁性和压阻式传感器、不同机器人本体以及单传感器和双传感器配置的三组多样化数据集上，Tactile-JEPA相较于现有最先进方法将力估计误差降低6.3%，手内姿态误差降低20.8%，并在其他下游应用中（包括策略学习）取得了一致的性能提升。总体而言，我们的研究结果表明，触觉感知的收益关键取决于编码器预训练的质量，而Tactile-JEPA正是直接针对这一问题提出的解决方案。代码已开源，可在https://github.com/E-Kovtun/tactile获取。

Authors: Elizaveta Kovtun, Matvey Konovalov, Andrey Sakhovskiy, Semen Budennyy

Performance-Preserving Online Adaptation in Social Navigation via Diffusion Steering RLRobot

social navigation diffusion steering reinforcement learning online adaptation hardware-in-the-loop

简要说明：本文提出了一种基于扩散引导的强化学习（DSRL）方法，用于社交导航策略的在线自适应，在保持基模型性能的同时实现灵活的行为调整，并通过硬件在环仿真验证了其有效性。

TLDR: This paper proposes a diffusion steering via reinforcement learning (DSRL) method for online adaptation of social navigation policies, which preserves the base model's performance while enabling flexible adaptation, and validates it in hardware-in-the-loop simulation.

Abstract: In social navigation, modeling the complex interactions between humans and robots is difficult, and deep reinforcement learning has therefore been actively studied. However, because simulation alone cannot fully reproduce diverse scenarios, robot dynamics, and the social conventions that vary across deployment environments, fine-tuning in the deployment environment is promising. In doing so, learning that preserves the base model's performance is required, so as not to compromise the primary objective of navigation, namely avoiding pedestrians and reaching the destination. In this study, we propose a method that applies diffusion steering via reinforcement learning (DSRL), which trains only the noise policy while keeping the diffusion policy fixed, thereby achieving learning that preserves performance. Furthermore, we integrate diffusion-based RL policies trained with multiple seeds to construct the base policy, improving learning performance. Our evaluation shows that, compared with other methods, the proposed method enables efficient learning while preserving performance, and we confirm flexible behavior control through adaptation to social conventions, as well as its effectiveness on a physical robot through hardware-in-the-loop simulation.

摘要（中文）：在社交导航中，模拟人与机器人之间复杂交互颇具难度，因此深度强化学习受到了广泛研究关注。然而，由于仅靠仿真无法完全复现多样化的场景、机器人动力学特性以及不同部署环境中各异的社会规范，因此在部署环境中进行微调具有重要前景。在此过程中，需要保持基础模型性能的学习方式，以免影响导航的首要目标，即避开行人并到达目的地。本研究提出了一种通过强化学习应用扩散引导（DSRL）的方法，该方法仅训练噪声策略，同时保持扩散策略固定不变，从而实现保持性能的学习。此外，我们将多个随机种子训练得到的基于扩散的强化学习策略进行整合，构建基础策略，以提升学习性能。评估结果表明，与其他方法相比，所提方法在保持性能的同时实现了高效学习，并且我们通过适应社会规范验证了灵活的行为控制，同时通过硬件在环仿真证实了其在实体机器人上的有效性。
