Authors: Haruto Nagahisa, Kohei Matsumoto, Yuki Hyodo, Ryo Kurazume

Phrase-Level Robotic Guqin Performance: Bimanual Motion Planning and Audio-Tactile Interaction Monitoring Manipulation

bimanual manipulation hierarchical planning audio-tactile feedback musical instrument performance humanoid robotics

简要说明：本文提出了一种分层规划框架，用于双臂机器人系统进行古琴乐句演奏，集成视觉、触觉和听觉反馈，在实体乐器上实现了高事件正确率。

TLDR: This paper presents a hierarchical planning framework for a dual-arm robotic system to perform phrase-level guqin music, integrating vision, tactile, and auditory feedback to achieve high event correctness on a physical instrument.

Abstract: Recent advances in humanoid robotics and embodied intelligence have enabled robots to perform increasingly complex manipulation tasks. However, musical instrument performance remains a formidable benchmark, demanding not only collision-free trajectory execution but also precise contact timing, asymmetric bimanual coordination, and target acoustic outcomes on physical instruments. The guqin, a seven-string fretless zither, presents unique manipulation challenges due to its millimetric string spacing, transient right-hand plucking, and sustained left-hand harmonic contacts. In this work, we present a physical heterogeneous dual-arm robotic system for phrase-level autonomous guqin performance. We formulate guqin playing as a hybrid discrete--continuous execution problem and develop a hierarchical planning framework that coordinates working finger assignment, configuration continuity, obstacle avoidance, and tight bimanual contact schedules across consecutive musical events. The system integrates vision-guided instrument localization, tactile-based harmonic contact monitoring, and auditory feedback-informed plucking parameter calibration. Real-world experiments on a 25-event phrase demonstrate that the system reliably executes coordinated open-string and seventh-hui harmonic sequences on a physical guqin, achieving 93.6% and 96.8% event correctness across repeated trials.

摘要（中文）：近年来，人形机器人与具身智能领域的进展使得机器人能够执行日益复杂的操控任务。然而，乐器演奏仍然是一项极具挑战性的基准任务，不仅要求无碰撞的轨迹执行，还需要精确的接触时机、非对称双臂协调，以及在实体乐器上产生目标声学效果。古琴作为一种七弦无品齐特琴，因其毫米级弦距、瞬态右手拨弦和持续左手泛音接触，带来了独特的操控挑战。在本研究中，我们提出了一套物理异构双臂机器人系统，用于乐句级自主古琴演奏。我们将古琴演奏建模为混合离散-连续执行问题，并开发了一种分层规划框架，该框架在连续音乐事件之间协调工作手指分配、构型连续性、避障以及紧密的双臂接触时序。该系统集成了视觉引导的乐器定位、基于触觉的泛音接触监测，以及基于听觉反馈的拨弦参数校准。在包含25个音乐事件的乐句上的真实世界实验中，系统在实体古琴上可靠地执行了协调的空弦与七徽泛音序列，在重复实验中分别实现了93.6%和96.8%的事件正确率。

Authors: Zhen Wang, Zhiheng Chen, Tianyuan Bao, Tianwei Zhang

Safety Control of a Hyper-redundant Robot via Adaptive Weighted Control Barrier Functions Manipulation

control barrier functions hyper-redundant robot adaptive weighting safety control tracking error

简要说明：本文提出了一种针对超冗余机器人的自适应加权控制屏障函数（W-CBF）框架，以提高安全性并减少因负载不均引起的跟踪误差，并在仿真和物理实验中进行了验证，包括覆盖任务。

TLDR: This paper proposes an adaptive weighted control barrier function (W-CBF) framework for hyper-redundant robots to improve safety and reduce tracking errors due to uneven loading, validated in simulation and physical experiments including a coverage task.

Abstract: Hyper-redundant robots are well suited for confined-space manipulation due to their high dexterity, but safe operation in cluttered environments remains challenging. In addition, their slender structures often lead to uneven load distributions and nonuniform tracking errors along the body. To address these issues, this work proposes a weighted control barrier functions (W-CBFs) framework that enforces safety constraints while reducing tracking errors caused by uneven loading. The proposed controller was first evaluated on a circular path-following task under different obstacle configurations. With fixed weights, compared to the non-weighted method, the maximum reduction in root-mean-square (RMS) tracking error was 59.6\% in simulation and 87.7\% in physical experiments. An adaptive weighting strategy was then investigated based on the discrepancy between simulated and experimental performance under different mapping functions. The RMS errors were further reduced by 21.9\% and 8.5\%, respectively, although the error increases when obstacles were located close to the robot body. Finally, the robot was evaluated in a cleaning task requiring coverage of a rectangular area and compared with manual teleoperation. Although the controller was not explicitly optimized for area coverage, the autonomous strategy achieved comparable or better coverage performance while avoiding collisions with the surrounding frame, whereas collisions occurred during manual operation.

摘要（中文）：高度冗余机器人因其高灵活性而非常适合在受限空间内进行操作，但在杂乱环境中安全作业仍面临挑战。此外，其细长结构常导致载荷分布不均及沿机体方向出现不一致的跟踪误差。为解决这些问题，本研究提出了一种加权控制屏障函数（W-CBFs）框架，在确保安全约束的同时，减少因载荷不均引起的跟踪误差。所提出的控制器首先在多种障碍物配置下的圆形路径跟踪任务中进行了评估。在固定权重条件下，与非加权方法相比，均方根（RMS）跟踪误差在仿真中最大减少了59.6%，在物理实验中减少了87.7%。随后，基于不同映射函数下仿真与实验性能之间的差异，研究了一种自适应加权策略。该策略使RMS误差进一步分别降低了21.9%和8.5%，但当障碍物靠近机器人本体时误差有所增加。最后，机器人在一项需覆盖矩形区域的清洁任务中进行了评估，并与手动遥操作进行了对比。尽管控制器并未针对区域覆盖率进行显式优化，自主策略在实现相当或更优覆盖率的同时，还能避免与周围框架发生碰撞，而手动操作过程中则发生了碰撞。

Authors: Zijian Cai, Kiwan Wong, Wenci Xin, Wei Xiao, Daniela Rus, Cecilia Laschi

AquaOrbit: Sim-to-Real Reinforcement Learning for Underwater Target Orbiting under Intermittent Visual Feedback RLRobot

reinforcement learning sim-to-real underwater robot intermittent visual feedback target orbiting

简要说明：AquaOrbit 提出了一种带恢复模块的强化学习控制器，用于在间歇视觉反馈下进行水下目标环绕，在 Isaac Sim 中训练并可零样本部署到真实机器人，在仿真和真实实验中优于基于 PID 的视觉伺服方法。

TLDR: AquaOrbit presents a reinforcement-learning controller with a recovery module for underwater target orbiting under intermittent visual feedback, trained in Isaac Sim and deployable zero-shot on real robots, excelling over PID-based servoing in sim and real trials.

Abstract: Intermittent visual loss disrupts target-relative feedback during underwater orbiting, making it difficult to maintain coordinated motion and reacquire a moving target. We present AquaOrbit, a reinforcement-learning controller with a recovery module for underwater target orbiting under interrupted visual feedback. During detection loss, the recovery module uses latched line-of-sight, roll, and depth references to support stabilization and target reacquisition. We train the controller in Isaac Sim with dynamics, observation, and vision-loss randomization. Evaluated without retraining in Gazebo/ROS2 under a different physics engine and perception perturbations, AquaOrbit completes 20/20 orbiting trials in each of the static- and moving-target conditions on an unseen variable-depth 3-D trajectory. In the moving-target condition, it reduces mean line-of-sight error by approximately 46% relative to a PID-based visual servoing controller with recovery while maintaining comparable path-tracking accuracy; removing the recovery module reduces completion to 9/20. Zero-shot physical deployment with fully onboard perception and control demonstrates elliptical, figure-eight, and variable-depth circular trajectories, including the latter two trajectory types absent from training. The robot maintains attitude stability during manual occlusions lasting up to 8s and reacquires the target within 2.5s in the reported attitude-induced field-of-view loss events.

摘要（中文）：间歇性视觉丢失会破坏水下环绕过程中的目标相对反馈，导致难以维持协调运动并重新捕获移动目标。我们提出AquaOrbit，一种带有恢复模块的强化学习控制器，用于在视觉反馈中断条件下实现水下目标环绕。在检测丢失期间，恢复模块利用锁存视线、横滚和深度参考来支持姿态稳定与目标重新捕获。我们在Isaac Sim中结合动力学、观测和视觉丢失随机化对控制器进行训练。在未重新训练的情况下，于不同物理引擎和感知扰动条件下的Gazebo/ROS2中进行评估，AquaOrbit在静态和移动目标条件下均完成了20/20次环绕试验，目标轨迹为未见过的变深度三维路径。在移动目标条件下，与基于PID的视觉伺服控制器（带恢复模块）相比，AquaOrbit将平均视线误差降低了约46%，同时保持了相当的路径跟踪精度；移除恢复模块后，完成率降至9/20。零样本实机部署采用完全机载感知与控制，成功实现了椭圆形、八字形和变深度圆形轨迹，其中包括训练中未出现的后两种轨迹类型。在手动遮挡持续长达8秒的情况下，机器人保持了姿态稳定性，并在所报告的由姿态引起的视场丢失事件中，于2.5秒内重新捕获目标。

Authors: Kanzhong Yao, Jinyi Leng, Hao Zhang, Zhe Sun, Xuelong Li

FinsSim: A Reality-Aligned Integrated Simulation Platform for Underwater Robot Learning RLRobot

underwater robot learning sim-to-real simulation platform hydrodynamics control policies

简要说明：FinsSim是一个面向水下机器人学习的现实对齐集成仿真平台，提供高保真水动力学、统一学习流程、多传感器融合定位和校准推进器模型，以实现可靠的Sim-to-Real控制策略迁移。

TLDR: FinsSim is a reality-aligned integrated simulation platform for underwater robot learning, offering high-fidelity hydrodynamics, unified learning workflows, multi-sensor fusion localization, and calibrated thruster models to enable reliable Sim-to-Real transfer of control policies.

Abstract: Underwater robot learning relies on simulators that integrate high-fidelity hydrodynamics, convenient learning interfaces, and a credible transition to real scenarios. In this work, we present FinsSim, a reality-aligned integrated simulation platform for Sim-to-Real underwater robot learning. FinsSim first constructs high-fidelity simulation with selectable backends to adapt to diverse requirements. To facilitate underwater robot research, it further offers standard control baselines, alongside with unified robot learning workflows. For reliable Sim-to-Real transfer, FinsSim adopts a multi-sensor fusion scheme to provide low-cost yet precise localization. Moreover, it implements calibrated thruster-hydrodynamics models and a constrained wrench allocation algorithm. Bridging these modules by ROS~2, FinsSim establishes a complete Sim-to-Real transfer pipeline. Through matched simulations and experiments, it is demonstrated that reliable Sim-to-Real transfer of underwater robot control policies can be achieved with the FinsSim framework. Separate ablation studies also validate that the modules of FinsSim can address the pivotal issues of underwater Sim-to-Real from different aspects. Overall, this work aims to bridge the gap between theoretical research and practical applications, ultimately driving advancements in the field of underwater robotics.

摘要（中文）：水下机器人学习依赖于集成了高保真水动力学、便捷学习接口以及向真实场景可靠迁移的仿真平台。本文提出了FinsSim，一个面向水下机器人Sim-to-Real学习的实景对齐集成仿真平台。FinsSim首先构建了具有可选后端的高保真仿真环境，以适应多样化需求。为促进水下机器人研究，该平台进一步提供了标准控制基线以及统一化的机器人学习工作流。为实现可靠的Sim-to-Real迁移，FinsSim采用多传感器融合方案，以低成本实现高精度定位。此外，该平台实现了标定推进器-水动力学模型及约束性力旋量分配算法。通过ROS 2将上述模块互联，FinsSim构建了完整的Sim-to-Real迁移流水线。通过匹配的仿真与实验，验证了基于FinsSim框架可实现水下机器人控制策略的可靠Sim-to-Real迁移。独立的消融研究也验证了FinsSim的各模块能够从不同方面解决水下Sim-to-Real迁移中的关键问题。总体而言，本文旨在弥合理论研究与实际应用之间的鸿沟，进而推动水下机器人领域的发展。

Authors: Yu Zhang, Yuanmingqing Song, Xiangyun Rao, Pangkit Fong, Kunhao Zhang, Chongrong Fang, Jianping He

ReVeal: A Reconstruction-Aware Real-to-Sim Framework for VLA Policy Evaluation VLA

real-to-sim reconstruction fidelity VLA policy evaluation closed-loop evaluation monocular depth supervision

简要说明：ReVeal 是一个真实到模拟的评估框架，用于评估用于 VLA 策略评估的模拟环境的重建保真度，使用新颖的指标和带有单目深度监督的重建流程，证明更高的重建保真度与更好的真实-模拟策略性能一致性相关。

TLDR: ReVeal is a real-to-sim assessment framework that evaluates the reconstruction fidelity of simulated environments for VLA policy evaluation, using novel metrics and a reconstruction pipeline with monocular depth supervision, demonstrating that higher reconstruction fidelity correlates with better real-sim policy performance agreement.

Abstract: Simulation-based evaluation provides a scalable and repeatable alternative to real-world evaluation of vision-language-action (VLA) policies. However, reconstruction errors can cause simulated policy performance to diverge from real-world performance, motivating the need to assess reconstructed environments for downstream VLA policy evaluation. We present ReVeal, a real-to-sim assessment framework combining workspace reconstruction, reconstruction-level assessment, and matched closed-loop policy evaluation. Novel-View Mesh Fidelity (NVMF) and Annotated Planar Geometry Fidelity (APGF) assess observation and planar geometric fidelity, respectively. We also develop PGSR-D, a reconstruction pipeline incorporating monocular depth supervision to improve geometry where multi-view visual cues are limited. Across 8 assessment scenes, NVMF and APGF consistently distinguish the fidelity of 2DGS, PGSR, and PGSR-D. Matched evaluations of GR00T, SmolVLA, and pi0.5 across 8 humanoid manipulation tasks show consistent ordering between reconstruction fidelity and real-sim performance agreement across pipelines. Further analysis of the evaluation workspaces shows that higher fidelity is associated with stronger real-sim agreement.

摘要（中文）：基于仿真的评估为视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略的真实世界评估提供了一种可扩展且可重复的替代方案。然而，重建误差可能导致仿真策略性能与真实世界性能产生偏差，因此有必要对重建环境进行下游VLA策略评估的适用性评估。我们提出了ReVeal，一种虚实结合的评估框架，集成了工作空间重建、重建级别评估和匹配的闭环策略评估。新视角网格保真度（NVMF）和标注平面几何保真度（APGF）分别评估观测保真度和平面几何保真度。我们还开发了PGSR-D，一种结合单目深度监督的重建流程，以在多视角视觉线索有限的情况下改善几何质量。在8个评估场景中，NVMF和APGF一致地区分了2DGS、PGSR和PGSR-D的保真度。在8个人形操作任务中对GR00T、SmolVLA和pi0.5进行的匹配评估显示，重建保真度与真实-仿真性能一致性在各流程间呈现一致排序。对评估工作空间的进一步分析表明，更高的保真度与更强的真实-仿真一致性相关联。

Authors: Xinyi Wang, Heng Hao, Wenjun Hu, Anna Enyu Li, Dizhi Ma, Karthik Ramani, Hankyu Moon, Yeong-Dae Kwon

BarrierFormer: Transformer-Guided Predictive Barrier Enforcement for Safe Robot Control RLRobot

control barrier functions transformer safe control model-free policy predictive safety

简要说明：BarrierFormer 提出了一种基于Transformer的框架，通过强制滚动时域的控制屏障函数约束来学习无模型、实时的安全控制策略，在安全率和推理延迟上优于RL、扩散、MPC和Transformer基线。

TLDR: BarrierFormer is a transformer-based framework that learns a model-free, real-time safe control policy by enforcing rollout-level control barrier function constraints, outperforming RL, diffusion, MPC, and transformer baselines in safety and latency.

Abstract: Control barrier functions (CBFs) have become one of the most popular tools for encoding and enforcing state constraints in safety-critical robotics. Standard CBF approaches are inherently myopic in nature as they enforce safety only at the current time step. Consequently, the system can be driven toward the boundary of the safe set where no feasible safe control exists at a future timestep. Model predictive control (MPC) based approaches address this by enforcing state constraints over a receding horizon. However, such approaches generally require the model to be known for solving a constrained optimization problem at every step, which is computationally expensive for real-time deployment. We propose BarrierFormer, a barrier-supervised transformer framework that addresses these limitations by encoding rollout-level CBF constraints in learning a model-free safe policy. A causal transformer encodes observation-action history, autoregressively generates a predictive rollout through the dynamics head to replace the model, and provides a residual correction to a nominal controller through the action head to replace the online computation. A barrier critic operating on local observations evaluates CBF constraint violations along this rollout, and a safety teacher computes barrier-consistent actions satisfying these constraints as direct supervision targets for the learned control policy. During inference, the policy maps observation-action history to control actions without any online optimization or model knowledge, enabling real-time model-free predictive safety enforcement. Evaluations across linear and nonlinear, 2D and 3D dynamical systems for safe goal-directed navigation demonstrate that BarrierFormer outperforms existing reinforcement learning (RL)-based, diffusion-based, MPC-based, and transformer-based approaches in safety rate and inference latency.

摘要（中文）：控制屏障函数（CBFs）已成为安全关键机器人领域中编码和执行状态约束最常用的工具之一。标准的CBF方法本质上是短视的，因为它们仅在当前时间步强制执行安全性。因此，系统可能被驱动至安全集合的边界，而在未来时间步中将不存在可行的安全控制。基于模型预测控制（MPC）的方法通过在滚动时域上强制执行状态约束来应对这一问题。然而，此类方法通常需要已知模型以在每一步求解约束优化问题，这对于实时部署而言计算成本过高。我们提出BarrierFormer，一种屏障监督的Transformer框架，通过在无模型安全策略学习中编码滚动级CBF约束来解决上述局限性。因果Transformer编码观测-动作历史，通过动力学头自回归生成预测性滚动输出以替代模型，并通过动作头为标称控制器提供残差校正以替代在线计算。基于局部观测的屏障评论家评估沿该滚动输出的CBF约束违背情况，安全教师计算满足这些约束的屏障一致动作，作为学习控制策略的直接监督目标。在推理阶段，该策略将观测-动作历史映射为控制动作，无需任何在线优化或模型知识，从而实现实时的无模型预测性安全保障。在线性和非线性、二维和三维动力学系统的安全目标导向导航评估中表明，BarrierFormer在安全率和推理延迟方面优于现有的基于强化学习（RL）、基于扩散、基于MPC及基于Transformer的方法。

Authors: Anandsingh Chauhan, Kunal Garg

HumynexSurg-1: A Curated Expert Liposuction Dataset Manipulation

surgical dataset robot foundation model force/torque fine-tuning liposuction

简要说明：HumynexSurg-1是一个带同步力、RGB-D视频和叙述决策的专家吸脂手术数据集，用于机器人基础模型在手术操作中的微调，并在NVIDIA Isaac GR00T N1.7上进行了概念验证。

TLDR: HumynexSurg-1 is a curated expert liposuction dataset with synchronized force, RGB-D video, and narrated decisions, designed for robot foundation model fine-tuning in surgical manipulation, with a proof-of-concept on NVIDIA Isaac GR00T N1.7.

Abstract: Robot foundation models learn manipulation from large demonstration corpora, but surgery is missing from those corpora: across the 780-hour Open-H surgical collection, one dataset carries synchronized force and none covers an aesthetic procedure. Liposuction is the hard case, because the instrument works under the skin and the surgeon operates by feel and by judgment. Humynex Robotics builds curated expert datasets for this kind of procedure. HumynexSurg-1 is the first release: a master liposuction surgeon performing on porcine abdominal tissue while narrating every decision, recorded with synchronized suction pressure, six-axis hand force/torque, top-down RGB-D video, side video and a lavalier microphone -- 14 episodes, 42,738 frames, 35.6 minutes, 356 utterances of which 95% compile into a liposuction-specific label schema. The capture follows a patent-pending sensing plan organized around the quantities a policy needs, so a channel captured today by a model can be upgraded to a sensor tomorrow without changing the data format. This release captures the instrument motion as a tool-hand track in the side video and provides the force channel as state; the funded capture adds a measured 6-DoF handle pose, a validated force channel, ultrasound imaging of the fat layer, and palpation sensing. As a proof of concept, NVIDIA Isaac GR00T N1.7 fine-tunes on the dataset with no custom code in under an hour per run and learns the recorded sessions; scaling probes on the same episodes show where further gains come from: every new session lowers the error on an unseen session. The dataset, its label schema, its quality-assurance reports and its evaluation protocol are the product; the next capture, many short sessions across fat regions with the sensors named here, is what the probes point to.

摘要（中文）：机器人基础模型从大规模示范语料库中学习操作技能，但手术操作在这些语料库中尚属空白：在长达780小时的Open-H手术数据集中，仅有一个数据集包含同步力信息，且没有任何数据集涵盖美容外科手术。吸脂手术是其中的难点案例，因为器械在皮肤下操作，外科医生依靠触觉和判断进行手术。Humynex Robotics针对此类手术构建了精挑细选的专家数据集。HumynexSurg-1是首个发布版本：由一位资深吸脂手术专家在猪腹部组织上进行操作，并对每个决策进行旁白解说，同步记录抽吸压力、六轴手部力/力矩、俯视RGB-D视频、侧视视频及领夹式麦克风音频——共14个片段、42,738帧、35.6分钟、356条语音描述，其中95%可编译为吸脂专用标签模式。该采集过程遵循一项正在申请专利的传感方案，其设计围绕策略所需的物理量展开，因此今天由模型捕获的通道可以在不改变数据格式的情况下，明天升级为传感器。本版本将器械运动以工具-手部轨迹的形式记录在侧视视频中，并提供力通道作为状态信息；已获资助的采集方案将进一步增加经过标定的6自由度手柄位姿、经过验证的力通道、脂肪层超声成像及触诊感知。作为概念验证，NVIDIA Isaac GR00T N1.7在无需自定义代码的情况下，单次运行可在不到一小时内对该数据集进行微调并学会录制的操作片段；同一批片段上的扩展实验揭示了进一步收益的来源：每增加一个新的会话，都会降低在未见会话上的误差。该数据集、其标签模式、质量保障报告及评估协议即为本产品；下一轮采集——涵盖不同脂肪区域的多个短会话，并配备上述传感器——正是实验所指明的方向。

Authors: Rhea Huang, David L. Matlock, Laurence Reich

Risk-Aware Motion Planning and Control under Unknown Dynamics with Hybrid Observations Other

risk-aware motion planning unknown dynamics hybrid observations stochastic shortest path controller synthesis

简要说明：本文提出了一种在未知动力学和部分状态可观测条件下的风险感知运动规划与控制框架，通过预计算开环控制并量化过渡风险来引导机器人穿越盲区。

TLDR: This paper presents a risk-aware motion planning and control framework for robots navigating under unknown dynamics with partial state observability, addressing blind regions by precomputing open-loop controls and quantifying transition risks to guide high-level planning.

Abstract: We consider robotic motion planning and control under unknown dynamics with hybrid state observations, where state measurements are available only in parts of the state space. Existing work combines system identification, predicted reachability, graph search and controller synthesis in a hierarchical framework using local affine approximated models over polytopic state space partitioning, but requires state observations for identification and feedback control. Based on this framework, we address blind regions by selecting nominal dynamics and precomputing open-loop control sequences before observation is lost. Since the true dynamics may differ from the selected nominal model, the robot may exit a blind polytope through an unintended facet. We quantify this transition risk and incorporate the possible outcomes into a stochastic transition system. The high-level planning problem is formulated as a stochastic shortest path problem, whose policy guides controller synthesis. A case study demonstrates that the method guides the robot from an initial state to a target while balancing route efficiency and the risks associated with traversing blind regions.

摘要（中文）：我们考虑在未知动力学和混合状态观测下的机器人运动规划与控制问题，其中状态测量仅在状态空间的某些部分可用。现有工作通过层次化框架，结合系统辨识、预测可达性、图搜索和控制器综合，在基于多胞形状态空间划分的局部仿射近似模型上进行处理，但该方法要求状态观测用于辨识和反馈控制。在此框架基础上，我们通过选择名义动力学并在观测丢失前预先计算开环控制序列来处理盲区问题。由于真实动力学可能与所选的名义模型存在差异，机器人可能从意外的小面离开盲多胞形。我们量化了这种转移风险，并将可能的结果纳入随机转移系统。高层规划问题被构建为随机最短路径问题，其策略指导控制器综合。案例研究表明，该方法能够在平衡路径效率与穿越盲区相关风险的同时，引导机器人从初始状态到达目标。

Authors: Zhiquan Zhang, Melkior Ornik

WorldCrafter: Consistent Video World Model with Implicit 3D-aware Memory WorldModel

video world model implicit 3D-aware memory long-horizon consistency camera control scene exploration

简要说明：WorldCrafter提出了一种带有隐式3D感知记忆的视频世界模型，支持从单张图像或文本提示进行长时程、相机可控的场景探索，无需显式深度即可提升一致性和控制精度。

TLDR: WorldCrafter introduces a video world model with an implicit 3D-aware memory that enables long-horizon, camera-controlled scene exploration from a single image or text prompt, improving consistency and control without explicit depth.

Abstract: Video world models enable interactive exploration of dynamic environments, yet struggle to respect prior observations over long horizons and across viewpoints. We present WorldCrafter, a video world model that learns a camera-queryable implicit 3D-aware memory for this purpose. The key insight is to let the requested viewpoint shape how multi-view evidence is compressed into the video generator's limited token budget. Trained jointly with the video generator, a memory encoder and pose-conditioned readout module integrate historical observations into a fixed set of target view-specific tokens before denoising, without explicit depth-based correspondences. By combining this memory with recent temporal context and few-step distillation, WorldCrafter enables streaming scene exploration from a single input image or text prompt. Experiments across static and dynamic scenes show substantial gains in long-horizon consistency and camera-control accuracy while preserving visual quality during minute-scale exploration.

摘要（中文）：视频世界模型能够实现对动态环境的交互式探索，但在长时间跨度及跨视角条件下，难以保持对先前观察结果的一致性。我们提出了WorldCrafter，一种视频世界模型，通过学习一种可被摄像机查询的隐式3D感知记忆来解决这一问题。其关键在于，让所请求的视角决定多视角证据如何被压缩进视频生成器有限的令牌预算中。该记忆编码器与姿态条件读取模块与视频生成器联合训练，在去噪阶段之前，将历史观察结果整合为固定的目标视角特定令牌集，无需显式的基于深度的对应关系。通过将该记忆与近期时间上下文及少步蒸馏技术相结合，WorldCrafter能够从单张输入图像或文本提示出发，实现流式场景探索。在静态与动态场景上的实验表明，该模型在长时间一致性及摄像机控制精度方面取得了显著提升，同时在一分钟级别的场景探索中保持了视觉质量。

Authors: Wangbo Yu, Kunhao Liu, Wenbo Hu, Shenghai Yuan, Chaoran Feng, Haiyang Zhou, Yukun Huang, Yiran Wang, Wang Zhao, Yingmin Luo, Ying Shan

Brain-Inspired Hierarchical Modularity for General Continual Learning Manipulation

continual learning modular adaptation foundation models embodied vision-language-action hierarchical modularity

简要说明：本文提出了一种受大脑启发的层级模块化持续学习原则，通过预训练基础模型的轻量模块化适应，在视觉识别、视觉语言理解、自我-外部视频理解和具身视觉-语言-动作学习等任务上持续改进，并在具身操作中取得大幅提升。

TLDR: This paper proposes a brain-inspired hierarchical modular principle for continual learning, instantiated as lightweight modular adaptation of pretrained foundation models, and shows consistent improvements across visual recognition, vision-language understanding, ego-exo video understanding, and embodied vision-language-action learning, with large gains in embodied manipulation.

Abstract: Continual learning, the ability to learn from sequential experience while retaining and adapting prior knowledge, is central to intelligent systems operating in changing environments. However, conventional continual learning is typically studied with offline task-wise training and clear task boundaries, leaving a substantial gap from general continual learning under online, uncertain, and evolving data streams. In this regime, intelligent systems must separate conflicting experience to reduce interference while integrating compatible experience to promote generalization. Inspired by the organization of the Drosophila learning and memory system, we identify a hierarchical modular principle that coordinates both functions through expert specialization and ensemble integration. We instantiate this principle as lightweight modular adaptation of pretrained foundation models, combining brain-inspired random expansion for expert routing and diversified modular integration across spatial and temporal scales. Across visual recognition, vision-language understanding, ego-exo video understanding, and embodied vision-language-action learning, our method consistently improves learning under online and uncertain data streams, with gains exceeding 50 percentage points over replay-free alternatives in embodied manipulation. These findings support hierarchical modularity as a biologically grounded path for learning from dynamic experience.

摘要（中文）：持续学习，即在从连续经验中学习的同时保持并调整先验知识的能力，是智能系统在变化环境中运行的核心。然而，传统的持续学习通常以离线任务式训练和明确的任务边界为研究前提，这与在线、不确定且不断演化的数据流下的一般持续学习存在显著差距。在此场景中，智能系统必须分离冲突经验以减少干扰，同时整合兼容经验以促进泛化。受果蝇学习与记忆系统组织方式的启发，我们识别出一种层级模块化原则，该原则通过专家特化和集成整合协调上述两种功能。我们将该原则具体化为对预训练基础模型的轻量级模块化适配，结合了受脑启发的随机扩展用于专家路由，以及跨空间与时间尺度的多样化模块集成。在视觉识别、视觉-语言理解、自我-交互视角视频理解以及具身视觉-语言-动作学习中，我们的方法在在线且不确定的数据流下持续提升学习性能，其中在具身操作任务中，相较于无回放基线方法，性能提升超过50个百分点。这些发现支持层级模块化作为从动态经验中学习的生物学基础路径。

Authors: Hongwei Yan, Kanglei Zhou, Qi Cheng, Weiyi Dong, Chunyan Lan, Guanglong Sun, Jun Zhou, Qian Li, Yi Zhong, Liyuan Wang

Action-Slot: Structured Action-Centric Representation Learning for Multi-Agent Atomic Activity Understanding AutonomousDriving

atomic activity understanding slot attention multi-agent weakly supervised localization traffic behavior

简要说明：Action-Slot 提出了一种面向多智能体原子活动理解的结构化动作中心槽注意力框架，在识别和弱监督定位上表现优异。

TLDR: Action-Slot introduces a structured action-centric slot attention framework for multi-agent atomic activity understanding in traffic scenes, achieving strong recognition and weakly supervised localization.

Abstract: Atomic activity understanding aims to recognize and localize structured traffic behaviors that jointly encode motion patterns and their grounding in road topology. Unlike conventional action recognition, atomic activities are multi-agent, multi-label, and topology-aware: multiple activities co-occur while many agents remain inactive. We introduce Action-Slot, a structured action-centric representation learning framework. Slot attention is widely used for object-centric decomposition, but its permutation-invariant design and object-level inductive bias are misaligned with atomic activity semantics. We reformulate slot learning as structured activity decomposition through three designs: (1) category-aligned action slots that anchor slots to predefined activity categories, (2) parallel spatio-temporal slot updating for holistic video-level reasoning, and (3) background and negative-slot regularization that enforces competition between foreground activities and irrelevant regions. Together these establish an activity-centric inductive bias that disentangles concurrent and asynchronous activities directly from raw video. Beyond recognition, the learned representations encode transferable spatio-temporal grounding signals. We further propose an attention-difference-based pseudo mask selection framework that suppresses false positives by measuring attention changes before and after candidate region removal, enabling weakly supervised localization without dense annotations. To support systematic evaluation, we introduce TACO, a balanced synthetic dataset with full atomic activity coverage and pixel-level annotations. Experiments on OATS, TACO, and annotated nuScenes show superior recognition, strong sim-to-real transfer, and state-of-the-art weakly supervised localization.

摘要（中文）：原子活动理解旨在识别并定位结构化交通行为，这些行为同时编码了运动模式及其在道路拓扑结构中的空间映射。与传统动作识别不同，原子活动具有多智能体、多标签和拓扑感知的特性：多个活动同时发生，而许多智能体处于非活跃状态。我们提出了Action-Slot，一种结构化的以动作为中心的表征学习框架。插槽注意力广泛用于以对象为中心的解耦，但其置换不变的设计和对象层面的归纳偏置与原子活动的语义不一致。我们通过三种设计将插槽学习重新构建为结构化活动分解：（1）类别对齐的动作插槽，将插槽锚定到预定义的活动类别；（2）并行时空插槽更新，实现整体的视频级推理；（3）背景和负插槽正则化，强化前景活动与不相关区域之间的竞争。这些设计共同建立了一种以活动为中心的归纳偏置，能够直接从原始视频中解耦并发和异步的活动。在识别之外，学习到的表征编码了可迁移的时空定位信号。我们进一步提出了一种基于注意力差异的伪掩码选择框架，通过测量候选区域移除前后的注意力变化来抑制误报，从而在无需密集标注的情况下实现弱监督定位。为支持系统评估，我们引入了TACO，一个平衡的合成数据集，涵盖完整的原子活动类别并带有像素级标注。在OATS、TACO和带标注的nuScenes上的实验表明，该方法在识别性能上表现优异，具备强大的从仿真到现实的迁移能力，并在弱监督定位上达到了最先进的水平。

Authors: Yu-Ho Chang, Chi-Hsi Kung, Yi-Hsuan Tsai, Yi-Ting Chen

NeuIDO: Neural Intrinsic Dynamics Operator for Physics-Informed 4D World Models WorldModel

neural operator world dynamics physics-informed 4D generation zero-shot inference few-shot adaptation

简要说明：NeuIDO 学习一个神经算子，将视觉观测映射到内在动力学，实现物理信息 4D 世界模型的零样本动力学推断，并支持少样本适应真实场景。

TLDR: NeuIDO learns a neural operator that maps visual observations to intrinsic dynamics, enabling zero-shot dynamics inference for physics-informed 4D world models, with few-shot adaptation for real-world scenes.

Abstract: World models aim to capture environmental dynamics and predict future trajectories, showing growing potential for embodied intelligence. Physics-informed 4D generation integrates physical simulation to predict 3D object interactions, offering a promising pathway toward world models. However, this paradigm relies on manually imposed dynamical assumptions rather than internalizing world dynamics, and thus still leaves a gap toward a true world model. To bridge this gap, we propose NeuIDO, a novel world dynamics modeling framework that learns a unified intrinsic dynamics representation from visual observations, advancing physics-informed 4D generation toward a world model. Specifically, we formulate world modeling as a neural operator learning problem and introduce a two-stage training strategy to learn a generalizable mapping from the visual observation distribution to the intrinsic dynamics distribution. Building on this observation-dynamics mapping, NeuIDO enables zero-shot dynamics inference directly from videos and can be further aligned with complex real-world dynamics via few-shot adaptation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that NeuIDO effectively unifies the intrinsic dynamics underlying diverse visual observations into a shared representation and rapidly infers dynamics in novel scenes.

摘要（中文）：世界模型旨在捕捉环境动态并预测未来轨迹，在具身智能领域展现出日益增长的潜力。物理信息驱动的4D生成将物理模拟与三维物体交互预测相结合，为迈向世界模型提供了一条有前景的路径。然而，该范式依赖于人为施加的动力学假设，而非内化世界动态，因此与世界模型之间仍存在差距。为弥合这一差距，我们提出NeuIDO，一种新颖的世界动力学建模框架，能够从视觉观测中学习统一的固有动力学表征，推动物理信息驱动的4D生成向世界模型迈进。具体而言，我们将世界建模表述为神经算子学习问题，并引入两阶段训练策略，以学习从视觉观测分布到固有动力学分布的可泛化映射。基于这一观测-动力学映射，NeuIDO能够直接从视频中进行零样本动力学推理，并可通过少样本自适应进一步与复杂真实世界动态对齐。大量实验表明，NeuIDO能够有效将多样视觉观测背后的固有动力学统一到共享表征中，并在新场景中快速推断动力学特征。

Authors: Jiajing Lin, Xin Zhang, Jianhua Sun

HappyWorld-Bench WorldModel

world model benchmark state consistency action-conditioned embodied world models Elo ratings

简要说明：HappyWorld-Bench 是一个全面的基准测试，用于评估视频、空间和具身世界模型，揭示了状态一致性和动作响应方面的可靠性差距。

TLDR: HappyWorld-Bench is a comprehensive benchmark for evaluating world models across video, spatial, and embodied tracks, revealing reliability gaps in state consistency and action responsiveness.

Abstract: Evaluating world models requires assessing both the quality of the worlds they generate and their consistency and responsiveness under exploration, interaction, and modification. We introduce HappyWorld-Bench, a comprehensive benchmark that evaluates whether generated worlds remain reliable as agents interact with them. Our design is built on a hierarchical capability framework of six world capabilities (W1-W6), from generative construction to unified world modeling, instantiated across three independent evaluation tracks: video world models, spatial world models, and embodied world models. HappyWorld-Bench comprises 1,138 video prompts, 300 spatial scenes, and 254 embodied test cases. Across all three tracks, we build and operate HappyWorld-Arena to organize human A/B comparisons and derive model-level Elo ratings, which complement newly designed automated metrics that capture behavioral correctness. We evaluate 14 video world models, 9 spatial systems, and 8 embodied candidates under this unified framework. Results reveal remaining reliability gaps across all three tracks: video models exhibit reduced consistency during extended rollouts and revisits, spatial models achieve at best 70.14% placement accuracy and 73.33% edit execution, and embodied models struggle to preserve state across multi-step actions and respond precisely to altered action conditions and physical rules. These findings highlight the need to evaluate world models not only by visual quality, but also by state consistency and the correctness of their responses to actions and interventions.

摘要（中文）：评估世界模型，需要衡量其生成世界的质量，以及在探索、交互和修改过程中表现出的一致性与响应性。我们推出HappyWorld-Bench，一个综合性基准测试，用于评估代理与生成世界交互时，世界是否保持可靠。该基准设计基于六项世界能力（W1-W6）的分层能力框架，涵盖从生成构建到统一世界建模，并在三个独立评估轨道中具体实施：视频世界模型、空间世界模型和具身世界模型。HappyWorld-Bench包含1，138个视频提示、300个空间场景和254个具身测试用例。在三个轨道中，我们构建并运行HappyWorld-Arena，组织人工A/B比较，并推导出模型级Elo评分，与新设计的自动化指标互为补充，以捕捉行为正确性。在此统一框架下，我们评估了14个视频世界模型、9个空间系统和8个具身候选模型。结果显示，三条轨道仍存在可靠性差距：视频模型在扩展推导和重访时一致性降低；空间模型的放置准确率最高为70.14%，编辑执行率达73.33%；具身模型在多步动作中难以保持状态，且对改变后的动作条件和物理规则响应不够精准。这些发现强调，评估世界模型不仅需关注视觉质量，还需重视状态一致性及其对动作和干预响应的正确性。

Authors: Zhiqi Bai, Junai Cai, Yixin Chen, Jingrun Du, Tao Feng, Wei Gong, Siyuan Huang, Xiao Lin, Jiaheng Liu, Jun Luo, Yongzhe Lyu, Liya Ma, Zenan Meng, Lin Qu, Wenbo Su, Jiaming Wang, Qinghe Wang, Shaofei Wang, Yanghai Wang, Zequn Wang, Ziming Wang, Hu Wei, Jiangtao Wu, Ruiqi Wu, Jiaxin Xie, Yuchi Xu, Ze Xu, Chengting Yu, Liangyu Yuan, Gang Zeng, Yawen Zeng, Xingyao Zhang, Zizheng Zhang, Bo Zheng, Jiancheng Zhu, Song-Chun Zhu

Lightweight Pedestrian Head-Orientation Recognition Network for Safe Pedestrian-Vehicle Interaction AutonomousDriving

head orientation recognition lightweight CNN low-resolution pedestrian intention prediction autonomous driving

简要说明：本文提出了一种用于行人头部朝向识别的轻量级CNN，并构建了新的标注数据集，在低分辨率交通图像上取得了高准确率，并展示了其在自动驾驶中对行人意图预测的辅助作用。

TLDR: This paper introduces a lightweight CNN for pedestrian head-orientation recognition with a newly constructed annotated dataset, achieving high accuracy on low-resolution traffic images and demonstrating utility for downstream pedestrian intention prediction in autonomous driving.

Abstract: Pedestrian head orientation recognition plays an important role in autonomous driving by providing valuable cues for understanding pedestrian attention and anticipating potential crossing behavior. However, reliable recognition in real-world traffic scenes remains challenging because pedestrian head regions are often captured at low resolution. To address this challenge, we propose a lightweight Low-Resolution Head Orientation Convolutional Neural Network (LRHO-CNN) for pedestrian head orientation recognition. We construct a new dataset by extracting pedestrian head images from multiple public datasets and manually annotating them into eight orientation categories. The collected images are systematically preprocessed and augmented to increase data diversity and better represent variations in illumination and image quality. The experimental analysis compares LRHO-CNN with three fine-tuned baseline models, namely ResNet-18, ResNet-34, and VGG-16. The results demonstrate that LRHO-CNN achieves the highest classification accuracy among the evaluated models. LRHO-CNN is further evaluated on the JAAD and PIE datasets, demonstrating its effectiveness in recognizing pedestrian head orientation in real-world traffic scenes and providing informative head-orientation cues that can support downstream pedestrian behavior and intention prediction.

摘要（中文）：行人头部朝向识别在自动驾驶中发挥着重要作用，能够为理解行人注意力及预判其潜在的横穿行为提供有价值的线索。然而，在真实交通场景中实现可靠的识别仍具挑战性，因为行人头部区域通常以低分辨率成像。为应对这一挑战，我们提出了一种轻量级低分辨率头部朝向卷积神经网络（LRHO-CNN），用于行人头部朝向识别。我们通过从多个公开数据集中提取行人头部图像，并人工标注为八个朝向类别，构建了一个新数据集。所收集的图像经过系统预处理和数据增强，以增加数据多样性，并更好反映光照和图像质量的变化。实验分析将LRHO-CNN与三种微调后的基线模型（ResNet-18、ResNet-34和VGG-16）进行了比较。结果表明，LRHO-CNN在所有评估模型中取得了最高的分类准确率。进一步在JAAD和PIE数据集上对LRHO-CNN进行评估，验证了其在真实交通场景中识别行人头部朝向的有效性，并能够提供信息丰富的头部朝向线索，为下游的行人行为及意图预测提供支持。

Authors: Yuanzhe Li, Yidi Huang, Xiaotong Chang, Hounian Liu

MotionJEPA: Preventing Temporal Feature Collapse by Capturing Visual Changes in Latent Space WorldModel

Joint Embedding Predictive Architecture Temporal Feature Collapse World Model Latent Representation Planning

简要说明：MotionJEPA 提出了一种名为 DISReg 的正则化器，通过结合静态和动态嵌入项来防止 JEPA 潜在世界模型中的时间特征坍缩，从而提升表征完整性和在静态背景干扰下的下游规划成功率。

TLDR: MotionJEPA introduces a regularizer (DISReg) that combines static and dynamic embedding terms to prevent temporal feature collapse in JEPA-based latent world models, improving representation completeness and downstream planning success under static-background distractors across four environments.

Abstract: Joint Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPAs) are a promising paradigm for learning task-agnostic latent world models without visual reconstruction. However, standard JEPA training exhibits a strong inductive bias towards slow features, causing feature suppression and the collapse of latent representation. While inverse dynamics provides temporal anti-collapse, it relies on action labels and offers little incentive to embed general, unlabeled dynamics. We introduce Difference Image and Single image embedding Regularization (DISReg), a novel regularizer that builds on an inverse-dynamics-style module that predicts temporal difference image embeddings without any pixel reconstruction loss, encouraging balanced static and dynamic feature learning. DISReg consists of a static term that shapes the distribution of the image embedding and encourages slow features, and a dynamic term, which, unlike direct regularization on the embedding, imposes no constraint on the image embedding's shape or distribution and instead only incentivizes that dynamic features be present. By integrating this regularizer into a standard JEPA, we establish our new architecture, MotionJEPA. Latent probing demonstrates that MotionJEPA produces more complete representations than other methods, and our trajectory analysis shows it maintains geometrically simple latent embeddings with low curvature. We further show that MotionJEPA improves downstream planning success under static-background distractors across four environments.

摘要（中文）：联合嵌入预测架构（JEPAs）是在无需视觉重建的情况下学习任务无关潜在世界模型的一种有前景的范式。然而，标准JEPA训练对缓慢特征存在强烈的归纳偏置，导致特征抑制和潜在表征的坍塌。虽然逆动力学提供了时间上的抗坍塌机制，但它依赖于动作标签，且对嵌入通用、无标签动态的激励不足。我们提出了差分图像与单图像嵌入正则化（DISReg），一种新颖的正则化方法，它建立在逆动力学风格的模块之上，用于预测时间差分图像嵌入，而无需任何像素重建损失，从而鼓励静态与动态特征的均衡学习。DISReg包含一个静态项，用于塑造图像嵌入的分布并鼓励缓慢特征；以及一个动态项，与直接对嵌入施加正则化不同，它不对图像嵌入的形状或分布施加任何约束，而仅激励动态特征的存在。通过将该正则化器集成到标准JEPA中，我们构建了新架构MotionJEPA。潜在探测表明，MotionJEPA产生的表征比其他方法更完整，而我们的轨迹分析显示，它保持了低曲率的几何简单潜在嵌入。我们进一步证明，MotionJEPA在四个环境中提升了静态背景干扰物下的下游规划成功率。

Authors: Markus Karmann, Shile Li, Christian Internò, Bruno Andreis, David Klindt, Randall Balestriero, Jindong Gu, Philip Torr, Qi Zhang, Peng-Tao Jiang, Hao Zhang, Bo Li, Onay Urfalioglu

Minimum Time Trajectories for a Car-Like Mobile Robot Moving with Rigid Wheels Under Non-Sliding Constraints Other

car-like robot time-optimal trajectories non-sliding constraints path primitives rigid wheels

简要说明：本文通过将运动学路径基元与三个考虑刚性轮非滑动约束的新基元结合，推导了汽车类移动机器人的最短时间轨迹，并提供了近似解析解。

TLDR: This paper derives minimum-time trajectories for a car-like mobile robot by augmenting kinematic path primitives with three new primitives that account for non-sliding constraints from rigid-wheel dynamics, providing approximate analytic solutions.

Abstract: This paper studies the minimum time trajectoriesvof a car-like mobile robot navigating in an obstacle free environment. The robot, with forward and backward speeds, is controlled by bounded front-wheels acceleration and limited front-wheels steering rate. The paper extends previous results which solved this problem for the kinematic car-like robot. However, the kinematic model assumes pure rolling at the wheels ground contacts. This assumption requires non-sliding constraints for the front and rear wheels that can only be handled by the robot dynamics. This paper formulates the non-sliding constraints based on the robot dynamics then augments the kinematic model time-optimal path primitives with three new path primitives associated with the non-sliding constraints. The three non-sliding path primitives together with the kinematic model twelve path primitives form the car-like robot time optimal trajectories. Approximate analytic solutions for the non-sliding path primitives are also provided. Examples study the time-optimal path primitives along representative maneuvers, illustrating how the non-sliding constraints influence the time optimal trajectories of the car-like robot.

摘要（中文）：本文研究了类车移动机器人在无障碍环境中行驶的最短时间轨迹问题。该机器人具备前进与后退速度，其前轮加速度和转向速率均受到有界限制。本文在已有针对运动学类车机器人研究成果的基础上进行了扩展。然而，运动学模型假设车轮与地面接触点处为纯滚动状态，这一假设要求前后轮均满足无滑动约束，而该约束仅能通过机器人动力学来处理。本文基于机器人动力学建立了无滑动约束模型，并将运动学模型中的时间最优路径基本单元扩展为包含三种与无滑动约束相关的新型路径基本单元。这三种无滑动路径基本单元与运动学模型中的十二种路径基本单元共同构成了类车机器人的时间最优轨迹。同时，本文还给出了无滑动路径基本单元的近似解析解。通过实例分析了代表性操作中的时间最优路径基本单元，展示了无滑动约束对类车机器人时间最优轨迹的影响。

Authors: Joseph Ben-Asher, Elon Rimon, Leeor Ravina

SPARSER: Sparse Variable Projection by Exploiting Separable Structure in Robotic Perception Perception3D

Variable Projection Nonlinear Least-Squares SLAM SfM Sparsity

简要说明：SPARSER提出了一种用于机器人感知中规范对称非线性最小二乘问题的变量投影框架，联合利用稀疏性和可分离性，在SLAM、SNL和SfM基准测试上比最先进的求解器快5-7倍。

TLDR: SPARSER introduces a Variable Projection framework for gauge-symmetric nonlinear least-squares problems in robotic perception, jointly exploiting sparsity and separability to achieve 5-7x speedups over state-of-the-art solvers on SLAM, SNL, and SfM benchmarks.

Abstract: Robotic perception often requires solving large nonlinear least-squares (NLS) problems. While sparsity has been widely exploited to scale solvers, a complementary and underused structure is \emph{separability}: some variables, such as visual landmarks, appear linearly in the residuals and admit a closed-form solution once the remaining variables, such as poses, are fixed. Variable projection (VarPro) exploits this structure by analytically eliminating the linear variables, yielding a reduced problem with favorable computational properties. However, its use in robotic perception has been limited by gauge symmetries, such as invariance to global translations and rotations, which introduce challenges for standard VarPro methods. We present SPARSER (\textbf{S}parsity \textbf{P}reserving \textbf{A}nalytic \textbf{R}eduction for \textbf{S}eparable \textbf{R}obotic \textbf{P}erception), a VarPro framework for gauge-symmetric problems that jointly exploits separability and sparsity. Our method constructs a \emph{matrix-free Schur complement operator} for efficient evaluation of reduced costs, gradients, and Hessian-vector products, enabling integration with iterative NLS solvers. We characterize the applicable problem class, identify common cases admitting further analytical simplifications, and show that IRLS-based robust costs preserve most of the exploitable structure. Across synthetic and real SLAM, SNL, and SfM benchmarks, SPARSER is on average $5\times$--$7\times$ faster than state-of-the-art baselines on CPU and GPU, with gains exceeding $40\times$ on individual datasets. On outlier-corrupted multi-robot SLAM data, the robust variant is $2\times$--$16\times$ faster than a state-of-the-art GNC solver. We release open-source C++ code and all datasets.

摘要（中文）：机器人感知通常需要求解大规模非线性最小二乘（NLS）问题。尽管稀疏性已被广泛用于扩展求解器的规模，但一种互补且未被充分利用的结构是\emph{可分离性}：某些变量（如视觉地标）在残差中呈线性出现，一旦其余变量（如位姿）固定，即可得到闭式解。变量投影（VarPro）通过解析消去线性变量来利用这一结构，从而得到一个具有良好计算特性的降阶问题。然而，其在机器人感知中的应用一直受到规范对称性（如对全局平移和旋转的不变性）的限制，这给标准VarPro方法带来了挑战。 我们提出SPARSER（\textbf{S}parsity \textbf{P}reserving \textbf{A}nalytic \textbf{R}eduction for \textbf{S}eparable \textbf{R}obotic \textbf{P}erception），一种面向规范对称问题的VarPro框架，同时利用可分离性和稀疏性。我们的方法构建了一个\emph{无矩阵Schur补算子}，用于高效计算降阶代价、梯度和Hessian-向量积，从而能够与迭代NLS求解器集成。我们刻画了适用的问题类别，识别了可进一步解析简化的常见情形，并表明基于IRLS的鲁棒代价保留了大部分可利用的结构。 在合成及真实的SLAM、SNL和SfM基准测试中，SPARSER在CPU和GPU上的平均速度比最先进的基线快$5\times$--$7\times$，在个别数据集上加速比超过$40\times$。在受异常值污染的多机器人SLAM数据上，鲁棒变体比最先进的GNC求解器快$2\times$--$16\times$。我们发布了开源C++代码和所有数据集。

Authors: Nikolas R. Sanderson, Andrew Fishberg, Haoyu Han, Heng Yang, Jonathan P. How, Hanumant Singh, Michael Everett, Alan Papalia

AC-DC: Adaptive Communication for Scalable Dynamic Average Consensus in Multi-Robot Ergodic Search Other

dynamic average consensus multi-robot ergodic search adaptive communication scalability

简要说明：本文提出了 AC-DC，一种用于多机器人系统可扩展动态平均共识的自适应通信协议，并将其应用于遍历搜索，相比基线实现了更低的通信量和更好的共识精度。

TLDR: The paper introduces AC-DC, an adaptive communication protocol for scalable dynamic average consensus in multi-robot systems, and applies it to ergodic search, achieving lower communication and better consensus accuracy compared to baselines.

Abstract: We study scalable peer-to-peer dynamic average consensus (DC) for multi-robot systems under finite-range, finite-rate, and interference-constrained communication. We introduce Adaptive Communication for Dynamic Average Consensus (AC-DC), which jointly adapts Who communicates with whom, When, and over What parts of the consensus state, using local inputs and successfully received neighbor information. Each robot's consensus state estimates the current average of the robots' local inputs. AC-DC updates these estimates as local inputs change and averages the values exchanged between robot pairs. In AC-DC, robot pairs update without waiting for every robot to complete a communication round, and the selected-state messages carry consensus state coordinates independent of team size for a fixed state representation. We apply AC-DC to dynamic-priority multi-robot ergodic search: one consensus stream estimates team visitation for motion coordination, while the other fuses regional measurement information to update uncertainty maps and search targets. Across twelve settings with up to 80 robots and 20 paired trials per setting, AC-DC has the lowest mean (i) normalized covariance-trace area under the curve (AUC) and (ii) attempted modeled communication payload among the compared decentralized methods. Averaged across settings, AC-DC achieves paired AUC reductions of 27.5% relative to state-of-the-art baselines, with 8.7x less communication traffic. As the number of robots increases, we observe that AC-DC's communication payload approaches that of the ideal centralized baseline (one ground compute-station communicating directly with all robots): with 120 robots in a fixed 600 x 600 m scaling test, AC-DC uses 19.3 MB versus 19.2 MB for the ideal centralized baseline, while remaining peer-to-peer.

摘要（中文）：我们研究了在有限范围、有限速率和干扰受限通信条件下，面向多机器人系统的可扩展对等动态平均一致性（DC）问题。我们提出了一种自适应通信动态平均一致性算法（AC-DC），该算法利用本地输入和成功接收到的邻居信息，联合自适应地调整“谁与谁通信”、“何时通信”以及“在共识状态的哪些分量上进行通信”。每个机器人的共识状态估计所有机器人当前本地输入的平均值。AC-DC在本地输入变化时更新这些估计值，并对机器人之间交换的数值进行平均。在AC-DC中，机器人对之间的更新无需等待所有机器人完成一轮通信，且所选择的状态消息携带的共识状态坐标维度与团队规模无关（在固定状态表示下）。我们将AC-DC应用于动态优先级多机器人遍历搜索任务：一条共识流用于估计团队访问情况以协调运动，另一条共识流用于融合区域测量信息以更新不确定度地图和搜索目标。在多达80个机器人的十二种设置中，每种设置进行20组配对试验，AC-DC在（i）归一化协方差迹曲线下面积（AUC）和（ii）尝试的建模通信负载方面，在所有比较的去中心化方法中均取得了最低平均值。跨所有设置平均来看，AC-DC相对于最先进的基线方法实现了27.5%的配对AUC降低，同时通信流量减少至原来的8.7倍以下。随着机器人数量增加，我们观察到AC-DC的通信负载趋近于理想集中式基线的水平（即一个地面计算站直接与所有机器人通信）：在固定600×600米扩展测试中，120个机器人时AC-DC使用了19.3 MB，而理想集中式基线为19.2 MB，同时AC-DC仍保持对等通信架构。

Authors: Robin Inho Kee, Begum Cannataro, Vasileios Tzoumas

Estimation and Control of Tensegrity Manipulator Kinematics based on Strut Inclination Angles Manipulation

tensegrity manipulator shape estimation IMU posture control reduced-order model

简要说明：本文提出了一种基于IMU传感器和优化的张力整体连续体机械臂降阶模型，用于形状和姿态控制，并进行了实时实验验证。

TLDR: This paper presents a reduced-order model for shape and posture control of tensegrity-based continuum manipulators using IMU sensors and optimization, with real-time experimental demonstration.

Abstract: Unlike conventional rigid-link robots defined by discrete joints, continuum robots pose a fundamental challenge for expressing their complex continuous bending configurations for closed-loop control. Several modelling approaches have been proposed for conventional continuum robots, but tensegrity-based continuum robots remain largely open. Moreover, many of these approaches assume a continuous elastic backbone and are therefore not directly applicable to tensegrity manipulators, whose bodies are networks of rigid struts and tensioned cables. This work presents a reduced-order model for shape and posture control of a tensegrity-based continuum manipulator. The manipulator is modelled as a serially connected parallel-link mechanism. The proposed method is formulated as an optimization problem that uses geometric constraints of the tensegrity structure together with information from the Inertial Measurement Unit (IMU) sensors embedded in the strut elements. To the best of our knowledge, this work presents the first experimental demonstration of a real-time IMU-based shape estimation method on a full-scale tensegrity manipulator and demonstrates posture control using a simple Proportional-Integral (PI) controller. The results show that the proposed method can estimate the shape of both single-module tensegrity structures and multi-module tensegrity manipulators from arbitrary static configurations and achieve desired postures.

摘要（中文）：与由离散关节定义的传统刚性连杆机器人不同，连续体机器人在表达其复杂的连续弯曲构型以实现闭环控制方面面临根本性挑战。针对传统连续体机器人已有多种建模方法被提出，但基于张拉整体的连续体机器人仍 largely 处于开放状态。此外，许多现有方法假设存在连续的弹性骨架，因此不直接适用于张拉整体机械臂——其本体是由刚性支柱和张紧缆索构成的网络。本工作提出了一种用于基于张拉整体的连续体机械臂形状与姿态控制的降阶模型。该机械臂被建模为串行连接的并联机构。所提方法被表述为一个优化问题，该问题利用张拉整体结构的几何约束以及嵌入支柱元件中的惯性测量单元（IMU）传感器信息。据我们所知，本工作首次在全尺寸张拉整体机械臂上实验演示了基于IMU的实时形状估计方法，并展示了一种使用简单比例积分（PI）控制器的姿态控制。结果表明，所提方法能够从任意静态构型估计单模块张拉整体结构和多模块张拉整体机械臂的形状，并实现期望姿态。

Authors: Tufail Ahmad Bhat, Shuhei Ikemoto

AnalogDepth: Multi-view Geometry from FPV drones under Analog Video Transmission Perception3D

FPV drone analog video transmission monocular depth estimation LoRA knowledge distillation

简要说明：AnalogDepth 通过基于 LoRA 的知识蒸馏和真实噪声库，将深度基础模型 Depth Anything 3 适配到模拟 FPV 无人机的噪声图像，提升了深度估计和三维重建精度。

TLDR: AnalogDepth adapts the Depth Anything 3 visual geometry foundation model to noisy analog FPV drone footage via LoRA-based knowledge distillation with a real-noise bank, improving depth estimation and 3D reconstruction.

Abstract: Analog video transmission (VTX) remains widespread in FPV drones due to low latency, weight and low cost. However analog VTX suffers from complex spatially structured image degradation which differ fundamentally from digital image corruption (e.g. AWGN) used in standard training augmentation. This work shows that this type of noise severely degrades the accuracy of Depth Anything 3 (DA3), a state-of-the-art feed forward visual geometry foundation model. To address this gap, we present AnalogDepth, a parameter-efficient training pipeline that adapts DA3 to analog FPV imagery using student-teacher knowledge distillation with Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) injected into the DINOv2 backbone. Rather than synthesizing noise analytically, we build a noise bank from static FPV recordings under diverse conditions and compare real-noise injection against PSD-matched Gaussian synthesis and AWGN as baselines. Experiments on six real FPV flight sequences across three indoor scenes show that training with our noise bank consistently reduces per-frame depth RMSE and 3D reconstruction Chamfer distance compared to the pretrained DA3 baseline and both Gaussian noise variants. These results demonstrate that replicating the spatial structure of real analog transmission noise is critical for effective adaptation.

摘要（中文）：模拟视频传输（VTX）由于低延迟、轻重量和低成本，在有刷无人机（FPV）中仍广泛使用。然而，模拟VTX存在复杂的空间结构图像退化，这与标准训练增强中使用的数字图像损坏（如加性高斯白噪声AWGN）根本不同。本研究表明，这类噪声严重降低了Depth Anything 3（DA3）的准确性，DA3是一种最先进的前馈视觉几何基础模型。 为弥补这一不足，我们提出AnalogDepth，一种参数高效的训练流程，通过学生-教师知识蒸馏和将低秩适应（LoRA）注入DINOv2骨干网络，使DA3适应模拟FPV图像。我们不采用分析性噪声合成就地生成噪声，而是从不同条件下的静态FPV记录中构建噪声库，并将真实噪声注入与PSD匹配的高斯合成及AWGN作为基线进行比较。在三个室内场景的六组真实FPV飞行序列上的实验表明，与预训练的DA3基线和两种高斯噪声变体相比，使用我们的噪声库训练一致降低了逐帧深度RMSE和三维重建Chamfer距离。这些结果表明，复现真实模拟传输噪声的空间结构对于有效适应至关重要。

Authors: André Amorim, Pedro F. Proença

OpenFlyScan: A Quality-Guided Aerial Reconstruction System for Consumer Drones Perception3D

3D Gaussian Splatting aerial reconstruction quality prediction reacquisition planning consumer drones

简要说明：OpenFlyScan提出了一种面向消费级无人机的质量引导航拍重建系统，通过预测3DGS重建质量并生成针对性补拍路径，提升用于具身模拟的城市资产构建效率。

TLDR: OpenFlyScan presents a quality-guided aerial reconstruction system for consumer drones that predicts 3DGS reconstruction quality and generates targeted reacquisition paths, improving urban asset creation for embodied simulation.

Abstract: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) provides high-fidelity scenes for large-scale embodied simulation, but constructing large-scale urban assets remains constrained by expensive equipment and delayed quality feedback. Preset surveys can leave complex surfaces insufficiently observed, with defects discovered only after reconstruction, requiring return visits and repeated processing. We present OpenFlyScan, a quality-guided aerial reconstruction system for consumer drones that integrates a GS quality model, a reacquisition planner, and a custom-designed mobile app. The model learns from GS rendering errors to predict regional reconstruction quality. Based on these predictions, the planner then generates complementary reacquisition strips to be executed through the app, which also supports automated oblique surveys and data transfer without additional hardware on board. Across real aerial scenes, the model effectively identifies regions that are likely to be poorly reconstructed. In the Expo West field experiment, targeted reacquisition improves PSNR at additional views by 10.95 dB. With consumer drones, OpenFlyScan integrates capture, targeted reacquisition, and reconstruction to support rapid, low-cost urban asset creation. Code and models will be made publicly available at https://openflyscan.github.io/.

摘要（中文）：三维高斯溅射（3DGS）可为大规模具身仿真提供高保真场景，但构建大规模城市资产仍受限于高昂的设备成本和滞后的质量反馈。预设航拍路径可能无法充分覆盖复杂表面，缺陷往往仅在重建完成后才被发现，从而需要返场补拍并重复处理。我们提出OpenFlyScan，一种面向消费级无人机、以质量为导向的航空重建系统，集成了GS质量模型、补采规划器以及定制化移动应用。该模型通过学习GS渲染误差来预测区域重建质量；在此基础上，规划器生成补充性补采航带，并通过移动应用执行，该应用还支持自动倾斜摄影测量与数据传输，无需机载额外硬件。在真实航空场景中，该模型能够有效识别可能重建不佳的区域。在西博城实地实验中，针对性补采使附加视点的PSNR提升了10.95 dB。凭借消费级无人机，OpenFlyScan将采集、定向补采与重建集于一体，支持快速、低成本的城市资产构建。代码与模型将公开于https://openflyscan.github.io/。

Authors: Zhongrui You, Zhen Li, Junli Liu, Zhigang Wang, Bin Zhao

Ask Before It Tells: Benchmark-to-Robot Body-Cue Transfer for a Question-First Bedside Robot Other

body-cue recognition assistive robot question-first interaction robot-camera viewpoint distress cue detection

简要说明：本文介绍了床边机器人Nuni，将检测到的痛苦线索视为询问而非警报的理由，并比较了RGB分类器与姿态中心混合流程，后者在机器人视角下具有更好的触发问题可靠性。

TLDR: This paper introduces Nuni, a bedside robot that treats detected distress cues as reasons to ask rather than alert, comparing RGB classifiers with a pose-centric hybrid pipeline that shows better question-triggering reliability from a robot-camera viewpoint.

Abstract: Body-cue recognition can support assistive robots, but benchmark accuracy does not guarantee reliable behavior under a robot-camera viewpoint. We present Nuni, a bedside robot prototype that treats a detected distress cue as a reason to ask rather than a reason to alert. We compare two X3D-UGT RGB appearance classifiers, which reach 97.7% and 94.8% six-way accuracy on NTU RGB+D, with a pose-centric hybrid pipeline on 28 single-actor scripted clips recorded from the robot camera. The hybrid path achieved 0.71 six-way macro recall, versus 0.25 and 0.29 for the fine-tuned and from-scratch RGB variants. More importantly for interaction, it produced a question-triggering distress cue in 12/16 distress clips and would have prompted unnecessarily in 2/8 normal clips; the RGB variants yielded a question-triggering cue in only 2/16 and 3/16 distress clips. We separately tested the question-first controller through event injection. All 13 state-transition trials passed: valid responses caused stand-down, two unanswered prompts produced one alert, and three boundary conditions were handled correctly. These results are a preliminary technical evaluation, not a user study or medical validation, but they show how interaction policy can limit the consequences of uncertain perception.

摘要（中文）：身体线索识别可以支持辅助机器人，但基准准确率并不能保证在机器人摄像头视角下具备可靠的行为。我们提出了Nuni，一种床边机器人原型，它将检测到的痛苦线索视为询问的理由，而非警报的理由。我们比较了两种在NTU RGB+D上分别达到97.7%和94.8%六分类准确率的X3D-UGT RGB外观分类器，以及一种基于姿态的混合流程，后者在从机器人摄像头录制的28个单人脚本片段上进行评估。混合路径实现了0.71的六分类宏平均召回率，而微调RGB变体和从零训练的RGB变体分别为0.25和0.29。更重要的是，在交互方面，混合路径在16个痛苦片段中的12个中产生了触发询问的痛苦线索，而在8个正常片段中的2个中可能不必要地触发了询问；RGB变体在痛苦片段中仅分别有2/16和3/16产生了触发询问的线索。我们通过事件注入单独测试了提问优先控制器。所有13个状态转换试验均通过：有效响应导致解除警报，两次未应答提示产生一次警报，三个边界条件被正确处理。这些结果是初步的技术评估，而非用户研究或医学验证，但它们展示了交互策略如何限制感知不确定性带来的后果。

Authors: Dongsik Yoon

Toward Human-in-the-Loop Robot Failure Recovery: Bridging Communication Gaps in Human-Robot Collaboration Other

human-robot interaction robot failure recovery LLM inverse semantics benchmark

简要说明：本文提出了 LD-HRI，一个用于评估人在环路机器人故障恢复的游戏、数据集和基准，通过衡量说话者（包括 LLM）生成的请求是否考虑听者知识差异来评估其性能。研究发现模型生成的请求对新手更有效，但仍存在显著的专家-新手差距。

TLDR: This paper introduces LD-HRI, a game, dataset, and benchmark for evaluating human-in-the-loop robot failure recovery by measuring how well speakers (including LLMs) generate requests that account for listener knowledge differences. It finds that model-written requests outperform human-written ones for novices but still leave significant expert-novice gaps.

Abstract: Robots can recover from failures by asking bystanders for help, but effective human-in-the-loop recovery requires communication that accounts for differences in people's knowledge. Prior inverse-semantics work generates requests using a single listener model, leaving differences in listener knowledge untested. We introduce Listener Differences in Human-Robot Interaction (LD-HRI), a game, dataset, and benchmark that evaluates speakers through human listener performance. Our evaluation examines request properties, large language model (LLM) speakers, and inverse-semantics request-selection algorithms under controlled differences in listener information. The corpus contains 446 human-written requests and 1{,}302 listener trials. We additionally evaluated 24 frozen LLM-written requests with 70 human listeners across 560 trials. Novice success is descriptively higher with model-written requests across all four tasks, yet both request sources leave substantial expert--novice gaps, including 16 percentage points for LLM requests. LD-HRI makes these gaps measurable, providing a foundation for designing more robust communication in human-robot and human-agent interaction.

摘要（中文）：机器人可以通过向旁观者求助来从故障中恢复，但有效的人机协同恢复需要考虑到人们知识差异的沟通方式。以往的逆向语义研究使用单一听者模型生成请求，未能检验听者知识差异的影响。我们提出了人机交互中的听者差异（LD-HRI），包括一个游戏、数据集和基准测试，通过人类听者表现来评估说话者。我们的评估在受控的听者信息差异条件下，考察了请求特性、大语言模型（LLM）说话者以及逆向语义请求选择算法。该语料库包含446条人类书写的请求和1,302次听者试验。我们还评估了24条由冻结的LLM生成的请求，涉及70名人类听者共560次试验。在所有四项任务中，模型生成的请求在初学者成功率上描述性更高，但两种请求来源均留下了显著的专家与初学者差距，其中LLM请求的差距达到16个百分点。LD-HRI使这些差距变得可量化，为设计更稳健的人机交互和人类-智能体交互中的沟通方式奠定了基础。

Authors: Promise Ekpo, Teju Vijay, Dhruv Mandalik, Tisha Jain, Arman Ibrayeva, Sunishka Sil, Stefanie A. Tellex, Angelique Taylor

MR-SPITE: Accelerating Multi-Robot Conflict Scans via Hierarchical Swept-Volume Approximations Other

multi-robot planning conflict scanning swept-volume approximation motion-segment filter collision checking

简要说明：MR-SPITE通过运动段上的层次扫掠体积近似加速多机器人冲突扫描，在协调多机器人系统中显著缩短规划时间。

TLDR: MR-SPITE accelerates multi-robot conflict scanning by hierarchically approximating swept volumes along motion segments, achieving significant speedups in planning time for coordinated multi-robot systems.

Abstract: Conflict scanning over synchronized robot paths requires detailed collision checking, potentially across every robot pair at every timestep, and may be repeated many times as conflicts are repaired. We present Multi-Robot SPITE (MR-SPITE), a conservative, motion-segment-based filter for accelerating these scans. MR-SPITE partitions each path into temporal intervals and assigns conservative bounds to each segment. An interval scheduler compares bounds for temporally overlapping motions: disjoint bounds certify the shared window as conflict-free, while unresolved windows are passed to the underlying collision checker. We integrate MR-SPITE into ARC and combine it with VAMP-based collision checking. For 16 Fetch robots, ARC with MR-SPITE achieves a paired median conflict scan speedup of 7.18x and reduces median planning time by 57% relative to the baseline ARC implementation with PRM+VAMP. These results demonstrate that motion-segment bounds complement configuration-level collision acceleration while preserving the behavior of the underlying discretized scanner.

摘要（中文）：同步化机器人路径上的冲突扫描需要对每一时间步上的每一对机器人进行细致的碰撞检测，并且在冲突修复过程中可能需要重复执行多次。我们提出了多机器人SPITE（MR-SPITE），一种基于运动片段的保守型过滤器，用于加速这些扫描过程。MR-SPITE将每条路径划分为时间区间，并为每个片段分配保守边界。一个区间调度器比较时间上重叠的运动对应的边界：不相交的边界可证明共享窗口内无冲突，而未解决的窗口则交由底层碰撞检测器处理。我们将MR-SPITE集成到ARC中，并将其与基于VAMP的碰撞检测相结合。对于16个Fetch机器人，采用MR-SPITE的ARC在冲突扫描中位数速度上实现了7.18倍的提升，并且相对于采用PRM+VAMP的基线ARC实现，规划时间中位数减少了57%。这些结果表明，运动片段边界能够补充配置级碰撞加速，同时保持底层离散化扫描器的行为不变。

Authors: Marta Markowicz, James Motes, Marco Morales, Nancy Amato

Object-Centered Reconstruction for Vision-Based 3D Force Estimation Manipulation

vision-based force estimation object-centered reconstruction soft-tissue deformation surgical robotics stereo endoscopic video

简要说明：本文提出了一种基于视觉的3D作用力估计方法，通过物体中心重建和几何约束跟踪软组织变形，并在手术视频上验证了其可行性。

TLDR: This paper presents a vision-based pipeline for estimating 3D interaction forces from soft-tissue deformation in stereo endoscopic video, using object-centered reconstruction and geometry-constrained tracking, with validation on phantom, ex vivo, and in vivo surgical data.

Abstract: Excessive force may damage tissue and increase the risk of anastomotic leakage in robotic colorectal surgery. Although the da Vinci 5 provides force sensing, this capability is unavailable on earlier da Vinci systems and many other surgical robotic platforms. In this work, we present a vision-based pipeline for estimating 3D interaction forces from soft-tissue deformation in stereo endoscopic video. We dynamically reconstruct the tissue point cloud in an object-centered coordinate frame, track tissue points with geometric constraints, and predict the 3D force vector with a neural network. We progressively evaluate the pipeline on rubber-glove phantoms, ex vivo porcine colons, and in vivo colorectal surgical video sequences. Under varying tissue orientations and positions within the endoscopic view, as well as different camera viewpoints, the proposed method achieves average root mean square error (RMSEs) of 0.77 N and 1.30 N on the phantom and porcine colon, respectively. Compared with the camera-frame representation, the object-centered representation reduces average RMSE by 51.3% and 56.7%, while geometry-constrained tracking reduces RMSE by 19.8% and 25.3% compared with CoTracker. We further qualitatively demonstrate the feasibility of vision-based force estimation on an in vivo colorectal surgical sequence, as a step toward clinical translation of vision-based, sensorless force estimation.

摘要（中文）：在机器人结直肠手术中，过大的作用力可能损伤组织并增加吻合口漏的风险。尽管达芬奇5代手术系统具备力感知功能，但早期的达芬奇系统及许多其他手术机器人平台尚不具备该能力。本研究提出了一种基于视觉的流程，通过立体内窥镜视频中软组织形变来估计三维交互力。我们在以目标为中心的坐标系中动态重建组织点云，利用几何约束跟踪组织点，并通过神经网络预测三维力向量。我们逐步在橡胶手套仿体、离体猪结肠以及在体结直肠手术视频序列上评估该流程。在内窥镜视野中组织朝向和位置变化以及不同相机视角的条件下，所提方法在仿体和猪结肠上分别实现了0.77 N和1.30 N的平均均方根误差（RMSE）。与相机坐标系表示相比，以目标为中心的表示将平均RMSE分别降低了51.3%和56.7%；与CoTracker相比，几何约束跟踪将RMSE分别降低了19.8%和25.3%。我们进一步通过在体结直肠手术序列上的定性实验，证明了基于视觉的力估计的可行性，为基于视觉、无需传感器的力估计向临床转化迈出了重要一步。

Partial-Scan-and-Move Source Seeking for Mobile Robots RLRobot

partial scan source seeking gradient estimation confidence set mobile robot

简要说明：本文提出一种部分扫描-移动策略，使移动机器人利用偏置传感器进行源搜索，通过不完全圆形扫描估计梯度并构建置信集，以决定移动方向和是否接近源。

TLDR: This paper introduces a partial-scan-and-move strategy for mobile robots to seek a source using an offset sensor, estimating gradients from incomplete circular scans with confidence sets to guide movement and termination near the source.

Abstract: This paper presents a partial-scan-and-move strategy for source seeking with a mobile robot equipped with an offset scalar sensor. At each robot position, the sensor collects source field measurements while the robot rotates. Instead of requiring a complete circular scan before every move, we ask when the measurements collected over only part of the circle are already sufficient to determine the next action. We develop a gradient estimation method for partial scans together with a confidence set that accounts for measurement noise and local field variation. The robot uses this confidence set to decide whether it is close enough to the source or has enough information to move in a descent direction. We show that, under suitable conditions, each decision can be made within a prescribed partial scan and that the robot reaches a desired neighborhood of the source in finitely many moves with high probability.

摘要（中文）：本文提出了一种部分扫描与移动策略，用于配备偏置标量传感器的移动机器人执行源搜索任务。在每个机器人位置，机器人在旋转过程中传感器采集源场测量值。我们并不要求在每次移动前完成完整的圆形扫描，而是探究仅基于圆上部分区域采集的测量值是否已足以确定下一步动作。我们开发了一种适用于部分扫描的梯度估计方法，并构建了一个考虑测量噪声和局部场变化的置信集。机器人利用该置信集判断自身是否已足够接近源，或者是否拥有足够信息沿下降方向移动。我们证明，在适当条件下，每次决策均可在预设的部分扫描范围内完成，并且机器人能够在有限次移动内以高概率到达源的期望邻域。
